ServiceNow is seeking a Manager, Technical Accounting, to join our Technical Accounting team in our next phase of growth. This is a high-visibility position that will play an important role in researching and documenting a wide variety of complex technical accounting matters, supporting purchase accounting for an active M&A pipeline, and other related topics. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders throughout the Company to support the successful execution of key initiatives within the Finance organization. This role will report to the Director, Technical Accounting, who reports to the Sr. Director, Technical Accounting and M&A. The Sr. Director has responsibility for all technical accounting matters and leads Finance’s M&A process from diligence through integration. 

What you get to do in this role:

  • Monitor and assess new accounting pronouncements applicable to the Company; partner with stakeholders to analyze the impact and support implementation 

  • Key contributor throughout the M&A process, supporting pre-letter of intent review, financial diligence, purchase accounting, and valuation, as well as post-close accounting integration 

  • Develop and apply deep technical knowledge in areas such as business combinations, investment accounting, goodwill and intangible asset impairment testing, accounting for share-based compensation programs, revenue accounting matters (e.g., payments to a customer, gross versus net), and hedge accounting, amongst a variety of other complex accounting areas 

  • Draft and review SEC disclosures on relevant technical accounting topics 

  • Execute the quarterly and year-end close process for technical accounting matters, including preparation of journal entries, reconciliations, and SEC disclosure support 

  • Be a trusted business partner and advisor to various stakeholders within Accounting, Finance, Legal, Corporate Development, and other cross-functional teams 

  • Take initiative for process improvements to scale and optimize the technical accounting process, including the implementation of AI initiatives 

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of effective global accounting policies, processes, procedures, and internal controls 

  • Serve as a day-to-day technical accounting contact for external auditors, supporting resolution of complex accounting matters 

  • Support special projects and workflow process improvements 

  • Involvement in the SEC reporting process to help ensure the financial statements are in compliance with US GAAP 

Qualifications

  • Total experience of minimum 6 years, including Big Four public accounting experience and/or technical accounting experience at a public company 

  • BS/BA degree in Finance or Accounting and active CPA license is required 

  • Manager role in a Big Four public accounting firm and/or technical accounting role at a public company 

  • Positive, service-oriented attitude, highly motivated to learn and to make an impact within the organization 

  • Experience mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members; prior team leadership experience is a plus 

  • Strong technical accounting background with a knowledge of US GAAP, SEC reporting standards, and SOX 404, as well as experience performing technical research and preparing technical accounting memos 

  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills 

  • Relationship builder across all levels of the organization 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Corporate Development) on technical accounting positions without direct authority 

  • Strong organizational skills to manage numerous workstreams at once and complete work timely 

  • Self-starter and a great team member 

  • Proactive approach to identifying root causes and implementing durable solutions, including escalation when appropriate 

  • Ability to be flexible and work analytically in a dynamic environment 

  • Meticulous and superior attention to detail 

  • Strong Excel knowledge 

  • Familiarity with emerging AI tools for accounting automation is valued 

  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems is a plus

Job Description

What You Own: 

Performance Evaluation & Calibration: 

  • Own ServiceNow's performance evaluation framework, including rating definitions, behavioral expectations by level, and the standards that ensure assessments are consistent and meaningful. 
  • Define and maintain the philosophical underpinnings of how performance evaluation at ServiceNow, in alignment with the COE's design principles and broader performance management strategy. 
  • Partner with Compensation to ensure evaluation outcomes connect logically to rewards decisions. 
  • Strategically design to leverage AI to assist with relevant evaluation process components that improve consistency and reduce bias while ensuring human judgment remains at the center of every performance decision. 
  • Design and govern the calibration process, comprehensively supporting how managers and leaders should align on performance assessments across teams and business units.

  • Identify and address systemic calibration inconsistencies; partner with HRBPs to close gaps in how the process is applied across different parts of the business. 

How You Work: 

  • You work in a co-ownership model: COE defines the what and why; Product owns the how and when. You represent the business logic and employee / leader experience in every tech conversation. 
  • You bring a consulting mindset, diagnosing what senior leaders actually need, not just what they ask for. 
  • You strategically consider how AI capabilities can improve the evaluation processes at ServiceNow. 
  • You operate at a strategic level while remaining close enough to the work to catch execution gaps before they become problems. 
  • You are a strong cross-functional partner. The work you own touches nearly every HR function, and you build trust by seeing around corners, owning solutions, and rolling up your sleeves to help get work done.  

What Great Looks Like:

  • ServiceNow's evaluation framework reflects our recently updated performance philosophy and informs how HR leaders & business leaders talk about performance. The ‘why’ is crisp and clear. 
  • Calibration sessions produce consistent, defensible outcomes, and HRBPs report high confidence in the process. Leaders understand why it matters and where to invest their time and focus. 
  • DT understands why calibration matters and how they can evolve the evaluation tool to best support calibrated decision making and outcomes. 
  • Employees get critical insight into their performance throughout the year and after the performance cycle, understanding transparently how they did and how they are rewarded.

  • Deep expertise in performance evaluation and calibration, including rating frameworks, assessment standards, and approaches that support fair, consistent, and meaningful decisions
  • Proven experience translating performance philosophy and strategy into practical frameworks, processes, tools, and leader guidance
  • A strong consulting mindset and experience advising senior HR and business leaders on complex or sensitive talent decisions
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional work across HR, Compensation, HR Business Partners, Product, and technology teams

title: Sr. Manager, Solution Consulting (OT / Cyber-Physical Systems) (Armis/Veza)
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

ServiceNow began when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code to automate a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. Her reaction inspired a larger mission: free people from busywork so they can focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention, bringing together any AI, any data, and any workflow to help 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We are building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together, and we are just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Armis from ServiceNow protects the full attack surface and helps organizations manage cyber risk exposure in real time. Together with ServiceNow Security and Risk capabilities and Identity Security capabilities from Veza, Armis helps secure every asset and identity, including AI agents, across complex environments. The result is a foundation for autonomous defense for the Agentic Enterprise, grounded in security, operational, and business context. 

Job Description

As a Sr. Manager, Solution Consulting (Operational Technology and Cyber-Physical Systems, OT/CPS), you will lead a global team of Solution Consultants focused on ServiceNow's OT/CPS portfolio, including Armis OT visibility and security, Cyber Asset Security, and USEM for OT. This is a player-coach role: you will set the technical pre-sales strategy, develop a high-performing team, and personally engage in the most strategic customer opportunities. 

Success in this role means scaling ServiceNow's OT/CPS business by building a world-class solution consulting team, improving the quality and consistency of technical sales execution, and helping customers connect industrial operations, cyber risk, and business impact across complex environments. 

What you'll do... 

Team leadership and talent evaluation 

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a global team of OT Solution Consultants, providing coaching, feedback, and career development. 
  • Evaluate Solution Consultants against a consistent skills framework that measures OT and ICS technical depth, asset visibility and exposure management expertise, demo and storytelling craft, discovery quality, business value articulation, and AI fluency. 
  • Use those assessments to build individual development plans, identify coverage gaps, recommend staffing and role changes, and inform hiring, bench strength, and succession planning. 
  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Enablement, and Talent teams to calibrate expectations, recognize top performance, and address underperformance early. 
  • Set performance goals, track progress, and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture across the broader Solution Consulting community. 

AI-native leadership 

  • Model AI-native ways of working in account research, discovery preparation, demo and proof-of-value design, proposal support, pipeline inspection, and team coaching. 
  • Set clear expectations that every SC uses AI to improve the quality, speed, and consistency of their work, and measure adoption through practical indicators such as reusable assets created, preparation quality, demo effectiveness, and time saved. 
  • Build and share reusable AI assets, including prompts, agents, skills, demo scripts, and playbooks, that scale OT/CPS expertise across regions and verticals. 
  • Coach SCs to position the ServiceNow AI platform and agentic capabilities credibly with OT, security, and operations buyers, including AI governance and safety in industrial environments. 
  • Stay current on AI developments and bring practical improvements to how the team sells, demonstrates, and delivers value. 

Sales support and strategy 

  • Partner with Account Executives, Armis and Veza specialists, and OT sales leadership to qualify, shape, and win complex OT/CPS opportunities. 
  • Provide technical leadership through discovery, demonstrations, proofs of value, RFP responses, and executive presentations. 
  • Develop deep expertise in the OT/CPS portfolio and explain how it connects to ServiceNow ITOM, Security and Risk, workflow capabilities, and Armis OT visibility and security in customer-specific use cases. 
  • Help define go-to-market plays, vertical strategies (energy and utilities, manufacturing, life sciences, oil and gas, transportation), and sales collateral. 

Customer engagement 

  • Engage directly with CISOs, OT security leaders, plant and operations leaders, and architects to understand technical requirements, operational constraints, regulatory pressures, and the business outcomes customers need to achieve. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor on OT security, compliance, and risk reduction, including frameworks such as NIS2, NERC CIP, IEC 62443, and CIRCIA. 
  • Conduct customer site visits, workshops, and executive briefings, and deliver demonstrations and proofs of value that connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational resilience, and measurable business impact. 

Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Provide structured field feedback to Product Management on features, competitive gaps, and market demand. 
  • Work with Marketing and Enablement to develop technical content, case studies, and field-ready tools. 
  • Coordinate with Services, Partners, and Customer Success for a smooth transition from sale to implementation. 

Continuous improvement 

  • Track the OT security competitive landscape and emerging industrial technologies. 
  • Identify process improvements and best practices to scale the Solution Consulting function. 
  • Report on team performance, coverage, and AI adoption to senior leadership. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • A bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent work experience. 
  • Proven experience in solution consulting, sales engineering, or technical sales, preferably in cybersecurity, OT/ICS security, or industrial technology. 
  • Experience managing and developing technical pre-sales teams, including assessing talent, setting standards, and coaching to improve. 
  • Deep knowledge of OT/ICS environments, protocols, and architectures, including the Purdue model and segmentation, as well as OT security and asset visibility. 
  • Familiarity with OT regulatory and standards frameworks (NIS2, NERC CIP, IEC 62443, CIRCIA, etc.). 
  • A demonstrated AI-native mindset: hands-on use of generative and agentic AI in your own work, and a track record of driving AI adoption on a team. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences. 
  • A strong customer focus and the ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders. 
  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to drive decisions. 
  • A proactive, self-driven approach in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Armis from ServiceNow protects the full attack surface and helps organizations manage cyber risk exposure in real time. Together with ServiceNow Security and Risk capabilities and Identity Security capabilities from Veza, Armis helps secure every asset and identity, including AI agents, across complex environments. The result is a foundation for autonomous defense for the Agentic Enterprise, grounded in security, operational, and business context. 

Job Description

As a Sr. Manager, Solution Consulting (Operational Technology and Cyber-Physical Systems, OT/CPS), you will lead a global team of Solution Consultants focused on ServiceNow's OT/CPS portfolio, including Armis OT visibility and security, Cyber Asset Security, and USEM for OT. This is a player-coach role: you will set the technical pre-sales strategy, develop a high-performing team, and personally engage in the most strategic customer opportunities. 

Success in this role means scaling ServiceNow's OT/CPS business by building a world-class solution consulting team, improving the quality and consistency of technical sales execution, and helping customers connect industrial operations, cyber risk, and business impact across complex environments. 

What you'll do... 

Team leadership and talent evaluation 

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a global team of OT Solution Consultants, providing coaching, feedback, and career development. 
  • Evaluate Solution Consultants against a consistent skills framework that measures OT and ICS technical depth, asset visibility and exposure management expertise, demo and storytelling craft, discovery quality, business value articulation, and AI fluency. 
  • Use those assessments to build individual development plans, identify coverage gaps, recommend staffing and role changes, and inform hiring, bench strength, and succession planning. 
  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Enablement, and Talent teams to calibrate expectations, recognize top performance, and address underperformance early. 
  • Set performance goals, track progress, and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture across the broader Solution Consulting community. 

AI-native leadership 

  • Model AI-native ways of working in account research, discovery preparation, demo and proof-of-value design, proposal support, pipeline inspection, and team coaching. 
  • Set clear expectations that every SC uses AI to improve the quality, speed, and consistency of their work, and measure adoption through practical indicators such as reusable assets created, preparation quality, demo effectiveness, and time saved. 
  • Build and share reusable AI assets, including prompts, agents, skills, demo scripts, and playbooks, that scale OT/CPS expertise across regions and verticals. 
  • Coach SCs to position the ServiceNow AI platform and agentic capabilities credibly with OT, security, and operations buyers, including AI governance and safety in industrial environments. 
  • Stay current on AI developments and bring practical improvements to how the team sells, demonstrates, and delivers value. 

Sales support and strategy 

  • Partner with Account Executives, Armis and Veza specialists, and OT sales leadership to qualify, shape, and win complex OT/CPS opportunities. 
  • Provide technical leadership through discovery, demonstrations, proofs of value, RFP responses, and executive presentations. 
  • Develop deep expertise in the OT/CPS portfolio and explain how it connects to ServiceNow ITOM, Security and Risk, workflow capabilities, and Armis OT visibility and security in customer-specific use cases. 
  • Help define go-to-market plays, vertical strategies (energy and utilities, manufacturing, life sciences, oil and gas, transportation), and sales collateral. 

Customer engagement 

  • Engage directly with CISOs, OT security leaders, plant and operations leaders, and architects to understand technical requirements, operational constraints, regulatory pressures, and the business outcomes customers need to achieve. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor on OT security, compliance, and risk reduction, including frameworks such as NIS2, NERC CIP, IEC 62443, and CIRCIA. 
  • Conduct customer site visits, workshops, and executive briefings, and deliver demonstrations and proofs of value that connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational resilience, and measurable business impact. 

Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Provide structured field feedback to Product Management on features, competitive gaps, and market demand. 
  • Work with Marketing and Enablement to develop technical content, case studies, and field-ready tools. 
  • Coordinate with Services, Partners, and Customer Success for a smooth transition from sale to implementation. 

Continuous improvement 

  • Track the OT security competitive landscape and emerging industrial technologies. 
  • Identify process improvements and best practices to scale the Solution Consulting function. 
  • Report on team performance, coverage, and AI adoption to senior leadership. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • A bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent work experience. 
  • Proven experience in solution consulting, sales engineering, or technical sales, preferably in cybersecurity, OT/ICS security, or industrial technology. 
  • Experience managing and developing technical pre-sales teams, including assessing talent, setting standards, and coaching to improve. 
  • Deep knowledge of OT/ICS environments, protocols, and architectures, including the Purdue model and segmentation, as well as OT security and asset visibility. 
  • Familiarity with OT regulatory and standards frameworks (NIS2, NERC CIP, IEC 62443, CIRCIA, etc.). 
  • A demonstrated AI-native mindset: hands-on use of generative and agentic AI in your own work, and a track record of driving AI adoption on a team. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences. 
  • A strong customer focus and the ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders. 
  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to drive decisions. 
  • A proactive, self-driven approach in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time on average. 

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay range of $175,000-$210,000, plus equity when applicable, variable or incentive compensation, and benefits. Sales positions generally include a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. The base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. Benefits include health plans, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan, and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location of the role and may change based on work location.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

External Partner Relationship & Strategic Alignment

  • Serve as the primary Pre-Buy contact for ServiceNow's largest GSI — trusted by partner operations leads, finance teams, and executive stakeholders as the go-to for deal structure, exceptions, and escalations
  • Own the weekly operating cadence: burndown reviews, pipeline calls, and exception handling across all GEOs with full partner visibility into inventory, deal status, and quarter-end risk
  • Balance partner advocacy with internal compliance — protecting partnership health while ensuring Pre-Buy motions meet revenue recognition, compensation, and policy requirements

Pre-Buy Program Management & GTM Execution

  • Own end-to-end Pre-Buy execution working cross functionally as a project management removing barriers and providing escalation points: Reviewer (not owner) of inventory tracking, burndown processing, OPTY validation, add-backs, swaps, and leftover reconciliation across both active contracts
  • Produce weekly reporting for executive readouts — PPC burndown by GEO and forecast stage (Commit / Expect / Upside / Pre-Pipeline), closed transactions, and remaining inventory with bridge normalization
  • Proactively identify slow-burn patterns, stranded inventory, and expiration risks; surface to leadership with context and recommended action before they escalate

Sales Strategy & Channel Enablement

  • Partner with GPLs GPS, and GPMs to identify pipeline opportunities that can be accelerated through the Pre-Buy motion — operating as a strategic sales partner, not a processor
  • Own field enablement with sales and the partner: playbooks, burndown SOPs, and partner-facing reference materials that reduce recurring questions and speed deal execution
  • Serve as the first escalation point for field issues — mis-bookings, policy gray areas, comp disputes — resolving or packaging for leadership with a clear recommendation

Cross-Functional Orchestration & Governance

  • Coordinate across Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Comp to drive clean approvals and maintain a single source of truth for all Pre-Buy and LOI decisions
  • Own LOI governance: interpret contract language, translate into booking and comp guidance, and prevent LOI actions from triggering unintended downsell or GRR distortion
  • Prepare executive-ready materials — business cases, risk flags, approval tracking, and QBR packages — for the PreBuy Committee and senior leadership

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Channel Sales, Partner Operations, GTM Operations, or Sales Strategy in global enterprise SaaS
  • Direct experience working with or within a large GSI or strategic channel partner — understands how GSIs structure deals, allocate budgets, and consume licenses
  • Strong program management discipline: runs multi-stakeholder programs with clear milestones and exec visibility without hand-holding
  • Self-starter with a track record of stepping into ambiguity, diagnosing what's broken, and building durable process independently
  • Experience owning channel sales motions: deal intake, pipeline forecasting, compensation treatment, and partner-facing reporting cadences
  • Comfort with enterprise SaaS deal mechanics: NNACV/ACV, GRR/NRR, revenue bridge normalization, and crediting models
  • Ability to influence across Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Comp without direct authority
  • Operates with calm urgency in high-stakes, quarter-end environments with competing priorities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with prepaid, or inventory-based GTM models; familiarity with burndown accounting and OPTY reconciliation mechanics
  • Prior experience supporting a large GSI relationship (Cognizant, Infosys,) at global scale
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Power BI, and advanced Excel for operational reporting
  • Familiarity with LOI structures, deal governance, and revenue bridge accounting
  • Experience managing GEO-distributed programs across EMEA, AMS, and APAC

Job Description

The Role

Are you up for an exciting challenge? Picture yourself scaling and optimizing a cutting-edge Generative AI product that offers instant assistance to enterprise users. Ever wondered how to apply abstraction, scalability, and optimization to a dynamic, probabilistic, and generative conversational system? If so, we invite you to join our Conversation Engine team. At our company, you'll have the unique opportunity to work at the core of Moveworks Generative AI product. Your main focus will be scaling and optimizing it to meet the growing demands of the enterprise solution space. Take a look at our recent posts (Moveworks Live, Creator Studio) on Moveworks’s groundbreaking solutions for enterprise AI. As pioneers in enterprise AI, we don't follow a set formula for building the next solution. Instead, we encourage you to bring your innovative ideas and imagination to solve unsolved problems. You'll collaborate closely with machine learning experts and cross-functional teams, rapidly iterating over new ideas, and leveraging user behavior data to make informed decisions. Your challenge will be to scale and optimize our conversation engine to support hundreds of millions of users, across multiple chat channels and use cases, and enhance our end-to-end product infrastructure with the utmost engineering quality and robustness.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Construct an extensive product infrastructure, complete with user-friendly interfaces that empower engineers and configurators to effortlessly customize and optimize generative AI models. This includes collecting data and feedback, adapting to diverse enterprise use cases and business contexts, and delivering domain-specific conversational experiences.
  • Design scalable API abstractions for our conversation platform, which supports all popular chat clients (for example, MSTeams, Slack, and Web) and offers a neutral API for developing other parts of the engineering system.
  • Optimize the dialog engine to accommodate a wide range of conversational features, leveraging private domain knowledge unique to each enterprise customer in the cloud, and enable real-time multilingual translation. You will achieve this with minimal memory footprint, low latency, and streamlined development process for application engineers.
  • Champion the best practices for coding patterns, API design, scalability, robustness, and optimization. Foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvements among fellow engineers.
  • Provide comprehensive insights and visibility into the performance of our conversational AI product. This involves implementing a robust logging and tracing framework, user-friendly debugging and triaging tools, and automated metrics for efficient monitoring and analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with ML engineers, application engineers, product teams, and customer support teams to drive the development of new features and scalability initiatives.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • A strong foundation in computer science and software engineering, coupled with expertise in building scalable systems.
  • A deep understanding of clean, modular, and scalable API design. You have the ability to champion best coding practices and influence fellow engineers to uphold high standards of code quality and craftsmanship.
  • A passion for optimizing systems and improving performance. You are well-versed in tracing, logging, and metrics frameworks, and possess a systematic approach to quickly identify and resolve latency bottlenecks, race conditions, and throughput limitations.
  • The ability to independently research new requirements and develop innovative solutions. You thrive in an environment of fast-paced coding and execution, embracing rapid iterations to deliver results.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively articulate rationales and design approaches. You have a cross-functional awareness that enables you to collaborate seamlessly with various teams.
  • A bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a related field, demonstrating your academic foundation in the field.
  • 5+ years of professional development experience, specifically in building systems at scale.

Qualifications

  • 7+ or more years of experience in network engineering, architecture, support, or design 

  • 5 or more years of experience in service delivery or technical account management in post-sales or pre-sales environments 

  • 3 or more years of experience in IT, security, healthcare technology, or similar environments 

  • Familiarity with network protocols across OT/ICS, biomedical, or traditional IT infrastructures 

  • Experience managing a broad portfolio of accounts with minimal oversight, and sound judgment about where your time creates the most value 

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in daily work, and the ability to learn new technology quickly

  • A track record of identifying risk early and driving it to resolution, including accounts where the path forward was not obvious

Bonus points

Job Description

Sr. Manager, Customer Success – Healthcare Cybersecurity

About the Role

The Sr. Manager of Customer Success leads Armis's healthcare customer success portfolio, serving as the strategic bridge between technical teams and healthcare stakeholders (clinical IT, biomedical engineering, compliance, security operations). You'll own portfolio performance across hospital systems and healthcare enterprises, mentor Technical CSMs supporting complex medical device and clinical network environments, and ensure consistent execution of strategies that drive adoption of OT/IT security across hospitals, labs, imaging centers, and clinical workflows. You'll translate healthcare compliance and operational realities into scalable success frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own regional ARR planning and attainment for healthcare accounts. Align resources to customer segmentation maturity levels, clinical network complexity, and regulatory timelines; run cadence reviews and intervene early on retention risks tied to medical device visibility or compliance gaps.
  • Standardize healthcare-specific EBR narratives around clinical network security outcomes (segmentation velocity, device inventory completeness, incident response readiness) and risk metrics. Partner with customers on FDA cybersecurity compliance storytelling and HIPAA/HITECH audit readiness.
  • Establish and enforce portfolio-level healthcare risk playbooks. Chair recurring risk reviews focused on critical device vulnerabilities, unmanaged endpoint exposure, and segmentation gaps; coordinate cross-functional mitigations with biomedical, IT, and security teams.
  • Operationalize healthcare network design reviews and security standards across the portfolio. Define best practices for DICOM/HL7 protocol visibility, clinical VLAN segmentation, NAC enforcement, and medical device inventory governance. Scale reusable patterns that accelerate time-to-value for multi-site hospital systems.
  • Run regional Voice of Customer cadences focused on healthcare-specific use cases. Aggregate clinical IT and biomedical requests into prioritized asks (e.g., remote maintenance security, OT/IT convergence visibility, wireless medical device monitoring); coordinate beta engagements and close feedback loops with Product and clinical advisory boards.
  • Establish enablement agenda for the healthcare team. Build proficiency baselines on medical device types (imaging, monitoring, therapeutic, lab), clinical communication protocols (HL7, DICOM, IEEE 11073, BACnet, Modbus), healthcare compliance frameworks (IEC 80001, NIST CSF for Healthcare, HIPAA Security Rule), and ensure expert coverage for complex architectures and incident response scenarios.
  • Own healthcare onboarding standards and playbooks. Define discovery workflows for multi-facility deployments, clinical network assessments, and medical device inventory projects. Measure adoption of best practices across segmentation, patching, and incident coordination.
  • Scale healthcare vertical frameworks. Tailor strategies for different customer profiles (academic medical centers vs. community hospitals vs. integrated delivery networks) and regulatory contexts (FDA premarket requirements, state healthcare data breach laws, CMS security standards).
  • Drive customer-to-product feedback loops. Maintain relationships with healthcare advisory boards and clinical IT leaders; advocate for product enhancements around medical device discovery, clinical protocol monitoring, and healthcare-specific compliance reporting.
  • Model ethical decision-making on healthcare security trade-offs (balancing security hardening against clinical operational continuity). Hold team accountable to balanced customer outcomes and organizational targets.
  • Cultivate a learning culture. Run retros on customer implementations, institutionalize playbooks for common healthcare scenarios (device compromise, network anomalies, remote access hardening), and build skills roadmaps for Technical CSMs working in healthcare environments.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Consulting within B2B SaaS or enterprise cybersecurity, with 5+ years focused on healthcare IT, medical device security, or clinical network environments.
  • Proven track record managing technical portfolios and leading teams in healthcare cybersecurity, OT/IT convergence, or medical device security.
  • Deep understanding of healthcare network infrastructure (clinical VLANs, medical device protocols, segmentation, remote access for biomedical vendors).
  • Demonstrated fluency with healthcare communication protocols (DICOM, HL7/FHIR, IEEE 11073, BACnet, Modbus) and ability to translate protocol security implications to clinical stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare compliance frameworks (HIPAA, HITECH, FDA cybersecurity premarket/postmarket guidance, IEC 80001, NIST CSF for Healthcare).
  • Exceptional ability to manage relationships across technical and clinical stakeholders (biomedical engineers, clinical IT directors, compliance officers, hospital security teams).
  • Track record of managing large, complex healthcare customer implementations (multi-site systems, high-touch deployments, regulatory audits).
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Healthcare IT, Biomedical Engineering, or related discipline (required); advanced degree or equivalent healthcare security experience preferred.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience with healthcare-specific cybersecurity or visibility platforms (Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, or similar OT/medical device security solutions).
  • Experience working with biomedical engineering teams or clinical IT leadership on device security and network architecture projects.
  • Familiarity with healthcare incident response workflows and coordination across clinical, IT, and security operations teams.
  • Knowledge of hospital architecture standards (e.g., AAMI TIR57 guidelines for clinical IT security).
  • Strategic systems thinker who excels at translating clinical and compliance complexity into scalable operational frameworks.
  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to present security concepts to non-technical clinical leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Data-driven decision-maker with strong portfolio analytics and KPI design experience.
  • Empathetic leader committed to developing Technical CSMs and building team capability in healthcare-specific domains.

**This role requires in-office presence in Mountain View, CA 5x/week**

About the Team

The Developer Experience team builds platforms that enable developers building on the Moveworks Agentic AI platform. We own the flywheel: more builders → more integrations shipped → better assistant → more demand. We build scalable infrastructure first, then the products on top of it. Platform engineering discipline meets developer-facing product thinking.

The Role 

You own the technical foundation the team ships on. You design and build the hardest platform problems — generality, scalability, extensibility — while keeping developer experience as the measure. You think in systems. You ship. You bring others along.

What You'll Do 

  • Design and build core developer platforms: SDKs, APIs, runtime abstractions, tooling infrastructure, developer-facing services
  • Own end-to-end delivery of products that increase developer productivity: faster time-to-market, higher-quality artifacts, lower friction
  • Define platform primitives other products build on — bias toward generality, reliability, clean abstractions
  • Drive measurable supply metrics: developer activation, integration velocity, artifact quality, ecosystem breadth
  • Lead technical strategy for your platform areas: roadmap, API design, cross-team alignment
  • Set the engineering bar: architecture, design standards, observability, operational excellence
  • Mentor senior engineers; raise the team's technical depth

What We Look For at Senior Staff Level

You're a multiplier. You trace developer pain to platform gaps, design general solutions, ship them in ways that unlock categories of use cases. You raise the abstraction level of everything you touch. You shape product decisions from the technical side. Your mentees have gone on to senior roles or owned critical systems.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12+ years designing, building, operating production systems; significant platform or infrastructure team experience
  • Experience leading design and multi-year operation of developer platforms that reached 100+ external teams; can point to instances where the platform unlocked new use cases or accelerated velocity by order of magnitude
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems: reliability, API design, performance, fault tolerance, observability
  • Strong systems engineer with fluency in production microservices environments at scale
  • Built general-purpose platforms other engineers depend on; understand what makes an abstraction good vs. leaky
  • End-to-end ownership: you design, code, debug in production, iterate based on real feedback — not handing off at the design doc
  • Navigate tradeoffs with incomplete data: know when to generalize vs. specialize, when to build vs. integrate, when to move fast vs. lock in design
  • Understand developer activation funnels and feedback loops that turn builders into core contributors

Nice to Have: 

  • Familiarity with LLM-based architectures or agent orchestration patterns
  • Experience with enterprise developer environments: auth, sandboxing, compliance, multi-tenancy constraints

担当アカウントおよび/またはテリトリーにおける四半期・年間の売上目標の達成に向けて、以下の業務を担当いただきます。 

  • 担当テリトリーにおける営業戦略の策定(ターゲット企業リストの作成、営業計画の立案を含む) 
  • 経営層・CxOとのエグエグゼクティブミーティングの設定・実施。ソリューションコンサルタントおよび関連チームと緊密に連携し、ServiceNowのCRMソリューションを示すデモンストレーションを提供

  • 担当アカウントエグゼクティブおよびソリューションコンサルタントと協力し、CRM ソリューションの提案を、見込み顧客、既存のお客様、パートナー、業界イベントやセミナーで直接実施
  • 担当テリトリーのServiceNowパートナーチャネルを支援し、お客様にとって最適な体験を実現 
  • カスタマーサクセスのための戦略を顧客担当チームに共有し、プラットフォームのプレゼンテーションやバリュープロポジションの標準化・効率化を推進

  • 業務プロセス、意思決定、課題解決にAIをどのように組み込めるかを実践的または批判的に考え、取り組んだ経験(AIツールの活用、ワークフローの自動化、AIによるインサイトの分析、自社の職種や業界へのAIの影響の探求など)

title: Staff Software Engineer_Voice Connectivity
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Job Description

Overview

The Staff Software Engineer, Voice Connectivity Engineering designs, builds, ships, and operates the connectivity layer between a customer's existing telephony and CCaaS environment and the ServiceNow Voice ecosystem. The engineer works across the full lifecycle: mapping a customer's SIP trunks, CTI integrations, and CCaaS-specific APIs, building and hardening the signaling, media, and event integrations that connect those systems to ServiceNow's Voice/CTI and Native Voice Controls platform, and proving through testing and production monitoring that calls connect, stay connected, and hand off cleanly under real network and carrier conditions. This is not an agent-building role — the engineer is not primarily authoring the prompts or instructions that drive voice AI agent behavior — but it is the foundation those agents run on: without a reliable connectivity layer, no agent, however well designed, can reach a live caller.

Two things follow. First, correctness here is measured in call setup success, audio quality, latency, and failover behavior rather than model output — the engineer's product is a connection that has to hold up under real carrier, network, and vendor conditions, not just in a reference environment. Second, because every customer's telephony and CCaaS setup differs — different SIP providers, media gateways, authentication schemes, and CCaaS vendor quirks — the engineer must design integrations that are resilient and diagnosable, with clear failure signals when a segment of the call path breaks, rather than integrations that only work against the reference stack.

  What You Get to Do

  • Build the connectivity layer. Design, build, and operate the SIP trunking, signaling, and media integrations that connect a customer's telephony and CCaaS platform to ServiceNow's Voice/CTI and Native Voice Controls ecosystem.
  • Integrate with CCaaS and telephony platforms. Implement and harden integrations using the common patterns of SIP trunking and signaling, WebSocket and streaming media APIs, and real-time audio and event interfaces — across CCaaS providers such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Twilio, as well as traditional CTI/PBX and carrier setups.
  • Own call path reliability. Design for call setup success, failover, and graceful degradation across carriers, media gateways, and network conditions; instrument and monitor the connectivity layer for latency, jitter, packet loss, and dropped-call causes.
  • Deliver as a forward deployed engineer, embedded in the customer's environment. Work directly inside a customer's telephony, CTI, and CCaaS environment — mapping their existing architecture, standing up and tuning the connection into ServiceNow's Voice ecosystem, and troubleshooting live issues on their network and vendor stack.
  • Feed the Voice AI agent layer cleanly. Ensure the audio, signaling, and event streams the connectivity layer delivers are clean, well-formed, and low-latency enough for the voice AI agents running on ServiceNow's Voice ecosystem to operate correctly — partnering with agent engineering rather than building the agents yourself.
  • Design for security and compliance on the call path. Implement SIP security, media encryption, authentication, and least-privilege access across the connectivity layer, and account for what regulated or high-security customer environments require.
  • Specify precisely and direct engineering work. Convert customer telephony and CCaaS requirements into testable specifications and integration runbooks with explicit scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into implementable tasks and review the result for correctness and maintainability.
  • Own quality and reliability in production. Monitor connectivity health across live customer deployments, triage call-path incidents, and feed recurring failure patterns back into architecture and runbooks.
  • Collaborate across product, design, and engineering. Partner with product managers, voice AI agent engineers, and platform teams — Voice/CTI, CCaaS, and Native Voice Controls — to define integration requirements, align on tradeoffs, and communicate capability and risk clearly.

Qualifications

To Be Successful in This Role

Experience

A demonstrated track record of building, shipping, and operating production telephony or CCaaS integrations at a Staff Software Engineer level, including hands-on delivery of connectivity between third-party telephony/CCaaS platforms and a hosted or cloud service. Direct, hands-on experience integrating with CCaaS platforms using common patterns — SIP trunking and signaling, WebSocket and streaming media APIs, and real-time audio interfaces — across multiple CCaaS providers, is required. Demonstrated technical leadership is expected at this level: setting architectural direction across teams, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-team integration decisions on voice and telephony systems. Willingness to work directly with customers in a forward deployed capacity, embedded in their telephony and contact center environment, is required; prior forward deployed experience is an advantage. Typically 8+ years of production software experience, with several years focused on telephony, CTI, or real-time communications systems.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus but are not a substitute for a demonstrated record of shipping reliable, production voice and telephony connectivity.

Key Competencies, Skills, and Experience

  • Software engineering fundamentals. Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing.
  • CCaaS and telephony integration patterns. Hands-on experience integrating with CCaaS platforms and telephony infrastructure using SIP trunking and signaling, WebSocket and streaming media APIs, and real-time audio interfaces, across multiple providers such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Twilio, as well as traditional CTI/PBX systems.
  • Real-time communications and media handling. Practical knowledge of SIP, RTP/SRTP, WebRTC, codecs, media gateways, and the latency, jitter, and packet-loss characteristics of live audio.
  • Call path reliability and observability. Ability to design for failover and graceful degradation across carriers and vendors, and to instrument, monitor, and diagnose connectivity issues in production.
  • Voice platform architecture. Working knowledge of how a hosted voice and agent ecosystem — such as ServiceNow's Voice/CTI and Native Voice Controls — consumes audio, signaling, and event streams, enough to design an integration the platform can reliably use without building the agent logic itself.
  • Specification precision and architectural judgment. Ability to define integration and connectivity problems rigorously enough for another engineer to implement correctly, and sound judgment on build-versus-integrate tradeoffs across vendor ecosystems.
  • Safety, security, and data handling. Working knowledge of risks specific to telephony integrations — SIP security, media encryption, call-recording and PII handling, over-broad access — translated into concrete guardrails and monitoring.
  • Forward deployed delivery and stakeholder communication. Comfort working directly with customers inside their telephony environment under incomplete information and fixed timelines, and credibility communicating capability, limitation, and risk to non-engineers.

Desired Experience

  • Forward deployed or customer-embedded delivery. Prior work as a forward deployed engineer, solution engineer, or in professional services, delivering software inside a customer's environment.
  • Carrier and infrastructure depth. Experience with SIP trunk provisioning, PSTN/carrier relationships, number porting, and codec-level audio handling below the application layer.
  • CCaaS platform specialization. Deep, hands-on experience with one or more major CCaaS platforms — such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, or Amazon Connect — beyond generic integration patterns.
  • Observability tooling. Experience with tracing, monitoring, and analysis tooling for real-time communications systems, and analysis of production call and connectivity data at scale.
  • Enterprise domain depth. Customer service, contact center operations, or enterprise IT/telephony operations, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it.
  • Years of Experience. At least 8 years of experience in software engineering with at least 2 years of experience in deploying contemporary AI solutions at customers.

Job Description

We are the Industry Vertical Engineering team at ServiceNow. We design and build specialized software solutions tailored to the unique workflows, data models, and regulatory compliance needs of specific sectors, with a particular focus on high-tech and adjacent regulated industries such as telecommunications, healthcare, financial services, and manufacturing, rather than relying on generic, one-size-fits-all solutions. 

We are building the next generation of industry-specific enterprise applications, and increasingly these applications are AI-native: their core behavior is model-driven rather than explicitly authored. They interpret user intent, reason over context, invoke tools, and act on the user's behalf, all while respecting the complex business workflows, specialized data models, and evolving regulatory requirements of the industries we serve. 

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will design, build, ship, and operate AI-native industry applications whose most important logic often lives in natural language (instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, and guardrails) as much as in code. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, and often embedded directly with customers as a forward deployed engineer, building against their data, integrations, and channels. Alongside hands-on delivery, you will drive engineering excellence, mentor other engineers, and influence architecture and long-term platform direction across multiple teams. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Design, build, and deliver scalable, AI-native enterprise applications for industry-specific workflows, data models, and compliance requirements, along with the integrations and channels that make them usable in production. 

  • Build agentic behavior into those applications: intent interpretation, multi-step reasoning, tool and function invocation, and action on the user's behalf, delivered through conversational experiences across chat (and voice where the use case calls for it) that hold context and hand off cleanly between automated and human agents. 

  • Design AI-driven autonomous workflows: decompose business processes into the steps and decision points an agent can execute, decide where autonomy is appropriate and where a human checkpoint is required, and define how exceptions, retries, and hand-back to a person are handled. 

  • Author and maintain agentic instructions (system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation rules) as versioned engineering artifacts under review and regression coverage, not configuration text. 

  • Engineer prompts for reliability rather than demo quality, iterating against measured outcomes: task decomposition, golden examples, structured output schemas, grounding and citation, graceful failure, and token and latency cost. 

  • Build automated evaluation and test non-deterministic behavior: golden datasets, multi-turn conversation suites, model-as-judge scoring calibrated to human review, CI gates, drift detection, and adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool-selection testing. 

  • Design software that lets customers configure and extend platform capabilities without sacrificing performance, reliability, or maintainability, and write clean, reusable, well-tested code following engineering best practices, including code reviews, unit testing, and test automation. 

  • Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents: convert requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, decompose work into agent-sized tasks, and review agent output for correctness and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it. 

  • Deliver as a forward deployed engineer, embedded with customers when the work calls for it: building against their data, integrations, and channels, tuning instructions and evaluation sets in their environment, and returning with evidence that improves the product. 

  • Own quality, safety, and reliability in production: monitor conversation quality, containment, hallucination, and unsafe actions, defend against prompt injection and data leakage, and feed production failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Troubleshoot and optimize performance, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems. 

  • Serve as a technical leader: mentor engineers, promote knowledge sharing, drive engineering best practices, and lead complex technical initiatives spanning multiple teams while influencing architecture and long-term platform direction. 

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions, align on tradeoffs, and communicate capability, limitation, and risk clearly to non-engineers

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience in the SaaS industry, building and operating products at production scale. 
  • A demonstrated track record of building, shipping, and operating production software, including hands-on delivery of AI-native application features that real users depend on rather than demos. 
  • Direct, hands-on experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing AI-driven autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation and testing that verifies non-deterministic behavior. 
  • Advanced command of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, system design, APIs, and performance optimization. 
  • Strong grounding in modern application architecture across cloud, distributed systems, and service-oriented or platform technologies, with solid data modeling and storage fundamentals. Depth matters more than any specific language or framework. 
  • AI-native application development: agent orchestration at the application layer, tool and function calling, context assembly, grounding against enterprise data, and handling latency, cost, and failure. 
  • Prompt engineering and evaluation of non-deterministic systems: intent-driven prompt design plus measurable frameworks for response quality, agent behavior, tool-selection accuracy, and regression risk, iterating against evaluation results rather than impressions. 
  • Specification precision and architectural judgment: the ability to define problems rigorously enough that another engineer or an AI agent implements them correctly, and to decide soundly when to solve a problem in code, in instructions, or by delegating to an agent. 
  • Working knowledge of safety, security, and data handling for AI-integrated applications: prompt injection, sensitive-data and secret leakage, over-broad tool access, and unsafe autonomous action, translated into concrete guardrails, least-privilege controls, and monitoring. 
  • Willingness to work directly with customers in a forward deployed capacity, with the judgment to know when a fast local solution is right and when to hold out for the durable one, and the credibility to communicate capability, limitation, and risk to non-engineers. 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technically complex projects across multiple teams as a technical owner or engineering leader, with strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. 
  • Experience integrating AI into engineering workflows, decision-making, automation, or the software development process itself. 
  • Preferred qualifications: 
  • ServiceNow platform experience is recommended, including building configurable, extensible applications on the platform. 
  • Deep domain experience in high-tech, and familiarity with adjacent regulated industries such as telecommunications, healthcare, financial services, or manufacturing, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. 
  • Experience delivering conversational experiences in chat, voice, or both, including turn and context management, disambiguation and confirmation patterns, and automated-to-human handoff. 
  • Prior forward deployed, solution engineering, or professional services experience delivering software inside a customer's environment. 
  • Familiarity with modern UI frameworks (for example React, Angular, or Vue) and with evaluation, tracing, and prompt or instruction management tooling for LLM applications. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 10+ years of experience with Java or a similar OO language

  • Advanced knowledge with data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations

Position Location:
This is a Flexible (Hybrid) position.  Flexible positions require 2 days per week in a ServiceNow office location.  We have offices in several locations, including San Francisco, CA; Pleasanton, CA; Santa Clara, CA; San Diego, CA

Please Note:  This position will include supporting our US Regulated Markets.
“This position requires passing a ServiceNow background screening, USFedPASS (US Federal Personnel Authorization Screening Standards). This includes a credit check, criminal/misdemeanor check and taking a drug test. Any employment is contingent upon passing the screening.  Due to Federal requirements, only US citizens, US naturalized citizens or US Permanent Residents, holding a green card, will be considered.

Team Overview

The Data Platform group builds highly scalable, high‑performance platform capabilities for data‑in‑motion and backend storage systems. Our customers operate at massive scale, pushing the boundaries of data volume, throughput, and concurrency. We are looking for a seasoned IC5 Senior Staff Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems and Data Lake architectures to drive next‑generation platform innovation.

Role Summary

As an IC5 Senior Staff Engineer, you will architect and deliver large‑scale distributed platform components, lead complex technical initiatives, and define engineering best practices. You will bring strong leadership, hands-on engineering depth, and the ability to design and operate reliable, scalable, and high‑performance data systems.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Architect, design, and build high‑performance distributed systems and platform components.
  • Build distributed systems data ingestion solutions with strong emphasis on scalability, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Deliver high‑quality, clean, modular, and reusable code while enforcing engineering best practices (code reviews, unit testing, automation, design reviews).
  • Build foundational libraries, frameworks, and tools focused on modularity, extensibility, configurability, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver end‑to‑end solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for projects with significant complexity and risk.
  • Research, evaluate, and adopt new technologies that enhance platform capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose complex production issues across distributed systems.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering work — whether using AI-powered coding and operational tooling, automating workflows, or reasoning about how AI changes the way software and infrastructure are built.
  • 12+ years of hands‑on engineering experience in distributed systems, data platforms, or large‑scale backend infrastructure with a Bachelor's degree; OR 8+ years with a Master's degree; OR 6+ years with a PhD OR equivalent work experience.

Core Engineering Expertise

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems architecture, design patterns, and algorithms.
  • Deep programming expertise in Java, including JVM internals, memory models, and garbage collection.
  • Proven experience in JVM performance tuning, profiling, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks.
  • Deep programming expertise and hands-on experience working with Helm (charts authoring, templating, managing overlay layering across environments)
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, networking, sockets, OS internals, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating large‑scale distributed systems.
  • Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
  • Security systems, methods and protocols.
     

Distributed Systems Expertise

  • Experience with large‑scale deployments of distributed systems.
  • Deep knowledge of replication, fault-tolerant, and HA strategies.
  • Experience working in DevOps environments to operationalize distributed platforms.
    • GitOps and release engineering for distributed k8s-native services.
  • Strong expertise in designing and architecting platforms using:
    • Kubernetes (workload deployments, upgrades, monitoring and maintenance).
    • Apache Iceberg (tables, catalogs, data encryption, schema evolution, metadata management).
    • Apache Kafka (high‑scale clusters, topic/partition strategies, HA).
    • Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, exactly‑once semantics).
    • Apache Spark (batch & streaming jobs, optimization, partitioning).
  • Expertise in data formats such as Parquet, ORC, and Avro, along with compaction and governance strategies.
  • Ability to build scalable, fault‑tolerant ingestion and transformation workflows.
  • Experience integrating Data Lakes with analytics engines, query services, or ML platforms.

Job Description

Team Bio: 

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. 

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise. 

Why This Role Matters:

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. 

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries. 

Who You Are:

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact. 

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points. 

You will: 

  • Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI 
  • Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments 
  • Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements 
  • Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams  

What You’ll Do: 

  • Deliver Production - readysolution in agile end-to-end sprints

What you'll do:

UX Architecture & Strategy — Define and own the long-term architecture for AI-native user experiences across the platform, making critical build-vs-buy decisions (design systems, agent-to-UI interaction patterns, real-time/streaming UX for AI-generated content) to ensure the experience layer stays resilient and coherent as the platform scales.

AI-Native Intelligent Experiences — Design and build user-facing surfaces where agentic backends - recommendations, autonomous triage, generated fixes/insights, multi-step agent reasoning - are exposed to end users through fast, trustworthy, low-friction interaction patterns. Own the hard UX problems unique to AI-native products: progressive disclosure of agent reasoning, graceful handling of uncertainty/latency, human-in-the-loop review flows, and making autonomous system behavior legible and controllable to end users rather than a black box.

UXC & Workspace Platform — Deep ownership of the UXC (User Experience/Workspace, UI16) surface — component architecture, design system consistency, and performance — as the primary canvas AI-native features are built on top of.

Agentic Pipeline Awareness — Partner closely with platform/ML teams building the agent orchestration and tool-calling infrastructure underneath (multi-agent dispatch, MCP-style tool integration, reasoning traceability) — translating what these backends can do into UX patterns that make them usable, safe, and trustworthy for real users.

Business Alignment — Align UX and technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, experience quality, and adoption of AI-native features directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market.

Hands-on Engineering — Write high-performance, clean, production-grade code primarily across the frontend/experience stack (Lit.js, React/TypeScript, design systems, component architecture), with working fluency in backend/platform code (Java, Python, Postgres, K8s) to collaborate effectively with platform teams.

Cross-functional Execution — Drive business-critical UX and platform outcomes in close collaboration with ML, backend platform, and product teams.

Engineering Culture — Mentor senior engineers, champion UX and engineering excellence, and foster a culture of rapid, impact-driven innovation in AI-native product development.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic/multi-agent systems from the consumer side — understands agent orchestration, tool-calling protocols (MCP or equivalent), and reasoning traceability well enough to design UX around them, even if platform-layer implementation sits with another team.

  • Experience integrating or critically evaluating AI tools/agentic workflows in product and engineering decision-making, particularly from a user-experience and trust/legibility angle.

title: Senior Technical Customer Success Manager (Veza)
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem  across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources  providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

Job Description

The  Senior Customer Success Manager is responsible for the end-to-end success of a defined portfolio of enterprise customers. This role carries direct accountability for customer outcomes, including executive alignment, realized business value, platform adoption, renewal readiness, and expansion identification.

Operating with extreme ownership, this role brings structure to complex environments, drives measurable results, and orchestrates internal resources without requiring direction.

We hire builders and owners–not coordinators.

This is a leadership-caliber individual contributor role, deployed against a limited number of accounts to enable deeper executive engagement and measurable customer outcomes.

Role Scope

Extreme Ownership of Customer Outcomes

  • Orchestrate the resources required to achieve customer outcomes.
  • Treat each customer as a business, balancing advocacy with commercial responsibility.

Executive Engagement

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with CIO, CISO, and senior stakeholders.

  • Lead integrated account planning across Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success.
  • Foster a one-team approach focused on long-term customer value rather than functional handoffs.

While execution is shared, accountability for customer outcomes remains clear.

  • Coordinate Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, and partner teams
  • Establish governance frameworks that drive accountability and transparency

locations: New York, New York, United States
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work.
