Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Head of Insurance Go to Market (GTM) AMS a deep expertise role that operates together with ServiceNow’s customer-centric industry transformation sales teams as well as core functions within the firm (i.e., marketing, product, customer success & implementation partners, etc.) to identify and localize ServiceNow Insurance and related solutions to the Financial Services market. S/he will closely align with our account teams for several strategic Financial Services clients (existing and potential) to seed and develop strategic opportunities based on the relevant industry solutions.

S/he will serve as the main point of contact for related pursuits within the global market connecting with more senior and C-suite stakeholders, taking our messaging, communications and experience to the next level with an industry-based lens in their language, and considering their challenges and needs.  The ideal candidate brings a very mature and experienced point of view, is visionary with the art of the possible, is fact-based and objective in his/her orientation and communication and serves as the key corporate Subject Matter Expert (SME) stakeholder.   

S/he will closely align with our core and solution account teams with a central focus on the Insurance sector (i.e., P&C Retail, Commercial, L&A and Brokerage) to seed, develop and help with closing strategic Insurance and related opportunities. S/he will utilize their existing broad and build where necessary, net new trusted relationships with customer and partner executives, partner with sales leaders, and be a highly impactful contributor to the revenue growth in our top Financial Services accounts globally.

This leader is ultimately responsible for 4 specific areas of responsibility, including:

  1. Customer Focused Pipeline Development – introducing and educating executives and senior leaders to ServiceNow through leadership and participation with customers at industry events, industry business reviews, etc.  Partnering with account executives and their teams to progress focused customer pipeline by infusing industry expertise (solution, messaging, etc.) into account strategy. Help establish the perception of ServiceNow in Insurance globally, addressing core insurance business challenges.
  2. Sales Oriented Pipeline Progression - Partnering with account executives and their teams to progress pipeline by infusing industry expertise (solution, messaging, etc.) into account strategy, forming relationships with key buying center executives, and helping shorten deal lifecycles by helping the team highlight the business value and competitive differentiators.
  3. Partner Development & Execution – leading priorities with select (top 3-4) partners to support in industry leadership positioning, enablement and customer development.  Focus should be an accelerant for customer focused pipeline priorities.
  4. Analyze, Drive & Report on The Business – analyzing the global insurance business to understand trends, opportunities, needs, KPI impact and movement against goals, and use that to feed/fuel customer efforts within this industry. Utilize data to influence / change behaviors to drive results and reinforce high-yield actions.  Close collaboration with our Product Teams to define the roadmap for future releases and capabilities to address the market.
  5. Industry Strategy & Team Leadership Development – developing integrated sector / geo strategy, including goals, growth focus & investments, M&A pursuits.  Partnering across the organization with key stakeholders (product, marketing, sales, enablement, etc.) to ensure strategies are aligned and jointly prioritized.  Managing and prioritizing time across top customer opportunities, partnering with product on the Insurance FSO and related solutions for future development and to where we make industry investments.  A key member of the Insurance Pod as we drive into Insurance being a strategic focus for ServiceNow.

S/he is expected to “roll up their sleeves” and based on their extensive experience is equally comfortable devising a multi-year strategy to penetrate the global market while also updating a tracker with the status of existing opportunities and key areas of pursuit.  S/he thrives in a high growth, fast-paced environment, and can maintain a ‘north star’ point of view despite managing the urgent requests of a given day. 

A typical day involves equal parts brainstorming on how to go to market more effectively; attending high-value marketing events operating as an obvious SME; participating in c-suite engagement opportunities; working with Industry leaders and Marquee/Big Bets account teams on specific customers; and regularly meeting with key partner leaders driving mature relationships that support opportunities and driving future pipeline.  This implies the ability to embed customer-centric industry muscle and experience, set in a consistent, scalable way.  Key partners in this role are Industry & Field Marketing, Industry Geo Sales Leaders, Product, Marquee Account Teams, and Industry GTM Leads.  The ideal candidate has a blend of understanding ServiceNow’s internal rhythm as well as a highly experienced grounded external point of view on what ‘best in class’ looks like to help us aspire to a new stature, industry first.

S/he will maintain a pulse on broader ServiceNow and Global Sales priorities, programs, and communications, and advise on ideal messaging, channels and approaches with the goal of delivering the best possible solution for customers.  We're looking for a high-energy, relationship building and empathetic partner who has a business building mindset and is a remarkable communicator!

Qualifications

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 10+ years of experience in the with proven success in guiding strategy, operations and day-to-day functions.
  • Strong knowledge and experience within the Insurance space, including the ability to collaborate with internal/external teams in assisting with successful integrations for problems in hand.
  • Proven pipeline management skills with a consultative sale-cycle approach.
  • Strong history of meeting targets with a vision of tangible execution for sustained YoY growth in the insurance industry.
  • Ability to utilize your network to help Sales Teams with identifying, prospecting, and supporting sales to potential channels partners to extend offerings into all sized financial institutions.
  • Be a consultative partner, building relationships with financial institutions, to help pitch, sell, and close as a value-add to their, IT, claims, service and underwriting solutions and strategies.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to Product, Development, and Marketing to provide industry insight and feedback to produce best in class solutions across the FSO (Financial Services Operations) segment. 
  • Exceptional written, presentation and delivery (verbal) communication skills – strategic, top down, concise
  • Ability to develop trusted advisor relationships with customers and sales organizations; demonstrated ability to advise and influence senior leaders, multiple teams / departments on strategy, messaging and customer engagement.
  • Experience producing thought leadership content and communications for an international audience.
  • Resourceful, self-motivated and able to prioritize independently shifting workloads in a dynamic, high growth environment.
  • Agile business mind: Adept ability to work in a matrix organization structure with a highly distributed team, leading through influence and relationship-building.
  • Business application software product marketing, sales or delivery experience is preferred over infrastructure experience.
  • Superior organizational skills with ability to effectively prioritize.
  • Ability to travel 50-75% of the time.
  • Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in business, finance, technology or related fields.
  • Community builder and team player

title: Director, Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Who We're Looking For:

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead a team of PMs as well as own the product strategy for empowering developers on the Now platform to build and take their applications to production faster. These areas include developer reach, testing, sandboxing, metering, and deployment of AI and human generated code. 

As agentic build tools compress the time it takes to author a change, the bottleneck moves downstream. Testing and deploying safely to production is already one of the loudest customer asks and one of the sharpest pain points on the platform. When changes originate from agents as well as people, and arrive at a much higher rate, the ability to validate and trust them quickly stops being a quality-of-life improvement and becomes a precondition for platform growth. You will lead the team that enables this for developers. 

This is not four adjacent feature areas with a shared manager. Customers experience the SDLC as one motion, and the central product challenge of this role is the connective tissue: a sandbox that behaves like the instance you will deploy to, a test suite that knows what changed, a release path that carries the evidence, and a model for building directly in production that an admin can actually govern. You set the strategy that makes their roadmaps resolve into a single lifecycle rather than four products that ship past each other. 

The scope is deeply technical and close to execution. The Developer Reach feature area alone unlocks a path to building in production that admins can manage at scale without losing control, and it demands real technical depth to steer. You will also carry a broad surface, over twenty product areas, with the escalation volume that comes with it, and you will need to run that operational load without letting it consume the strategic work. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap across Developer Reach, Developer Sandboxes, Agentic Testing, and Release Ops, and define how they compose into one lifecycle from authored change to governed, audited deployment. 

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of PMs, one per area. Set a clear standard for product craft, coach PMs on strategy and execution, and hold the bar on the seams between them: shared primitives, consistent models, and a single coherent customer narrative. 

  • Set product direction for validating AI-originated change at scale: what it means to trust an agent's output, what evidence a release needs to carry, and how much of the test and review burden can be automated without losing accountability. 

  • Drive the Developer Reach strategy, including the product model for building in production with admin control, guardrails, and reversibility at enterprise scale. 

  • Define the sandbox strategy: provisioning speed, production parity, data handling, and the developer experience of getting a safe place to work in seconds rather than days. 

  • Own the release governance path end to end, including the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, and the gating model that makes those tradeoffs explicit rather than accidental. 

  • Shape the metering and cost-modeling strategy for this area in partnership with Pricing & Packaging and Finance, and understand how it impacts the entire App Engine portfolio. 

  • Build the triage discipline that keeps escalations across a broad product surface from displacing the roadmap. 

  • Model an AI-first way of working: use agentic coding tools directly, build and deploy against your own products, and bring firsthand experience of the pain your customers are describing. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 

  • 12+ years of product management experience, including experience leading and growing a team of PMs, with a track record of setting technical strategy independently rather than executing a roadmap someone else defined. 

  • A track record of developing PMs, raising the bar on product thinking and execution across a team, and growing earlier-career PMs into strong owners of their areas. 

  • Deep experience owning developer platform, DevOps, or SDLC products at enterprise scale: CI/CD, test automation, environment management, release orchestration, or change management. 

  • Genuine hands-on technical comfort, including reading code, reasoning about system architecture, and holding your own in design discussions with senior engineers. Direct, regular personal use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf in your own workflow. 

  • Experience with enterprise change-management or release-governance systems and the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, ideally including systems that gate deployment through a controlled artifact such as a change set. 

  • Ideally, experience with test strategy at scale: automated test generation, coverage and flakiness economics, regression management, and what it takes for a team to actually trust a green build. 

  • Familiarity with environment and infrastructure provisioning models, ephemeral environments, production parity, and data seeding or masking, and the cost and security tradeoffs each carries. 

  • Working knowledge of agentic development workflows and what changes when a meaningful share of commits originate from an agent rather than a person: review, attribution, validation, and rollback. 

  • Proven ability to build and defend an executive-level strategic case, and to navigate cross-business-unit governance and ownership disputes at the VP and SVP level, driving alignment across genuinely contested boundaries. 

  • Demonstrated ability to run a high-volume operational surface, triaging escalations and production issues across many product areas while continuing to ship against a multi-year strategy. 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to translate deep technical tradeoffs into a strategy that lands with engineers and with executive stakeholders in the same conversation. 

Why join us? 

  • Own the part of the platform that decides whether agentic development is safe enough for enterprises to adopt, at the moment that question is being answered. 

  • Take four high-stakes bets that are currently separate and make them feel like one product, with the mandate and the team to actually do it. 

  • Drive the Developer Reach strategy for bringing agentic development on the Now platform to any developer in an organization, and the broader production-build model, one of the most technically ambitious efforts in the org and a direct answer to a long-standing customer ask. 

  • Operate at the center of the Platform Agentic Build Lifecycle org during the shift to AI-native software development, with influence over how changes get tested, governed, and released rather than only how they get written. 

  • Grow a team of PMs at the point where the platform’s velocity ceiling is actually set.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Role

Are you a software engineer who has honed your craft, partnership, and execution over years building and improving production systems, and are looking to apply your skills at the cutting edge of AI agents? This may be the role for you.

As a senior staff software engineer on our Agentic AI Harness & Quality team, you will play an important part in our mission: to advance the frontier of work that can be entrusted to agents to perform reliably at scale. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Moveworks AI Assistant platform in several of the following areas: agent orchestration, sandboxed file systems and code execution, latency optimization, agent memory, LLM self-reflection and improvement, execution environment simulation, enterprise knowledge graphs, and multimodal I/O.

You will have all the tools of modern enterprise AI at your disposal, including best-in-class LLMs from providers like OpenAI. Our team indexes on moving fast on scalable infrastructure, solving challenging product and engineering problems, and pushing the envelope of value provided to customers. If you are looking to do impactful work with a bright, dedicated, and impact-driven team alongside you, we’d love to have a conversation.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Take on exciting and difficult engineering challenges (see areas listed above) to build and evolve capable AI agent systems that are reliable in every sense of the word
  • Implement frontier AI algorithms and architectures and help productionize them at scale
  • Use the latest advances in machine learning, LLMs, and AI agents to enhance our products and create delightful user experiences
  • Contribute to roadmap and help drive the evolution of engineering areas of growing scope and impact to create lasting value for all our customers
  • Hone your craft in writing robust, extensible, readable, and performant code
  • Partner with subject matter experts across the company including in machine learning, security, product, user experience, and customer success, to learn from each other and build the best enterprise AI product the world has ever seen
  • Mentor other engineers on the team in how to build, maintain, and evolve great software
  • Collaborate with machine learning engineers, learn from each other, and build world-class AI systems

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 10+ years experience designing, building, and improving production systems, ideally at scale
  • Ability to think and communicate clearly about complex engineering problems and systems
  • Comfort giving and receiving feedback, and in holding yourself and your coworkers accountable to a high standard of operational excellence
  • Readiness to hit the ground running in a Mac development environment, programming in Python, Golang, and/or Java

We are building a real-time conversational AI voice platform. An orchestrator runs every call through Voice Activity Detection, Speech-to-Text, LLM-based agent matching, tool calling against ServiceNow platform (Glide) APIs, and Text-to-Speech.

In voice, latency and reliability are the product. You will own the platform's reliability, performance and operational architecture, and set direction across teams.

  • Define and drive SLIs/SLOs for availability, perceived latency (end-of-speech to first audio), and call quality.

Job Description

About the Team
ServiceNow's Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering team is an entrepreneurial, fast-growing, fast-moving function at the center of ServiceNow's shift to AI-native. We sit at the front lines of the most strategic agentic engagements in the Fortune 500 - partnering directly with C-suite buyers to translate ambiguous business problems into production-grade agentic builds that move the needle on revenue, cost, and customer experience. Our central technical function ensures we're meeting market demand at pace, scaling without sacrificing production fidelity, and feeding the signals from frontier customer work back into the ServiceNow product ecosystem.

About the Role
We're hiring a Principal, AI Deployment Strategy to own where the FDE organization deploys its talent for maximum impact. This role sits at the seam between our portfolio of engagements, our global capacity, and our critical GTM, sales, and product relationships. You'll calibrate how we allocate FDE resources against the highest-leverage customer, product, and market opportunities. This is a strategist-operator role, not a coordinator's - every deployment decision, every capacity constraint, every scale path is yours to solve at an expert caliber. The right person has lived across GTM, value technical value, and delivery, has the executive presence to hold a room with senior sales and product leadership.

Who Thrives Here
Operator-builders who've sat in seats across GTM, value engineering, and delivery and want all three at once. Comfortable being the strategist in a GTM planning session on Monday and the deployment tactician solving capacity trade-offs on Tuesday. No ego about scope; deep ego about outcomes.

What You'll Own

FDE Global Deployment & Portfolio Strategy
Own the global FDE portfolio and allocation strategy. Work with regional leadership, Geo Presidents, and SVP/GTM to calibrate where FDE delivers the most impact on revenue, product signal, and customer reference value. Run the investment thesis that positions the FDE team in the highest-conviction customer, product, and GTM moments. Navigate the competing priorities across regions, portfolios, and strategic accounts and make the calls that maximize team impact globally, not just locally.

2. FDE Investment Strategy & ROI Operations
FDE capacity is scarce and expensive. Deploy it like capital.

  • Treat every FDE engagement as an investment. Approve only work tied to a clear strategic imperative or commercial outcome: a renewal, net-new ACV, or a key product expansion. Set approval criteria that hold up under CFO scrutiny. Lock scope, success criteria, and the target outcome before work starts, then track every engagement through to the result.
  • Prove the return. Measure the renewals, net-new ACV, consumption, and expansion influenced per FDE-week, by engagement type, region, and industry. Make sure every value case clears its cost to serve. Use the results to steer where FDE deploys next and when to scale headcount or extend through partner capacity.

3. Value Velocity & Build Economics
Compress the time from use case identification to value defined, aligned to token burn, and executive-signed-off. Build the repeatable playbook that gets engagements from "interesting problem" to "approved investment with quantified outcomes" in a fraction of the current cycle. Scale that playbook across the portfolio so every FDE engagement benefits from the same velocity and rigor, regardless of region or industry.

4. Evolving Initiatives & Scale Path Orchestration
Stay close to what's working in the portfolio and what's not. Own the emerging initiatives that define FDE's next frontier - agentic use cases, go-to-market motions, industry verticals, platform capabilities - and build the scale paths that turn early wins into portfolio-wide capability. Recognize when an initiative is ready to scale, when it needs more signal, and when it should be archived. Define and manage the partner motion that extends FDE reach without diluting caliber. Build the vetting standards, engagement model, and guardrails that let tier-1 SIs and specialist partners deliver on FDE-adjacent work under FDE brand and quality standards.

5. Executive Narrative & Senior Relationship Alignment
Drive how the FDE impact shows up at the highest altitudes - board narratives, Financial Analyst Day, C-suite QBRs, marquee customer references. Own the throughline from raw deployment and build outcomes to the story that moves markets, analysts, and pipeline.

6. The Charter Isn't Fixed - It's Ever-Evolving
The AI market shifts week to week. What resonated with customers last quarter may be table stakes today, and what's not working needs to be killed fast. Stay close enough to the field to read those signals in real time, and move mountains internally to make sure the team is leaning into what's landing and pulling back from what isn't. Pattern-match across the portfolio, find the highest-leverage deployment decision in any given week, and go solve it at an expert level. Comfort with ambiguity and speed is the price of entry.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience spanning AI GTM, applied AI or technical solutioning, management consulting, or strategic delivery in a Fortune 500 environment
  • A track record of personally owning complex, multi-stakeholder GTM and deployment decisions with C-suite and senior executive partners. Ownership - not coordination.
  • Demonstrated fluency in agentic AI, LLM-based systems, or applied AI builds. Enough technical depth to challenge scope, pressure-test architecture, and credibly engage customer and internal engineering leadership.
  • Experience designing and scaling commercial frameworks, capacity models, or strategic allocation constructs that have held up under CFO and procurement scrutiny.
  • A history of managing portfolios or programs that have scaled beyond your individual reach. Resource allocation decisions that moved the needle across a region or function.
  • The judgment to know which deployment decision in the portfolio deserves your time this quarter, and the operating instinct to go solve it without waiting for a directive.

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.  

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.  

Why This Role Matters: 

Enterprise leaders aren’t just experimenting with AI—they’re demanding outcomes. The next wave of adoption will be led by those who can move fast, deliver measurable value, and transform 1-off wins into repeatable success.  

As a FDE Technical Program Manager, you operate on the frontlines of transformation. You will support ServiceNow’s cross-functional Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) teams in building and delivering intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve our customers’ most mission-critical challenges.  

You'll work in a fast-paced environment as our FDE team partners with key strategic customers to accelerate time to value. You will provide a proactive, strategic perspective, manage customer relationships, and drive tactical execution from initial conception through FDE build development, delivery, and successful completion.   

Who You Are: 

You are a dynamic and innovative problem-solver who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a strong analytical mindset while still keeping focus on the bigger picture. You have a background managing SDLC processes while keeping a customer-first mentality. You have a passion for AI and scaling innovation. You excel at transforming ambiguity into clarity and have hands on experience driving projects/programs end to end.  

What You’ll Do: 

  • Work seamlessly with software engineers, product managers, product designers, and customers, to deliver intelligent systems that address mission-critical challenges using AI. 
  • Collaborate directly with customers to co-innovate AI solutions tailored to their needs, acting as the first point of contact or escalation.

  • Drive large scale, cross-functional, high visibility AI software development builds on condensed timelines.   
  • Organize complex, ambiguous problems into prioritized milestones, deliverables, and success criteria for your builds, translating business objectives into execution strategy (tactical and strategic).  
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent builds from delivering on objectives, especially on the AI/ML deployment front. 
  • Help manage risks, dependencies and escalate impediments, as well as releases and navigating AI release requirements.  
  • Drive process improvements and create documentation to promote best practices using automation to replace repeatable, operational tasks.   
  • Coordinate day to day activities required to deliver a great solution on time, as well as create transparency through reports, dashboards, and status updates. 
  • Seek to continuously grow by proactively seeking and embracing constructive feedback, as well as provide feedback to colleagues to encourage an open and collaborative culture . 

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of project/program management experience in mid/large size software development companies. 
  • A solid understanding of SDLC and release management practices in cloud-based SaaS product organizations.  
  • Prior work delivering AI or intelligent workflow solutions at scale, with proven success in deploying AI solutions that delivered tangible customer impact. 
  • Familiarity with AI governance, compliance, and enterprise security practices 
  • This role includes occasional travel.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Demonstrated competence in key AI/ML software engineering program management best practices: program planning, schedule construction and management; risk assessment & mitigation, dependency management, change management, and predictive metrics.  
  • Outstanding collaboration and communication skills - clearly communicate changes, requests, and deadlines to the teams and risks, status, progress, and decisions to a variety of audiences including executives. 
  • Passion for working with people in technical and innovative environments, with the ability to work well with many different types of personalities in various functions.     
  • Strong leadership and relationship building skills to influence and motivate without authority - masterful in the art of bringing people together.  
  • Strong facilitation skills to lead/drive a variety of build events, with a high regard for quality, drive for continuous improvement across the organization, and ability to keep the big picture in view. 
  • Experience deploying AI solutions to production and skilled at identifying waste/delays in AI end-to-end development, deployment, and release processes. 
  • Exceptional team building and team management skills, including interpersonal skills, conflict resolution, and negotiation.  
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.

Job Description

The Martech team enables Marketing to scale through connected platforms, reliable data, automated processes, and technology solutions that support lead management, CRM processes, campaign execution, reporting, and revenue growth. 

As a Data Product Manager, Marketing Technology, you will define and deliver Martech capabilities with an initial focus on owning end-to-end lead flow, lead validation and enriching processes, Marketing data integrations, and platform optimizations and consolidations. You will partner across Marketing, IT, Digital, and Data teams to translate business needs into clear requirements, prioritize enhancements, and drive scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes. 

What you get to do in this role:

  • Act as the data product owner and advocate for Marketing stakeholders, gathering feedback, identifying pain points, and translating needs into Martech capabilities and enhancements. 

  • Develop, own, and manage clear business requirements for Martech initiatives, including lead management, lead processing analysis and reporting, system integrations, data quality enhancements, and operational workflows. 

  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand Martech platform capabilities, system roadmaps, integration dependencies, customization needs, and implementation processes. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle, including roadmap planning, discovery, requirements definition, sprint planning, product reviews, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch optimization. 

  • Identify, prioritize, and document business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics. 

  • Prepare current-state and future-state process documentation, system workflows, training materials, and gap analyses to support business alignment and change management. 

  • Define and track desired outcomes, OKRs, KPIs, and adoption metrics to measure the success of Martech initiatives. 

  • Lead or support stakeholder alignment, including obtaining cross-functional sign-off on requirements, solution design, UAT readiness, and release decisions. 

  • Define test criteria, support User Acceptance Testing, validate business outcomes, and help determine project readiness for launch. 

  • Troubleshoot data, lead flow, integration, and process issues across Martech platforms, marketing automation systems, and related third-party tools. 

  • Serve as a Martech subject matter expert across key platforms such as CRM platforms, Marketo, Adobe Experience Platform, ServiceNow, Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager, or other relevant marketing and sales technology tools. 

  • Support M&A integration efforts by assisting with discovery, documentation, and requirements for acquired system onboarding. 

  • Partner with global and regional marketing teams to improve communication, adoption, governance, and consistency across Martech processes. 

  • Contribute to retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual work, improve data integrity, and increase marketing efficiency. 

  • Help maintain Martech governance standards, including documentation, intake processes, prioritization models, release communications, and operational best practices. 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Technology, or a related field. 

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, business product management, marketing technology, marketing operations, CRM, marketing automation, or a related function. 

  • Proven experience partnering with Marketing, Sales, IT, Data, and other cross-functional teams to design, deliver, and continuously improve marketing technology solutions. 

  • Strong experience with Marketing automation systems and data platforms 

  • Experience working with Martech integrations, third-party tools, data flows, APIs, lead management processes, campaign operations, or customer data platforms. 

  • Adobe Experience Platform experience strongly preferred. 

  • Experience defining business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process documentation. 

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, sprint planning, backlog management, OKRs, and KPI measurement. 

  • Experience supporting UAT, release readiness, stakeholder sign-off, and change management. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate system, data, and process issues. 

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence, align, and communicate with stakeholders at multiple levels. 

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and cross-functional dependencies simultaneously. 

  • Experience with data quality, database structures, data cleansing, data enrichment, segmentation, or reporting processes preferred 

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and high stakeholder visibility. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with enterprise Martech ecosystems and platforms such as CRM platforms, Marketo, Adobe Experience Platform, ServiceNow, Workfront, ZoomInfo, Demandbase, 6sense, or similar tools. 

  • Experience supporting lead lifecycle management, routing, scoring, attribution, campaign execution, personalization, or buying group processes. 

  • Familiarity with marketing data governance, consent management, privacy requirements, and operational compliance.

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead an organization of approximately 20 engineers responsible for building and operating critical HRSD services that serve some of the world's largest enterprises. You will define technical strategy, drive execution, and ensure the delivery of highly scalable, reliable, and secure cloud services that power employee experiences across the ServiceNow platform.

This role also provides a unique opportunity to shape how AI transforms software engineering. You will drive the adoption of AI-assisted development practices, automation, and intelligent engineering workflows to improve productivity, accelerate innovation, and raise the quality bar across your organization. Company Description

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. title: Senior Manager, Partner Led Channel & Growth Operations
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow is looking for a Senior Manager, Partner Led Channel & Growth Operations to wear three critical hats across AMS GPC: incubating Partner Led Channel as a new business model in AMS, supporting Canada operations as a business partner, and enabling Major Area Strategists to drive pipeline growth and partner presence in AMS Major Areas. This is a high-impact, multi-dimensional role that sits at the intersection of new business model enablement, operational excellence, and strategic growth support. You'll work with Global Operations, a new PLC leader, regional operations, and strategists to make this portfolio execute.

What You'll Own

Partner Led Channel Incubation & Enablement (40%)

  • Global Ops alignment: Partner with Global Operations to understand PLC operating model, business requirements, and operational structure. Translate Global model to AMS context.
  • Systems & process definition: Understand how PLC operates within our backend systems, define data flows, deal routing, partner hierarchy, and operational workflows that enable the model.
  • New leader enablement: Work with new PLC leader to understand their business priorities, operational needs, and scaling plans. Help them navigate AMS operational infrastructure and best practices.
  • Operational roadmap: Support the PLC launch/ramp plan for AMS—what systems get configured when, what processes need to be in place, staffing/capacity planning. Work with leader to execute roadmap and enable team.
  • Cross-org coordination: Coordinate with Data & Systems team, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure PLC can operate smoothly within AMS infrastructure.

Canada Sales Operations & Execution (30%)

  • Forecasting discipline: Manage weekly/monthly forecast submission, validation, and accuracy. Own forecast quality and integrity.
  • Deal review coaching: Support deal reviews with Canada leader and team. Diagnose deal health, identify risks, surface pull-in candidates.
  • Pipeline intelligence: Track pipeline composition, stage velocity, sourced vs. sell-through. Surface early-warning signals on stalled deals.
  • Performance management: Coordinate quarterly/annual performance management—MBO setting, attainment tracking, individual conversations.
  • Operational discipline: Ensure agreed-upon sales processes are followed. Escalate issues to Partner Operations team.

Major Area Strategist Support & Pipeline Growth (30%)

  • Forecast & QBR support: Support Major Area Strategists for forecasting calls and QBRs. Gather data, surface trends, prepare executive briefs.
  • Deal tracking & intelligence: Maintain visibility into strategic deals for each strategist. Surface pipeline risks, opportunities, and acceleration candidates. Provide deal-level coaching.
  • Pipeline analytics: Build self-serve data views and scorecards for strategist's portfolios. Track growth metrics and NNL attainment. Surface insights to drive growth strategy.
  • Counsel & advisory: Be a sounding board for strategists on deals, strategy, and operational challenges. Provide market/competitive intelligence as needed.

Key Relationships

  • Head of AMS GPC Business Operations (your manager)
  • PLC Leader (new to AMS, building PLC business)
  • Canada Leader (operational partnership)
  • Major Area Strategists (2 current, expanding in 2027)
  • Senior Manager, Partner Operations Infrastructure (operational standards/escalations)
  • Global Partner Led Channel Operations team (PLC model alignment)
  • Data & Systems team (PLC systems enablement)
  • Field Business Partners (coordination)

Qualifications

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • 7+ years in sales operations, sales management, or business operations roles.
  • 2+ years directly supporting sales leaders or strategic teams as a business partner.
  • Experience launching or scaling new business models or sales motions.
  • Deep expertise in sales forecasting, deal review processes, and pipeline management.
  • Strong analytical mindset. You can pull data, diagnose issues, and identify growth opportunities.
  • Advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
  • Excellent communication and executive presence.
  • Balance of operational discipline and strategic thinking.
  • Cross-functional collaboration (Finance, IT, Sales Leadership, Global Operations).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Partner/channel sales operations or management experience.
  • Experience with SaaS or enterprise software sales operations.
  • Track record scaling new business models or sales organizations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and sales forecasting tools.
  • Experience working across multiple geographies or business units.
  • Executive-level communication and strategic advisory experience.

Character Traits

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. PLC is new. You can work with incomplete information and incomplete processes to figure out what works.
  • Business-minded strategist. You think about growth, market dynamics, and outcomes—not just processes.
  • Execution-oriented. You drive action across multiple priorities without losing focus.
  • Collaborative and curious. You ask great questions, listen actively, and help leaders think through complex problems.
  • Clear communicator. You translate complexity into simple language. Your analysis is actionable.
  • Resilient and adaptable. You handle changing priorities and ambiguity without losing momentum.
  • Trusted advisor. Leaders trust you with confidences and strategic challenges.

Why This Role Matters

Partner Led Channel is a new growth engine for AMS. Getting the operational model and systems right is critical to its success. Simultaneously, Canada and Major Area Strategists are scaling portfolios with complex growth dynamics. This role directly impacts PLC's ability to launch successfully, Canada's operational health, and strategists' ability to execute on growth. You'll be a trusted operational and strategic partner across all three.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits for IC5 level.
  • The opportunity to incubate a new business model and own its operational success in AMS.
  • Exposure to strategic growth initiatives, new business model enablement, and complex portfolio management.
  • High visibility and cross-functional influence—working with Global Ops, leadership, and strategists.
  • Clear growth path: Strong performers move into Head of Operations, VP of Operations, or Chief of Staff roles.
  • A team that values strategic thinking, operational excellence, and calculated risk-taking

Why ServiceNow

AI is changing how enterprises run, and ServiceNow is where it gets put to work. Our platform connects people, data, workflows and AI agents across the whole organisation, so customers get outcomes, not just insights. We're a team that stays hungry and humble, wows customers, creates belonging and wins together.

About this role

Great ideas don't win Enterprise deals. Great ideas you can see working do.

As an Advisory Presales Solution Consultant, you'll work alongside account teams to help some of Australia's biggest organisations solve real business problems on the ServiceNow AI Platform. You'll guide customers from the first conversation to confident decisions, and you'll have the room to try bold ideas, learn fast and make an impact that shows.

What you will do

  • Wow our customers: Dig into the challenges behind transformation, efficiency, regulation and resilience, and shape solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Build to show, not tell: Use ServiceNow's own tools to create live, tailored demos and prototypes that bring a customer's scenario to life. Skip the slide deck, and let the platform do the talking.
  • Advise executives: Hold regular conversations with senior leaders and help them define outcomes and business value.

  • Experiment with AI: Prototype AI and agentic workflows, test what's possible and show customers where it can take them.

  • Represent ServiceNow: Speak at executive briefings, events and webinars.

  • Experience in presales, consulting, solution architecture or a similar hands-on role in enterprise technology
  • Confidence engaging senior stakeholders and a knack for storytelling, strong demonstration and presentation skills
  • A love of building: you're happiest when you're making something work and showing someone what it can do
  • Hands on experience with AI, automation or low code tools, and an interest in the evolving AI landscape
  • Real curiosity and a low ego, always learning mindset. You don't need to know the platform yet, but you'll want to learn it fast

  • A collaborative style that lifts the people around you
     

Desirable

title: Staff AI Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Our team secures the AI in ServiceNow's products and platform from adversaries. As AI agents gain the ability to reason, retrieve context, and take real action on behalf of users, they become a new and largely unmapped attack surface - and the controls that protect them mostly don't exist yet. We build them. 

We're looking for a Staff AI Security Specialist who sits at the intersection of AI and Security and is happiest building. This is an applied role: you'll spend your time reasoning about how agentic systems break and then writing the code that stops it, from prototype to shipped control in collaboration with Security Engineers. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Analyze the security of AI agent systems - how the harness assembles context and drives the tool-calling loop, how agents plan and delegate, what they persist to memory, and how all of it responds to untrusted input - and find where an adversary can subvert them 
  • Design and build security controls for agentic systems: static analysis of agent and tool configurations, runtime policy enforcement, behavioral detection, and mitigations for tool and goal hijacking 
  • Build working prototypes end to end, then partner with engineering to harden the ones that prove out 
  • Threat model new AI architectures and features before they ship, and turn findings into concrete controls rather than a list of risks 
  • Red-team our own agents and our own defenses: indirect prompt injection, tool abuse, privilege escalation across agent boundaries, data exfiltration through model and tool channels 
  • Build repeatable evaluations and benchmarks so we can measure whether a control actually holds, and prove it as models and products change underneath us 
  • Track offensive and defensive AI security research and judge quickly what's real, what's noise, and what should change our roadmap 
  • Advise product and platform teams building agentic features on secure design, and raise the team's collective depth in AI security 
  • Publish what's worth publishing - internal research, patents, and external talks 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have: 

  • Experience in leveraging integration of AI capabilities into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • 6+ years of combined experience in security, software engineering, or applied research, including 2+ years working hands-on with AI/ML or LLM-based systems, is required 
  • Strong working knowledge of the agent harness and its security-relevant seams: system prompt and context construction, the tool-calling loop, context window management and compaction, sub-agent delegation, sandboxing and execution boundaries, is required 
  • Working knowledge of agent memory and retrieval systems - what persists, who can write to it, and how it is read back - along with orchestration frameworks and tool protocols such as MCP, and the failure modes each introduces, is required 
  • Demonstrated depth in at least one security domain (application security, offensive security, authorization and identity, or detection engineering), with the instinct to reason in terms of attacker capability, preconditions, and attack chains rather than checklists, is required 
  • Practical understanding of the AI-specific threat landscape - prompt, tool, and goal hijacking, indirect injection through retrieved content, memory poisoning and adversarial instruction persistence across sessions, insecure agent configurations, cross-session and cross-tenant data leakage, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS - is required 
  • Proficiency in Python, sufficient to independently build and ship working systems, is required 
  • Ability to take an ambiguous problem statement to a working artifact, own it end to end, and abandon it without ceremony when the evidence says it doesn't work, is required 
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both non-technical business users as well as technical stakeholders is required 

Preferred qualifications: 

  • Experience building systems that make and enforce security decisions at runtime 
  • Experience building static or dynamic analysis tooling 
  • Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial ML, or evaluating models and guardrails at scale 
  • Published security or AI research, patents, CVEs, or meaningful open-source contributions

Job Description

We seek a Director of Product Management to set and lead the product strategy for the Microsoft partnership across ServiceNow's full vertical stack, from data and AI through agents, governance, and industry-specific workflows. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You are the senior product leader and definitive internal authority on how ServiceNow's platform aligns with Microsoft's product stack end-to-end.

The scope is intentionally broad and will shift as both companies' product stacks evolve. Rather than a fixed list of integration points, this role is defined by a mandate: wherever ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack meet, you are accountable for the product relationship. You'll partner with product marketing, business development, corporate development, and other functions to define and execute the engagement strategy, track execution milestones, and maximize value generated for ServiceNow, our customers, and Microsoft. You will serve as ServiceNow's senior product counterpart to Microsoft product leadership.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Experience leading product strategy for technology partnerships, including build-vs-partner analysis, technical due diligence, and integration architecture.

title: Staff Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a Staff Researcher, you will work on research questions that most AI labs simply do not have access to. ServiceNow AI Research is chartered to build the future of enterprise agentic AI, from a rare vantage point: we see how agents actually behave, inside complex enterprise environments, at scale. 

You will contribute to research initiatives on how agents accumulate and reuse tacit knowledge, learn and improve continuously, and on their resilience, their safety, and the privacy of the data they handle. These are the real obstacles to enterprise agentic deployment today, and they surface in operational reality well before they appear in the literature. 

While much of the AI and NLP community concentrates on core agent capabilities, our team explores the dimensions that determine real adoption: safety mechanisms, threat detection, privacy guarantees, and responsible AI practices. You will have the freedom to publish and advance the state of the art, with the rare advantage of testing your hypotheses against real deployments rather than against benchmarks. 

Qualifications

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience 
  • 2 or more years of research experience post-PhD, a significant portion of it in an industrial setting or in direct contact with deployed systems 
  • Established publication record at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or equivalents), with contributions recognized as influential in your field 
  • Demonstrated track record of setting/executing research agenda, not only executing one: you have chosen problems before the community turned to them, and you can explain why 
  • Experience working on cross-disciplinary teams or projects collaborating with researchers and engineers

title: Staff Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tout a commencé sous le soleil de San Diego, en Californie, en 2004, lorsqu’un ingénieur visionnaire, Fred Luddy, a vu le potentiel de transformer notre façon de travailler. Aujourd’hui, ServiceNow se présente comme un leader mondial du marché, apportant une technologie innovante améliorée par l’IA à plus de 8 100 clients, dont 85% des entreprises du Fortune 500®. Notre plateforme intelligente basée sur le nuage connecte de manière transparente les personnes, les systèmes et les processus pour permettre aux organisations de trouver des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, plus rapides et meilleures. Mais ce n’est que le début de notre voyage. Joignez-vous à nous dans la poursuite de notre objectif de rendre le monde meilleur pour tous.

######

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Description de poste

En tant que chercheur principal, vous travaillerez sur des questions de recherche auxquelles la plupart des laboratoires d’IA n’ont tout simplement pas accès. La recherche en IA de ServiceNow a pour mission de bâtir l’avenir de l’IA agentique en entreprise, avec un point de vue privilégié : nous observons le comportement réel des agents, au sein d’environnements d’entreprise complexes et à grande échelle.

Vous contribuerez à des initiatives de recherche portant sur la manière dont les agents accumulent et réutilisent les connaissances tacites, sur leur capacité d’apprentissage et d’amélioration continue, ainsi que sur leur résilience, leur sécurité et la confidentialité des données qu’ils traitent. Ce sont les véritables obstacles au déploiement de l’IA agentique en entreprise aujourd’hui, et ils apparaissent dans la réalité opérationnelle bien avant d’être documentés dans la littérature scientifique.

Alors que la majeure partie de la communauté IA et TAL se concentre sur les capacités fondamentales des agents, notre équipe explore les dimensions qui déterminent l’adoption réelle : mécanismes de sécurité, détection des menaces, garanties de confidentialité et pratiques d’IA responsable. Vous aurez la liberté de publier et de faire progresser l’état de l’art, avec l’avantage rare de tester vos hypothèses sur de véritables déploiements plutôt que sur des bancs d’essai.

#######

As a Staff Researcher, you will work on research questions that most AI labs simply do not have access to. ServiceNow AI Research is chartered to build the future of enterprise agentic AI, from a rare vantage point: we see how agents actually behave, inside complex enterprise environments, at scale. 

You will contribute to research initiatives on how agents accumulate and reuse tacit knowledge, learn and improve continuously, and on their resilience, their safety, and the privacy of the data they handle. These are the real obstacles to enterprise agentic deployment today, and they surface in operational reality well before they appear in the literature. 

While much of the AI and NLP community concentrates on core agent capabilities, our team explores the dimensions that determine real adoption: safety mechanisms, threat detection, privacy guarantees, and responsible AI practices. You will have the freedom to publish and advance the state of the art, with the rare advantage of testing your hypotheses against real deployments rather than against benchmarks. 

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Doctorat en informatique, en apprentissage automatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience de recherche équivalente
  • Au moins deux ans d’expérience de recherche après le doctorat, dont une part importante en milieu industriel ou au contact direct de systèmes déployés
  • Historique de publications dans des conférences de premier plan (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP ou équivalents), avec des contributions reconnues comme influentes dans votre domaine
  • Expérience avérée de définition et d’exécution d’un programme de recherche, et pas seulement d’exécution : vous avez choisi des problèmes avant que la communauté ne s’y intéresse, et vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi
  • Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes ou de projets interdisciplinaires, en collaboration avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs
  • Solides compétences en développement logiciel : vous écrivez, maintenez et optimisez du code de recherche de haute qualité, et vous savez ce qu’il faut pour qu’un résultat survive le passage en production
  • Utilisation avancée des outils agentiques dans votre propre pratique de recherche, et volonté de faire progresser les pratiques de l’équipe dans ce domaine
  • Capacité démontrée d’influencer des décisions techniques au-delà de votre propre équipe, notamment auprès des équipes produit et ingénierie
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des travaux techniques complexes à des publics non spécialisés et à des dirigeants

Atouts

  • Expertise dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : mémoire des agents et connaissances tacites, apprentissage continu, sécurité et alignement, sécurité informatique et détection des menaces, confidentialité, évaluation des agents
  • Expérience de systèmes d’IA opérant dans de véritables environnements d’entreprise, avec les contraintes de conformité, de gouvernance et d’échelle que cela implique
  • Contributions à des logiciels libres, jeux de données ou bancs d’essai d’évaluation utilisés par la communauté
  • Rôles de service scientifique : comités de programme, travail éditorial, organisation d’ateliers
  • Collaborations académiques ou encadrement de doctorants
  • Maîtrise du français, ou intérêt à l’apprendre, dans un environnement de travail bilingue à Montréal

Requirements 

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience 
  • 2 or more years of research experience post-PhD, a significant portion of it in an industrial setting or in direct contact with deployed systems 
  • Established publication record at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or equivalents), with contributions recognized as influential in your field 
  • Demonstrated track record of setting/executing research agenda, not only executing one: you have chosen problems before the community turned to them, and you can explain why 
  • Experience working on cross-disciplinary teams or projects collaborating with researchers and engineers 
  • Strong software development skills: you write, maintain, and optimize high-quality research code, and you know what it takes for a result to survive the move into production 
  • Advanced use of agentic tools in your own research practice, and a willingness to advance the team's practices in this area 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions beyond your own team, particularly with product and engineering teams 
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical work to non-specialist audiences and to executives 

Nice to have 

  • Expertise in one or more of the following areas: agent memory and tacit knowledge, continual learning, safety and alignment, security and threat detection, privacy, agent evaluation 
  • Experience with AI systems operating in real enterprise environments, with the compliance, governance, and scale constraints that entails 
  • Contributions to open source software, datasets, or evaluation benchmarks used by the community 
  • Scientific service roles: program committees, editorial work, workshop organization 
  • Academic collaborations or supervision of doctoral students 
  • Fluency in French, or interest in learning it, in a bilingual Montreal work environment

title: Sr. Staff Product Designer, Mobile Experience Strategy & Systems
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to define and advance a coherent, best-in-class mobile experience across ServiceNow. 

This role will establish the strategy, principles, shared patterns, and quality standards that connect ServiceNow's Adaptive experiences with its native iOS and Android experiences. Working across Platform and business units, this leader will identify common customer needs, reconcile fragmented approaches, and help teams create mobile experiences that feel purposeful, consistent, accessible, and optimized for the strengths of each surface. 

The role combines systems thinking, mobile product strategy, interaction design leadership, and hands-on design direction. It will create reference experiences and reusable patterns, guide high-priority product work, and establish the practices teams need to make strong mobile decisions independently. It will partner closely with product designers, design-system teams, Product, Engineering, Research, and business-unit leaders while remaining accountable for the coherence and quality of the end-to-end mobile experience. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role with company-wide influence. Success requires deep expertise in both adaptive and native mobile design, exceptional product and interaction judgment, and the ability to align teams across a complex, federated organization without relying on formal authority. 

What You'll Do:

Define the enterprise mobile experience strategy 

  • Establish a unified vision and multi-year strategy for mobile experiences across Adaptive and native platforms. 

  • Define where experiences should be adaptive, native, or intentionally shared—and provide teams with clear principles for making those choices. 

  • Translate company, platform, and design-system priorities into a focused mobile experience roadmap. 

  • Identify the highest-value opportunities for mobile to simplify work, support work in context, and extend ServiceNow beyond the desktop. 

  • Represent mobile experience strategy in senior design, product, engineering, and platform forums. 

  • Align Platform and business-unit leaders around shared priorities, investments, dependencies, and measures of success. 

Create a coherent system of mobile patterns 

  • Identify recurring mobile workflows, interaction models, and customer needs across products and business units. 

  • Define reusable mobile experience patterns for navigation, search, approvals, tasks, notifications, data entry, record interaction, collaboration, offline and interrupted work, AI-assisted actions, and other common enterprise workflows. 

  • Establish clear relationships among shared experience patterns, Adaptive capabilities, native platform conventions, and product-specific needs. 

  • Ensure patterns account for different devices, form factors, input methods, orientations, operating-system behaviors, connectivity conditions, and user contexts. 

  • Partner with design-system designers and engineers to translate validated patterns into reusable guidance, assets, and system capabilities. 

  • Maintain a coherent pattern ecosystem while allowing intentional variation where customer needs or platform conventions require it. 

Raise the quality of mobile product experiences 

  • Define what best-in-class mobile quality means for ServiceNow, including usability, interaction, visual craft, performance perception, accessibility, resilience, and platform appropriateness. 

  • Create reference experiences, prototypes, and exemplars that demonstrate the intended experience and quality bar. 

  • Provide strategic design direction and hands-on critique for high-impact mobile initiatives across Platform and the business units. 

  • Lead cross-product reviews to identify fragmentation, redundant solutions, system gaps, and opportunities for reuse. 

  • Help teams resolve complex mobile interaction problems without taking over their product ownership or delivery responsibilities. 

  • Ensure shared experiences are designed for real mobile contexts rather than reduced or rearranged versions of desktop workflows. 

Bridge Adaptive and native experiences 

  • Develop a clear framework for deciding when a use case is best served through an Adaptive experience, a native experience, or a coordinated combination of both. 

  • Define principles for continuity across channels so users can move between desktop, Adaptive, and native experiences without losing context or confidence. 

  • Identify the capabilities that should remain consistent across surfaces and those that should follow native platform behaviors. 

  • Guide teams through tradeoffs involving reach, speed, fidelity, device capabilities, performance, accessibility, maintainability, and customer expectations. 

  • Surface gaps in Adaptive and native platform capabilities and translate them into prioritized system and platform needs. 

  • Partner with engineering and product leaders to ensure design intent is feasible, scalable, and supported by the underlying platform. 

Establish mobile standards and best practices 

  • Define mobile experience principles, interaction standards, design guidance, and decision frameworks that teams can apply consistently. 

  • Incorporate iOS, Android, responsive and adaptive design conventions while maintaining a recognizable ServiceNow experience. 

  • Establish guidance for touch interaction, gesture use, hierarchy, density, input, feedback, motion, system permissions, device capabilities, error recovery, and edge cases. 

  • Embed accessibility, localization, responsive behavior, privacy, trust, and inclusive design into mobile standards from the outset. 

  • Clarify how mobile patterns connect to the broader design system, content standards, AI experience principles, and platform architecture. 

  • Keep standards current as device ecosystems, operating-system conventions, AI interaction models, and customer expectations evolve. 

Enable teams across Platform and business units 

  • Create playbooks, decision tools, pattern guidance, workshops, demonstrations, and other resources that help teams design high-quality mobile experiences. 

  • Coach designers and cross-functional teams through mobile strategy, interaction, and system-design challenges. 

  • Build a mobile design community of practice that connects practitioners across Platform and the business units. 

  • Facilitate working sessions that reconcile competing needs and turn product-specific solutions into reusable patterns where appropriate. 

  • Help design leaders assess capability gaps and strengthen mobile craft across their teams. 

  • Enable distributed teams to move faster and make better mobile decisions while maintaining shared experience standards. 

Use research and evidence to guide investment 

  • Partner with Research, Product, Analytics, and customer-facing teams to understand mobile contexts, unmet needs, adoption barriers, and workflow opportunities. 

  • Establish an ongoing view of mobile experience quality across the product portfolio. 

  • Use customer evidence, product data, competitive analysis, design audits, and team feedback to prioritize improvements. 

  • Define measures for mobile usability, adoption, task success, satisfaction, consistency, reuse, accessibility, and experience quality. 

  • Communicate insights, progress, risks, and recommendations to design and cross-functional leadership. 

Scope and Partnership Model 

This role provides strategic and systems leadership for mobile experience design. It works through partnership with product teams rather than replacing their ownership. 

This role owns:

  • The cross-company mobile experience vision, principles, and design strategy. 

  • The framework for choosing and coordinating Adaptive and native approaches. 

  • Shared mobile experience patterns, standards, and quality criteria. 

  • Reference experiences and prototypes that demonstrate intended behavior. 

  • Cross-product mobile audits, strategic reviews, and recommendations. 

  • Mobile design best practices, enablement, and the community of practice. 

  • Identification and prioritization of systemic mobile experience gaps. 

Business-unit and Platform product teams own 

  • Product-specific mobile strategy within the shared enterprise direction. 

  • Customer and business outcomes for their product areas. 

  • End-to-end design and delivery of their mobile features and workflows. 

  • Product requirements, sequencing, resourcing, and roadmap commitments. 

  • Validation of product-specific needs with their customers and users. 

Shared accountability 

  • Creating coherent experiences across Adaptive, native, and desktop surfaces. 

  • Translating recurring product needs into reusable patterns and platform capabilities. 

  • Ensuring high-priority mobile experiences meet the shared quality bar. 

  • Resolving gaps among customer needs, design intent, platform capabilities, and implementation. 

  • Improving reuse, adoption, and consistency without suppressing necessary product innovation. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, mobile experience design, design systems, interaction design, or a related discipline. 

  • Demonstrated experience setting mobile product or experience strategy across multiple products, platforms, or business areas. 

  • Deep expertise designing both native iOS and Android experiences and adaptive or responsive mobile experiences. 

  • Exceptional interaction-design and systems-thinking skills, with a portfolio showing complex mobile workflows and reusable patterns. 

  • Strong understanding of Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design, mobile accessibility standards, and the conventions and capabilities of modern mobile platforms. 

  • Experience determining when experiences should be native, adaptive, responsive, or coordinated across multiple surfaces. 

  • Ability to translate customer and product needs into principles, frameworks, patterns, standards, and actionable design direction. 

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior design, product, and engineering partners across a complex, matrixed organization. 

  • Experience creating prototypes and reference experiences that clarify strategy, behavior, and design intent. 

  • Strong understanding of enterprise workflows, platform products, shared services, and the challenges of designing for complex or regulated environments. 

  • Experience using research, analytics, audits, and qualitative evidence to identify systemic opportunities and measure progress. 

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, storytelling, and critique skills across practitioner and executive audiences. 

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor designers and raise craft and strategic capability without formal management authority. 

Preferred Qualifications
