title: Sr Software Engineer - Veza
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza(part of ServiceNow now) is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem  across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources  providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.  

Founded in 2020 , Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry. 

Job Description

About the Team: 

The Access Security team is building the intelligence layer for the ServiceNow Veza Identity solution, helping enterprises answer one of their most important security questions: who and what can access critical resources, and what should be done about it? We turn complex identity and access data into clear, actionable product experiences so customers can uncover risky access, prioritize remediation, and reduce exposure before issues become incidents. 

We are looking for a full stack Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, optimize, and maintain Access Security features that use AI to improve access intelligence, risk detection, and remediation workflows. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end product experiences, from React-based interfaces and API design to secure, scalable backend services and AI-assisted workflows that operate reliably in enterprise environments. This role requires expertise in Go, Python, JavaScript, and React, practical AI integration experience, and ownership across the full software development lifecycle. 

As a full stack engineer, you will shape both the user experience and the services behind it, translating complex access intelligence into intuitive workflows, responsive interfaces, and reliable APIs that help security teams move from insight to action. 

What you’ll do:  

  • Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to define product experiences that balance customer value, usability, technical depth, performance, and business impact. 
  • Champion the responsible use of LLM frameworks, AI agents, and AI-driven access intelligence to create differentiated enterprise capabilities for identity and access use cases. 
  • Explore emerging technologies and patterns in identity and access management that help us deliver greater customer value while improving solution resilience, scalability, and performance. 
  • Participate in all technical aspects of team deliverables, including architecture, design, quality, performance, maintainability, and code reviews. 
  • Integrate automated testing into development workflows to ensure consistent quality across releases.  
  • Design and build intuitive, performant user interfaces that help customers investigate access risk, understand recommendations, and take remediation actions with confidence. 
  • Adopt and improve engineering practices, raising quality standards, and fostering continuous improvement in testing, reliability, and production readiness. 
  • Own end-to-end feature delivery, steering capabilities from early product discovery and architecture through implementation, release, operational oversight, and ongoing stability. 

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of identity security, AI, and full stack product engineering, with room to influence technical direction, shape customer-facing experiences, and help define how enterprises understand and remediate access risk. 

Qualifications

  • Applied AI experience: Practical experience integrating AI, ML, or LLM capabilities into production workflows, such as decision support, risk analysis, automation, or security-focused access intelligence. 
  • Experience: 8+ years in full stack software development, with technical hands-on experience building complex Enterprise production software including frontend and backend portions 
  • Languages and architecture: Strong proficiency in Go, JavaScript, and TypeScript, along with other key programming languages such as Python or Java, with the ability to make sound architectural decisions across frontend and backend systems. 
  • Apply modern frontend engineering practices, including component design, state management, accessibility, observability, and frontend performance optimization. 
  • Data and APIs: Expertise designing and implementing RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs, with proficiency in data modeling, SQL, relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and graph technologies. 
  • Systems Engineering: Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization. 
  • Leadership: Proven track record of delivering complete end-to-end solutions from conception to launch. 
  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Soft Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Domain Expertise: Prior experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), IGA, and PAM solutions. 
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
  • Artificial Intelligence: Hands-on familiarity building with cutting-edge LLM frameworks and provider libraries like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google.

title: Staff Data Platform Software Engineer - veza
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance. 

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents.  For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate Staff Software Engineer to join Veza's Graph Data Platform team. You will play a key role in designing, improving, and maintaining the robust and scalable code behind the Veza Access Graph, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to shape the future of our products and deliver exceptional identity and access management experiences to our customers. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the growth and success of a high-impact team while working on cutting-edge technologies.

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership

  • Act as the technical expert for the Veza Access Graph, identifying broad challenges — technical, functional, or business — and parsing them into initiatives the org can execute against
  • Solve complex problems with no established precedent in the org or the field, from architecture through implementation
  • Serve as the dependable subject-matter expert (SME) for your area; define coding standards and engineering best practices for the team
  • Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce redundancy, and drive large-scale simplification across the platform
  • Deliver significant direct technical contributions while independently driving workstream-level design reviews
  • Set the bar for code quality, testing, documentation, and support — and share best practices with teammates in a consumable format

Roadmap & Execution

  • Set roadmap and prioritization for workstreams in your area; drive planning, design, and delegation of key components to ICs and stakeholders
  • Identify gaps, dependencies, and unresolved problems; partner with customers and stakeholders to close them
  • Proactively refine technical requirements in alignment with key stakeholders
  • Operate autonomously, consistently delivering high-quality work on time

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Break complex roadmaps into clear workstreams, milestones, and timelines, driving alignment and buy-in across PMs, TPMs, EMs, TLs, ICs, and dependency teams
  • Represent your team's roadmap and dependencies in company-wide initiatives
  • Coach and mentor team leads and ICs; help define interview loops, identify talent gaps, and build coaching plans to close them
  • Drive collaboration, conflict resolution, and stakeholder buy-in to unblock projects and ensure successful delivery
  • Model ServiceNow's core values and contribute feedback to improve team culture

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional backend software development experience, with a focus on scalable distributed systems, data management, identity, security, or related domains
  • Distributed systems fundamentals — consistency models, partitioning/sharding, replication, consensus, failure modes at scale
  • Graph database internals — traversal algorithms, query planning/optimization, indexing strategies (not just querying an existing graph API)
  • Go at a systems-programming level — concurrency patterns, memory/performance tuning, and production experience building and testing backend services
  • Large-scale data modeling — schema design for graphs handling high cardinality/fan-out
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs in microservice architectures
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization / orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with caching mechanisms in distributed systems
  • Track record of technical decisions with org-wide blast radius — not just execution within an assigned mandate
  • Experience setting technical direction or standards adopted by multiple teams
  • Systems design for correctness and rollback safety in high-stakes infrastructure (access/identity data qualifies)
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering — using LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate design exploration, code review, debugging, and documentation, while knowing when to trust generated output versus verifying it against source, tests, or runtime behavior

Nice to have:

  • Storage engine or query engine experience — having built or deeply modified one (Neo4j internals or a comparable engine)
  • Deep knowledge of relational algebra and graph algorithms, with experience across OLTP and OLAP systems
  • Track record of using AI tools to multiply personal and team output on complex, large-codebase work — beyond autocomplete-level usage
  • Identity and access management concepts (RBAC/ABAC, permission graphs, entitlement modeling)
  • Security or compliance-adjacent engineering background
  • Graduate degree

You Are:

  • A rigorous problem-solver who instinctively verifies assumptions rather than guessing — you dig into logs, code, and system behavior before proposing a fix, and you're comfortable being wrong in public if it gets the team to the right answer faster.
  • Someone who thrives with ambiguity: you can take a vague mandate ("make the graph queries faster," "harden this for scale") and turn it into a scoped plan with clear tradeoffs, then execute it independently — while knowing exactly when to loop others in.
  • A systems thinker who considers blast radius and reversibility before making changes to critical infrastructure — especially in a domain like ours, where a subtle bug in the access graph has real security consequences.
  • A strong communicator who can explain why a traversal algorithm is O(n²) to another engineer and why that matters for customer-facing latency to a product manager — without losing precision or condescending to either audience.
  • Fluent with AI as a working tool, not a crutch — you use it to move faster through exploration, boilerplate, and first drafts, but you still own the correctness of what ships, and you can tell the difference between "the model sounds confident" and "this is actually verified."
  • Someone who treats AI-assisted output the same way you'd treat a junior engineer's PR — useful, often good, but reviewed with the same rigor as anything else before it touches production.
  • A mentor who multiplies the team's effectiveness, not just your own — you review code like you're teaching, you pair when it helps someone level up, and you measure your impact partly by how the engineers around you grow.
  • Someone who leaves things better than you found them: documentation, test coverage, runbooks, and team practices all improve because you touched them.
  • Low-ego and high-trust — you can disagree strongly in a design review and still buy the team a round after it's decided.
  • A pleasure to work with — even at 2am during an incident.

title: Sr Software Engineering Manager - Veza
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza(part of ServiceNow now) is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem  across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources  providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.  

Founded in 2020 , Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry. 

Job Description

About the Team  

We are seeking a passionate, experienced Sr Software Engineering Manager to lead Veza's NHI and Agent Security team, which is redefining next-generation security at Veza. The team is advancing Agent Identity Security as AI agents and copilots rapidly expand across enterprise systems. The team drives innovation, defines next-generation IGA for non-human identities and agents, and helps shape new industry standards as the AI agent ecosystem evolves. Its work includes discovering agents, tracking their actions, and defining access management and runtime authorization capabilities to maintain a strong security posture.  

This is a high-impact leadership role at the center of the engineering organization. 

You will combine engineering leadership with deep technical partnership by leading skilled engineers and tech leads and setting the technical vision for NHI and Agent Security. You will work closely with product, integrations, and security engineering teams to expand Veza’s capabilities as the company scales within the ServiceNow ecosystem. 

Technical Leadership 

  • Own the technical vision and roadmap for Veza's NHI and Agent Security team - the core team that drives visibility, and governance of NHI and Agent Identities. 
  • Drive architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices for building enterprise systems. 
  • Partner with the Tech leads and Senior Engineers on high-impact technical decisions, conducting design and code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to engineering standards. 
  • Identify and champion new technologies, tools, and approaches, including AI/ML, to continuously advance the product development. 
  • Ensure the product is built and maintained with high performance, reliability, and observability, including logging, monitoring, and compliance requirements. 
  • Define and drive detailed engineering execution plans, timelines, and processes that keep the team shipping with quality and predictability. 
  • Shape our long-term agent identity security roadmap alongside the Product team and help define industry standards for discovering agents, auditing actions taken on agents, securing runtime authorization, and ensuring least privilege access management. 

Cross-functional Collaboration 

  • Work closely with Product, Integrations, Platform, Graph and other product teams to achieve business objectives and build product that meets customer needs 
  • Partner with other ServiceNow teams to drive and unlock next-gen identity governance.  

People Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of backend software engineers and tech leads, building individual development plans and creating stretch opportunities. 
  • Own the full talent lifecycle for the team - hiring, onboarding, retention, and performance. 

Qualifications

Experience 

  • 10+ years of experience in backend software engineering with a strong focus on distributed systems, or identity security, and 4+ years in an engineering leadership role - ideally spanning both startup and enterprise SaaS environments. 
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into product workflows, or leveraging AI to enhance product experience, or system intelligence at scale - strongly preferred. 
  • Familiarity with emerging AI technologies and frameworks, with a track record of driving AI adoption and leveraging AI-driven tools to enhance team productivity and engineering efficiency. 
  • Familiarity with IGA or how traditionals systems are evolving with Agents. 
  • Deep familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), distributed systems, and containerization technologies such as Kubernetes. 
  • Experience with authentication, authorization protocols, and IAM concepts — understanding how identity and access relationships are structured across complex enterprise environments. 
  • Hands-on engineering background with proficiency in one or more of Go, Java, or Python — comfortable diving into the codebase and engaging at a technical depth appropriate for a player-coach role. 

Leadership 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and grow a fully distributed, high-performing engineering team - hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and retaining strong engineers and tech leads. 
  • Strong organizational and project management skills - able to run multiple workstreams, maintain engineering cadence, and keep delivery on track without micromanaging. 
  • Clear, proactive communicator who can translate complex technical concepts for both engineering teams and senior leadership. 

Who You Are 

  • Relentlessly high standards - never satisfied with the status quo, always looking for a better way. 
  • Able to dive deep without losing sight of the big picture - never out of touch with the technical details, never lost in them either. 
  • Low ego, high intellectual curiosity - you hire people smarter than you and create the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Working experience with at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP), including its core compute, networking, and IAM primitives.

  • Solid working knowledge of containers, CI/CD and GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Strong programming skills in Go (or another systems language with a willingness to work primarily in Go).

It also helps if you have:

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team Bio: 

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. 

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise. 

Why This Role Matters:

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. 

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries. 

Who You Are:

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact. 

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points. 

You will: 

  • Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI 
  • Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments 
  • Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements 
  • Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams  

What You’ll Do: 

  • Deliver Production - readysolution in agile end-to-end sprints
  • Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components 
  • Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed 
  • Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers 
  • Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code 

What Success Looks Like:

  • Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments 
  • Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects 
  • Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives 
  • Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts 
  • Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one 

Qualifications

What You Bring:

  • Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
  • Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles 
  • System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments 
  • Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL) 
  • Machine Learning: Foundations of MLflow, Weights & Biases, LoRA, PEFT, SageMaker, Vertex AI, AzureML, Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, SHAP, LIME, pandas, Spark, SQL
  • LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management 
  • Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring 
  • Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org 
  • Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale 
  • DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code 
  • Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce 
  • Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments 
  • Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Integrations (Tech Lead) — Veza
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem  across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources  providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance. 

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents.  For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate Senior Staff (Tech Lead) Software Engineer who will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining product features of our IAM platform for our Integrations. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to implement robust and scalable solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. 
The Integrations team builds the services which ingest data from external integrations (e.g. AWS, Okta) into the Veza platform, enabling Veza's suite of next-gen features across our wide and growing array of supported integrations. You will be exposed to a breadth of software products and have the opportunity to dig deep into large and complex data systems as you determine an efficient, yet comprehensive way to represent each integration's unique access relationships in Veza's data model. You will also drive the scalable way of adding integrations leveraging the latest AI/ML models.

Veza can only do what its integrations enable; you will work closely with all other engineering teams as you enable them to consume your integrations' data and provide advanced tools to allow our customers to easily manage their entire Enterprise ecosystem.

What you will do

  • Design, develop, and build integrations with services like AWS, GCP, Azure and resources like Box, Hashicorp, Databricks. These integrations have to be built ensuring high performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Lead a team of backend software engineers, providing mentorship and guidance to help them grow their skills and expertise.
  • Drive the technical direction for assigned projects,defining architecture, design patterns, best practices and leveraging the latest AI/ML models for integrations.
  • Partner with Product, Solutions Engineering, Support, and customers to translate requirements into connector designs and prioritize the integration roadmap.

We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where our employees feel empowered, take pride in their work, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.  

About the Team – Global Security Support Center (GSSC)  

The Global Security Support Center (GSSC) at ServiceNow is a diverse and highly skilled team of security professionals who play a pivotal role in strengthening both our internal and external security posture. The team collaborates closely with various functions across the company and serves as a key interface with our customers on security-related matters.  

Through expertise, communication, and a commitment to excellence, the GSSC team reinforces ServiceNow's reputation as a security-first organization, consistently demonstrating our commitment to protecting our platform, our data, and our customers.  

GSSC Mission Statement: To provide external & internal facing security support on behalf of the Security Organization to improve our customers' security posture and build Customer trust.  

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Represent security organization in customer-facing Security Incidents, cases, Security findings, tasks, questions and calls related to Security & Privacy.  
  • Own, triage, investigate and respond to security matters of the ServiceNow platform, ensuring timely communication, resolution and enhanced customer experience and processes.  
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all security-related matters in ServiceNow, supporting both internal and external stakeholders.  
  • Facilitate the efficient workflow/triage of security-related incidents/cases by collaborating with customers and other internal ServiceNow teams.  
  • Build and maintain a high level of customer trust and confidence through exceptional service and communication.  
  • Manage customer outreach communications on Security & escalation handling.  
  • Understand and deliver excellent capability maturity models to fine-tune security processes.  
  • Create and enhance documentation and processes to strengthen security maturity and operational excellence.  
  • Develop and deliver training/enablement programs on Security, for internal and external customers on security awareness and best practices.  
  • Develop AI Solutions for automating repetitive activities & design new solutions leveraging AI.  
  • Work with Legal on security/privacy-related matters & a global team spread across different time zones, so flexibility of times is required.  
  • Provide support and be available as a responsible resource for the On-Call rotation (weekends, public holidays, and after hours) as rostered.  
  • This role may require access to a Protected B cloud environment. The successful candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Government of Canada Reliability Status under PSPC's Contract Security Program. Clearance is a condition of employment in this function. The company will sponsor and support the screening process through its designated Company Security Officer. 

To be successful in this role, you have: 

  • A minimum of 8 years of professional experience in information security or application security roles. Or similar experience with education 
  • Candidate must be eligible to obtain and hold a reliability status in Canada. 
  • Preferred Certifications (Two or more)  
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) 
  • Azure AI Fundamentals  
  • AWS Certified AI Practitioner  
  • Offensive Security Web Assessor (OSWA)  
  • GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT)  
  • GIAC Security Essentials Certification (GSEC)  
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)  
  • CISSP  
  • CISM  

Qualifications

Technical Skills: 

  • Solid understanding of cloud computing models and major hyperscaler cloud models.  
  • Hands-on experience with using and understanding security tools and technologies, including: SIEM solutions, logging tools, load balancers, firewalls, WAFs, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management platforms, encryption techniques, etc.  
  • Basic to Intermediate-level programming knowledge in Java/JavaScript with the ability to read, interpret & understand to explain code effectively.  
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in using web proxy tools for security testing and assessments.  
  • Application Security: In-depth understanding of web application vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top Ten) and corresponding mitigation strategies.  
  • Risk Management: Ability to clearly explain security risks to non-technical stakeholders using straightforward, non-technical language.  
  • Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge: Good knowledge of key compliance and regulatory frameworks including: NIST, CIS, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO standards, etc.  
  • Artificial Intelligence: Experience working with AI technologies and designing AI-based solutions.  
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to evaluate and address complex security challenges.  

Soft Skills & Communication:  

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to a non-technical audience.  
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a team-oriented, collaborative environment, working in a follow-the-sun model.  
  • Good understanding of Security concepts and articulating Security and risk in simple terms without using jargon that makes sense to customers.  

Education & Experience: 

  • Preferred Bachelor's degree in computer science or information security or relevant information security experience.  
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience with web-based vulnerability exploitation is a strong plus for success in this role.

  • 5+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a related technical role. 
  • 5+ years of customer-facing technical, pre-sales, or customer support experience. 
  • Experience supporting complex cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise platform sales cycles with enterprise customers. 
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, identity and access, governance and risk, and security operations. 
  • Required strong working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, firewalls, DNS, NAT, and network segmentation. 
  • Familiarity with capturing network traffic via SPAN ports, port mirroring, TAPs, packet capture brokers, NetFlow, and network telemetry. 
  • Ability to understand and explain how security platforms integrate with customer network environments to collect data, provide visibility, and support technical validation during demos, POVs, and POCs. 
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills. 
  • Ability to engage effectively with technical practitioners, business stakeholders, and executive buyers. 
  • Demonstrated track record of contributing to technical wins, deal progression, and successful customer outcomes. 
  • BS degree in Computer Science, MIS, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Hands-on experience with IAM or IGA solutions 
  • Background in Security Operations or security engineering 
  • Experience with asset discovery across IoT, OT, or IoMT environments 
  • Exposure to vulnerability management or risk-based vulnerability programs 
  • Security, cloud, or relevant technical certifications preferred 
  • Linux or Python scripting experience

ServiceNow current compliance initiatives are focused on, but not limited regional programs such as Spanish ENS, French HDS, Italy QC2, UK Cyber Essentials Plus, and a deep understanding and experience with global programs such as ISO 27001, ISO 27018, PCI, and SOC 2.   • Facilitate certifier requests and information gathering for external and internal audits

  • Liaise with Risk Management and conduct security risk assessment activities   
  • Help our customers understand ServiceNow’s security and compliance control environment  
  • Contribute towards enhancing the GRC tool and processes to meet compliance business needs  

Qualifications

Qualifications 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • 8+ years working in the field of cyber security compliance, security risk or audit or similar experience plus education 
  • Direct and recent working experience with at least three of the following compliance programs: ISO 27001, PCI, UK Cyber Essentials Plus, Spanish ENS, France HDS, TISAX & C5 in Germany, and/or SOC2 
  • Prior experience working in the Security and Compliance group at a SaaS/Cloud company or with Security and Risk practice of a Big Four firm

Company Description

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem  across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources  providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

About the team 

The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning. 

This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like. 

The role 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you own the architecture of an security harness with novel exploitability engine end to end, and you’re accountable for the decisions that shape everything downstream. You set technical direction, make the hard calls defensible, and multiply the engineers around you. 

What you’ll own 

  • The end-to-end architecture of the exploitability engine—from evidence ingestion and entity resolution, through the attack-path probability core and choke-point ranking, to the validation loop that keeps predictions honest. 
  • The decisions that cascade through the system: calibrated probability versus ordinal rank, identity as a first-class graph edge, assume-breach seeding, and how the most critical assets are defined. These are model-shaping calls, not implementation details. 
  • The probabilistic ranking core: edge-traversal probability, guided path search with hop and likelihood limits, correlated-control-failure modeling, and honest uncertainty bands. 
  • The calibration and validation loop—canaries, purple-team and incident replay, calibration measured by zone and vector—that turns modeled weights into evidence rather than opinion. 
  • Make-or-break metrics as first-class engineering targets, starting with entity-resolution accuracy and calibration quality. 
  • The build-on strategy—extending the existing portfolio rather than rebuilding it, and knowing precisely what to reuse and what must be net-new. 

What you’ll do 

  • Lead zero-to-one work at production scale: turn an ambiguous, novel problem into a reliable system other teams build on, and set the bar where no precedent exists. 
  • Drive technical direction across architecture, design, and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar across the incubation. 
  • Mentor senior engineers and lead by influence, not title. 
  • Partner with product, security R&D, SecOps to turn customer problems into architecture, and translate that architecture into decisions leaders can act on. 
  • Establish AI safety, security, governance, and guardrails for agentic systems running in production. 

What you bring 

  • A track record of owning architecture across a large system or multiple teams, with deep experience operating production-quality software. 
  • Hands-on depth in both agentic and LLM systems and probabilistic or ML-driven scoring—graph modeling, calibration, search and optimization, or risk and probability engineering. 
  • Proven zero-to-one at scale: you’ve taken an ambiguous problem to a reliable production system that others depend on. 
  • The judgment to make consequential architecture decisions under uncertainty, and make them defensible to engineers and executives alike. 
  • Command of distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native development, and data or graph systems. 
  • Expert-level Python, and/or Java, Go, or TypeScript. 
  • Technical leadership and mentorship that moves teams through influence. 
  • Applied interest in security problems—attack-path analysis, vulnerability management, identity security, threat intelligence, or detection and response—is strongly preferred. 
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Windsurf is a plus. 
  • Experience with AI evaluation, safety, governance, or policy guardrails is a plus. 

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including leading the design and delivery of complex production systems. 
  • The primary skills required are Predictive Modeling, Graph ML, Security Analytics, Anomaly Detection, Risk Scoring, LLMs/Agentic AI, and MLOps, which align with advanced machine learning and AI engineering rather than traditional software development.
  • Demonstrated experience as the technical owner or lead for a major system or across teams. 
  • Depth building AI/ML-powered production systems; probabilistic modeling, graph analytics, or calibration and evaluation is a strong plus. 
  • Modern AI experience: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, agentic harness and workflows, model evaluation, or AI observability. 
  • Strong programming experience in Python and/or Java, Go, or a similar language. 
  • Cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, APIs, databases, and scalable architectures. 
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Cybersecurity or security-product experience, or familiarity with modern security architectures and operations, is strongly preferred.

Job Description

About the Team

AI Engineering and Delivery is the customer-obsessed engineering group building the agentic AI and enterprise-scale search systems that power Now Assist, AI Agents, and the AI-driven experiences our customers rely on every day. We build AI as foundational platform infrastructure — prioritizing robustness, performance, safety, and real-world customer impact at scale.

Types of problems you’ll get to work on

You will design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems embedded across ServiceNow's platform — autonomous agents that reason over real enterprise data, take action across workflows, and run safely at Fortune 500 scale.

Your core focus areas:

  • Agentic architecture. Design and ship multi-agent systems — orchestration, tool use, planning loops, memory, and failure recovery — that operate reliably in production, not in notebooks.
  • Enterprise-grounded reasoning. Build agents that leverage ServiceNow's data layer — CMDB, Workflow Data Fabric, and Knowledge Graph — to make decisions with context no frontier model has on its own.
  • Trust, safety, and governance. Own the guardrails: observability, human-in-the-loop controls, and compliance infrastructure that make autonomous systems safe to deploy at scale.
  • Retrieval and grounding. Work closely with our search team to ensure agents are grounded in accurate, low-latency retrieval — RAG pipelines, hybrid search, re-ranking, and evaluation — as a critical dependency of agentic quality.
  • Model integration and evaluation. Integrate frontier models (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI) into the Sense → Decide → Act → Govern architecture; evaluate trade-offs across cost, latency, and capability for production use cases.
  • Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and coaching — particularly on agentic design patterns and production AI discipline.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
  • Hands-on depth designing, shipping, and operating agentic systems in production — multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, planning loops, memory, and failure recovery. Not prototypes.
  • Production-grade Python. Systems language (Go, Java, or C++) is a plus.
  • Required skills include React, Node.js, Python, Java, REST, GraphQL, SQL, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, and Kubernetes. These skills are currently listed under the Software Development Engineer role and are directly relevant to both positions.
  • Working experience with frontier AI SDKs (Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI) — prompt engineering, structured outputs, and model evaluation in production settings.
  • Familiarity with RAG and retrieval patterns in production — vector stores, hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation metrics.
  • Track record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers on production AI practices.

Nice to Have

  • Deeper specialization in search and retrieval at scale or MLOps/model observability.
  • Published work or open-source contributions in agentic systems or retrieval.
  • Exposure to LLM fine-tuning or inference optimization in production.

Why join us

Intelligence is commoditizing. Context and execution are not. With 100B+ workflows, 6.5T transactions a year, and 85% of the Fortune 500 on our platform, we are building the system that makes AI actually work inside the enterprise — Sense, Decide, Act, Govern.

What's shipping as we speak: AI Specialists autonomously resolving cases across IT, CRM, HR, and Security. Action Fabric opening our full system of action to any external agent via MCP — Anthropic's Claude Cowork is the first design partner. Project Arc with NVIDIA bringing governed autonomous desktop agents into production. Build Agent live inside Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. AI Control Tower with kill-switch capabilities and cross-vendor agent governance. These are production systems at Fortune 500 scale, not roadmap slides.

You'd work across three problem spaces at the frontier of what we do: 

Autonomous Enterprise: Self-driving business processes grounded in CMDB, Workflow Data Fabric, and Knowledge Graph — context no frontier lab can replicate, 

Omni-channel AI Resolution: Production voice, chat, and computer-use agents with generative UI, live with customers today, 

AI Control Tower: Identity, entitlements, and audit-grade compliance for every agentic system in the enterprise — nobody else has this layer.

You will build the substrate that connects all four: SENSE (any data) → DECIDE (any AI model) → ACT (any workflow) → GOVERN (identity + governance). The architectural inflection point is now.

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

About the team 

The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning. 

This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like. 

The role 

As a Staff ML Engineer, you own a major subsystem of a novel exploitability engine end to end—for example the probability core, the exposure graph and entity-resolution layer, or the calibration and validation loop. You make the design calls within your area and drive them to production. 

What you’ll own 

  • A major subsystem end-to-end—the probability core, the exposure graph and entity resolution, or the calibration and validation loop—including its design, delivery, and quality. 
  • The design decisions within your subsystem, and how it interfaces with the rest of the engine. 
  • The metrics that prove your subsystem works—entity-resolution accuracy, calibration quality, or path-ranking precision—owned as first-class targets. 
  • Technical direction for the engineers working in your area. 

What you’ll do 

  • Take a major, ambiguous subsystem from design through production at scale. 
  • Drive design and code reviews in your area, and raise the engineering bar around you. 
  • Mentor engineers and lead a workstream through influence. 
  • Partner with product, security R&D, and SecOps to turn customer problems into subsystem design. 
  • Establish AI safety, security, and guardrails for the agentic parts of your subsystem. 

What you bring 

  • A track record of owning a significant system or subsystem end-to-end in production. 
  • Hands-on depth in agentic and LLM systems and/or probabilistic or ML-driven scoring—graph modeling, calibration, search and optimization. 
  • The primary skills required are Predictive Modeling, Graph ML, Security Analytics, Anomaly Detection, Risk Scoring, LLMs/Agentic AI, and MLOps, which align with advanced machine learning and AI engineering rather than traditional software development.
  • Proven delivery of an ambiguous problem to a reliable production system that others depend on. 
  • The judgment to make sound design decisions under uncertainty within your area. 
  • Command of distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native development, and data or graph systems. 
  • Expert-level Python, and/or Java, Go, or TypeScript. 
  • Technical leadership that moves a workstream through influence. 
  • Applied interest in security problems—attack-path analysis, vulnerability management, identity security, threat intelligence, or detection and response—is preferred. 
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Windsurf is a plus. 
  • Experience with AI evaluation, safety, governance, or policy guardrails is a plus. 

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including leading the design and delivery of complex production components. 
  • The primary skills required are Predictive Modeling, Graph ML, Security Analytics, Anomaly Detection, Risk Scoring, LLMs/Agentic AI, and MLOps. These skills align more closely with advanced machine learning and AI engineering than with traditional software development.
  • Demonstrated experience as the technical owner or lead for a significant system or subsystem. 
  • Depth building AI/ML-powered production systems; probabilistic modeling, graph analytics, or calibration and evaluation is a strong plus. 
  • Modern AI experience: RAG, embeddings, vector search, agentic workflows, model evaluation, or AI observability. 
  • Strong programming experience in Python and/or Java, Go, or a similar language. 
  • Cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, APIs, databases, and scalable architectures. 
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Cybersecurity or security-product experience, or familiarity with modern security architectures and operations, is strongly preferred.

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. The Staff Compliance Analyst will be responsible for contributing to and executing on the Certification strategy as defined by Security Compliance leadership. This consists of maintaining existing third-party assurance programs already held by ServiceNow, as well as driving the analysis and adoption of new programs as directed by ServiceNow leadership. This role will work collaboratively with members of the Sales, Security, and Operations teams. 

This role will also effectively monitor ServiceNow’s controls by understanding intent, and implementation of controls, as well as drive changes within the organization through effective testing. The successful candidate must be reliable, resourceful and have a “can-do” attitude. 

What you get to do in this role:  
  
We’re looking for a highly motivated, collaborative and technically experienced Staff Compliance Analyst with ability to understand and influence cloud operational and security processes, effectively communicate ServiceNow’s controls including intent, and drive changes within the organization through effective testing, and bring an understanding of how to effectively leverage AI to scale compliance for the future. The successful candidate must be reliable, resourceful and have a “can-do” attitude.   
  
You will be a key member of our team and play an important role in defining the Security and Compliance framework for a leading cloud company. In this role you will be required to demonstrate ability to analyse difficult problems, think out-of-box and provide pragmatic solutions and recommendations.    

ServiceNow current compliance initiatives are focused on, but not limited regional programs such as Spanish ENS, French HDS, Italy QC2, UK Cyber Essentials Plus, and a deep understanding and experience with global programs such as ISO 27001, ISO 27018, PCI, and SOC 2. The Senior Cyber Security Compliance Analyst will be involved in driving and measuring compliance for the cloud business systems, control areas, process, and product for company compliance initiatives.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Job Description

The Customer Success Executive is accountable for the strategic leadership and execution of post-sales activities within our most valuable accounts. This position plays a crucial role in driving ServiceNow’s long-term value by accelerating customers’ journey to success, ensuring predictable renewals, and maximizing the impact of ServiceNow across their business transformation initiatives.

As a trusted advisor, you’ll partner with C-level executives, guide seamless delivery of business transformation, and foster collaboration with ServiceNow’s teams and strategic partners.

What You Get to Do in This Role:

  • Drive Post-Sales Success: Own and lead the customer’s post-sales transformation, aligning ServiceNow’s offerings to customer goals, and bringing relevant industry thought-leadership to the table. Foster strong relationships with C-Level executives to deliver on business outcomes.
  • Collaborate Strategically: Partner with Account Executives to create and execute integrated pre- and post-sales strategies, delivering long-term value for both the customer and ServiceNow. Leverage the right resources at the right time to ensure success.
  • Mitigate Risks and Drive Value: Proactively identify potential risks to success and work with the customer and internal teams to develop strategies to overcome them, ensuring a smooth path toward value realization.
  • Focus on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Guide and inspire the Customer Success team to meet critical operational KPIs—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Work closely with customers to align their roadmap and drive new revenue opportunities.
  • Foster Strategic Alignment: Build relationships with ServiceNow leaders and consistently incorporate customer feedback to drive continuous improvement. Align business transformation insights with organizational goals to ensure long-term success.
  • Advocate for Innovation and Continuous Learning: As a strategic thought leader, drive innovative solutions for our customers, always looking for opportunities to help them achieve their long-term goals. Foster a culture of agility and calculated risk-taking within the team.
  • Set Success Metrics and Milestones: Establish clear, measurable success metrics with the customer, and regularly review progress. Refine business transformation plans as needed to ensure milestones are met and value is realized.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. You will be an expert in governance, strategy, and execution across cross-functional teams and have a track record of delivering scalable, repeatable success. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • Educational Background: BA/BS or equivalent required, Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: A minimum of 12 years in a management consulting or leadership role at a top-tier consulting firm, solution consulting, or similar positions focused on technology-enabled business transformations (Digital/SaaS/Enterprise Software).
  • Leadership Expertise: Demonstrated success in running large-scale, strategic accounts and exceeding business objectives. Proven track record in building and leading high-performing Customer Success or Consulting teams.
  • Business Acumen: Strong experience in identifying and solving complex business problems and aligning solutions with customer business objectives.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: A history of working across multiple functions and driving alignment in large, matrixed environments.
  • C-Level Relationships: Strong experience building relationships with C-level business leaders, including within some of the world’s largest enterprises.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in rapidly changing environments, adapting strategies to new challenges and opportunities.
  • Execution Focus: Ability to create repeatable processes for scalable execution while maintaining a hands-on approach to ensure critical tasks are completed efficiently.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Excellent communicator and influencer, with the ability to work effectively across a global organization and foster collaboration at all levels.
  • Customer Focus: Deep understanding of customer needs, challenges, and motivations, with a keen ability to address concerns and ensure satisfaction.

Position Overview:

The Executive Assistant is a force multiplier and operational partner to the Senior Executive Assistant, supporting the executive office of the President and Chief Financial Officer. This role focuses on event execution, communications support, administrative operations, and after-hours backup. The Executive Assistant reports to the Senior Executive Assistant and works under their strategic direction on all complex or executive-facing decisions. 

The Sr. EA retains ownership of calendar management, strategic cross-functional coordination, executive communications strategy, and complex vendor relationships. The Executive Assistant amplifies the Sr. EA's capacity by owning execution on defined operational areas. 

Key Responsibilities:

Event Coordination & Logistics: 

  • Execute event planning and logistics under Sr. EA strategic direction, including departmental meetings, executive office events, and organization-wide initiatives (e.g., holiday parties, town halls, all-hands meetings)

Communications Support & Coordination:

Authority Level: Operational execution on defined responsibilities under Sr. EA direction. Does not own calendar strategy, executive communications strategy, or cross-functional coordination strategy. All executive-facing or strategic decisions escalate to Sr. EA.

  • 5+ years as an Executive assistant
  • This position will require trips to the Bay Area
  • Social media skills, including creating and managing content across platforms
  • Strong organizational and project management skills; ability to manage multiple priorities 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; professional correspondence ability 
  • Ability to work independently and follow Sr. EA direction without constant oversight 
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and logistics 
  • Ability to remain calm and problem-solve in high-pressure environments 
  • Proficiency with Outlook, Teams, Office 365, and calendar management software 
  • Demonstrated ability to follow processes and escalate appropriately 
  • Flexible, adaptable, and willing to adjust priorities as needed 
  • Discretion and professionalism in handling confidential information 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting C-suite or senior executive team 
  • Event planning and coordination experience 
  • Experience with vendor management and contract coordination 
  • Knowledge of financial operations or compliance requirements 
  • Experience working as part of a larger administrative team 

What Success Looks Like:

  • Sr. EA can delegate event execution without micromanaging logistics 
  • Routine communications are handled professionally without Sr. EA involvement 
  • Executive-facing communications always go through Sr. EA before delivery 
  • Calendar logistics are executed perfectly; Sr. EA owns the calendar strategy 
  • Urgent after-hours issues are handled competently or escalated immediately 
  • Sr. EA has more bandwidth for strategic work due to execution support 
  • No duplicate effort or parallel decision-making between Executive Assistant and Sr. EA 

Work Environment & Expectations:

  • Fast-paced environment with competing priorities and time-sensitive requests 
  • Occasional after-hours support for urgent executive needs 
  • Collaboration with Sr. EA, finance teams, compliance, and cross-functional partners 
  • High level of professionalism and confidentiality required 
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing circumstances and priorities 
  • Support role—all executive decisions and strategy owned by Sr. EA 

Key Distinctions: This Role vs. Senior Executive Assistant:

Executive Assistant OWNS:

Senior Executive Assistant OWNS:

Job Description

Team & Role

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with engineering and product management from the outset. 

The Design Systems team creates the shared foundations that help ServiceNow teams deliver consistent, accessible, and high-quality product experiences. As Platform and the business units adopt AI-assisted ways of working, designers and front-end engineers need clear standards, practical examples, and reliable ways to check that those standards are being applied. 

We're looking for a Principal Design Technologist to make design-system standards easier to understand, test, and implement. This role translates design-system standards and design files into clear specifications, design-owned coded reference components, validation tools, and implementation guidance. These resources show how an experience should look and behave before Engineering builds and maintains the production implementation. 

Across Design, this principal individual contributor will use deep design and web-development expertise to create coded explorations that demonstrate the intended experience, behavior, and quality of components and AI-enabled interactions. They will mentor product designers who use code to explore and communicate experience concepts and contribute practical insight to the development and adoption of AI-assisted design tools. The role leads through expertise and influence. Product and Engineering retain ownership of product strategy, technical architecture, production code, roadmaps, and delivery. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Work with Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering to set the direction for design-system tools and practices that improve quality and adoption across Platform and the business units. 
  • Create and maintain design-owned coded UI reference libraries based on design-system standards and source designs, including Figma where applicable. Use them to demonstrate component states, interactions, responsive behavior, accessibility expectations, and use of design tokens. Engineering owns the production of component libraries and their technical implementation. 
  • Evaluate and create AI-assisted tools that help teams find, apply, and check design-system guidance. Define practical ways to assess whether the tools are accurate, useful, understandable, and aligned with approved standards. 
  • Partner with front-end engineering teams to identify recurring differences between approved designs and delivered experiences. Create design-side review and validation methods that surface issues earlier, and use what teams learn during implementation to improve shared standards, reference components, and guidance. 
  • Lead the adoption of AI tools across Design by evaluating emerging tools, setting responsible working practices, and providing playbooks, demonstrations, workshops, and peer learning that help designers improve quality and work more efficiently. 
  • Mentor and connect product designers who use code to prototype AI experiences. Establish shared working practices, align their explorations with the design system, and turn useful lessons into reusable guidance for the broader design organization. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering on the contribution process that enables experts across Design, Engineering, Product, Accessibility, Platform, and the business units to propose, review, and maintain design-system guidance and reference materials. 
  • Partner with Design Enablement and Engineering Operations to help front-end UI engineers use the design system effectively. Contribute design-system onboarding, training, implementation guidance, reference examples, and validation practices, while Engineering Operations leads engineering processes and adoption within the front-end community. 

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 12+ years of experience in product design, design systems, design technology, prototyping, or a related discipline within complex, enterprise-scale products. 
  • A portfolio or body of work demonstrating strong systems thinking, interaction and visual craft, and the ability to turn design standards into reusable guidance, reference components, and tools. 
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks such as Lit and Web Components, with the ability to build coded prototypes and design-owned reference components that clearly demonstrate intended appearance and behavior. 
  • Deep knowledge of design systems, including components, patterns, design tokens, themes, accessibility, responsive behavior, localization, governance, and contribution processes. 
  • Experience using AI to improve design work, such as helping teams find guidance, create and review design-system content, check quality, or automate repeatable tasks. Experience defining appropriate human review and responsible-use practices. 
  • Experience using or extending design tools such as Figma, documentation platforms, component catalogs, analytics, plugins, or automated design-quality and accessibility checks. 
  • Demonstrated success setting direction and influencing senior partners across Design, Product, Engineering, Accessibility, and AI in a complex, distributed organization. 
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, and mentoring skills, with a record of helping a broad design organization adopt AI tools, shared standards, and new ways of working. 

Basic Qualifications:  

  • Experience contributing throughout the product development process for web or software products. 
  • Experience in user experience design, product design, design systems, design technology, prototyping, or related field. 
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across Product, Design, Accessibility, and Engineering.

Job Description

Team Bio: 

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. 

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise. 

Why This Role Matters:

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. 

As a Forward Deployed Solution Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries. 

Who You Are:

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact. 

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points. 

You will: 

  • Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI 
  • Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments 
  • Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements 
  • Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams  

What You’ll Do: 

  • Deliver Production - readysolution in agile end-to-end sprints
  • Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components 
  • Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed 
  • Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers 
  • Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code 

What Success Looks Like:

  • Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments 
  • Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects 
  • Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives 
  • Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts 
  • Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one 

Qualifications

What You Bring:

  • Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
  • Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles 
  • System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments 
  • Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL) 
  • Machine Learning: Foundations of MLflow, Weights & Biases, LoRA, PEFT, SageMaker, Vertex AI, AzureML, Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, SHAP, LIME, pandas, Spark, SQL
  • LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management 
  • Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring 
  • Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org 
  • Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale 
  • DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code 
  • Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce 
  • Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments 
  • Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds
