title: Director, Solution Consulting - CRM Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Why This Role Matters

You will lead one of  ServiceNow’s fastest-growing markets — and this team will be at the center of that momentum.

You’ll shape how we go to market, how we sell value, and how we build the next generation of Solution Consulting talent.

Job Description

As the Director, North CRM Solution Consulting, you run the day-to-day pre-sales engine for CRM across the Nordics, Benelux, Sweden, and adjacent markets. You lead first-line Solution Consulting managers and  individual contributors, and you are the leader closest to the deals.

You know what each team is working on, what is landing with customers, and what is stalling. Your job is to remove the blockers, keep the team focused and motivated, and make sure Solution Consulting moves in step with its CRM selling peers. This is an execution role at heart: you make the engine go fast.

You report to the AVP, EMEA CRM Solution Consulting, who sets regional strategy and direction.

What you'll do...

Own the number -- deliver CRM NNACV for EMEA North

  • Carry accountability, with your first-line managers, for EMEA North CRM NNACV targets and contribute to the EMEA goal of double-digit ACV growth.
  • Forecast technical win rates and deal-by-deal readiness, and raise risk to the AVP early rather than late.
  • Work with EMEA North CRM sales leaders to focus Solution Consulting time on the opportunities, use cases, and industries where CRM wins fastest.

Know the deals on the ground

  • Maintain a detailed, current view of what each team is working on: active opportunities, technical stage, proof-of-value status, and next steps.
  • Know what is working and what is not, and act on it in the weekly deal and pipeline rhythms rather than in a quarterly review.
  • Join key customer, POV, and escalation discussions where technical credibility or senior air cover is needed.

Remove blockers and keep the team focused

  • Be the first escalation point for anything that slows a deal: environment access, resourcing conflicts, unclear scope, product gaps, or competing demands.
  • Protect the team's time by clearing distractions, cutting low-value requests, and making sure ICs spend their time on the deals that matter most.
  • Make sure every IC knows what good looks like on their deals and has what they need to deliver it.

Lead and develop first-line leaders and ICs

  • Coach first-line managers on deal reviews, technical strategy, and POV execution, and hold them to consistent motions and communication rhythms.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain strong technical talent, and build a bench of ready-now first-line leaders.
  • Give direct, regular feedback to ICs and managers, and address performance issues early.

Keep the team motivated and aligned to selling peers

  • Recognize wins visibly and often, and build a team rhythm that keeps morale and momentum high.
  • Run joint pipeline and deal reviews with CRM sales, value, partner, and product counterparts so Solution Consulting and selling teams operate as one engine.
  • Agree coverage, account plans, and proof strategy with the AEs before they reach the customer.

Drive the shift to POV-centric selling and the FDE model

  • Make working proof-of-value the default way the team earns technical trust, and help ICs move toward the Forward Deployed Engineer model of building alongside customers.
  • Use AI automation tools and standard POV frameworks to speed up demos, environment provisioning, and repeatable assets.

Connect the field to CRM product

  • Channel technical wins, losses, and product gaps from your team to the AVP and CRM product leaders, using specific, deal-level examples.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 6+ years in a leadership role in Solution Consulting or a comparable pre-sales or technical sales function, including managing first-line leaders and individual contributors.
  • Still credible on the deals: you can scope a POV, work through an architecture question, or join a customer call without losing the thread.
  • A consistent record of owning and delivering against ACV / NNACV or equivalent revenue-tied targets in a software or SaaS environment.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across the Nordics, Benelux, Sweden, and adjacent markets and operating effectively across cultures, languages, and time zones.
  • A working understanding of the CRM market and how AI and agentic automation are changing it.
  • Fluency with AI and automation tools and a bias toward using them to simplify how work gets done.
  • Experience moving a team from demo-centric to POV / proof-of-value-centric selling.
  • Clear, direct communication, and the ability to set a standard and hold first-line leaders to it.
  • Good operating judgement: knows when to escalate, when to decide, and when to get out of the way.
  • A talent-focused leader who can recruit, develop, and retain strong technical leaders and ICs.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Expected to travel up to 40% of the time on average, including across the Nordics, Benelux, Sweden, and adjacent markets.

Job Description

Position overview

A Regional Product Manager (RPM) connects global product strategy to execution in a specific market. Product managers build features and own the core roadmap with engineering teams. An RPM takes that roadmap into one market, adapts it to local customers, regulations, and buying patterns, and owns its commercial success there. At ServiceNow, RPM markets are defined by geography, industry, or customer segment.

In this role, you will own one industry or customer segment in the Americas. You will be the person responsible for how ServiceNow's AI products are positioned, sold, adopted, and improved in that market. This is an individual contributor (IC) role, reporting to the leader of Regional Product Management for the Americas.

Key Responsibilities

Regional strategy and adaptation

  • Translate the global AI product roadmap into a plan for your industry or segment 
  • Tailor use cases, solution packages, and messaging to the operational problems your customers care about most 
  • Account for industry regulations and compliance requirements in how solutions are positioned and deployed 
  • Track AI adoption trends in your market and adjust priorities as they shift 

Go-to-market and sales enablement

  • Partner with sales, marketing, and channel partners to launch AI products into your market 
  • Run discovery on priority deals and shape buying criteria and deal sizing toward AI early in the sales cycle 
  • Build discovery guides, use case catalogs, demo stories, and value stories that sellers can reuse 
  • Make sure AI use cases go live after every win, working with customer success, professional services, and partners on success criteria, go-live dates, and adoption metrics

Commercial strategy and financial targets

  • Own the commercial strategy for your market, including product mix, packaging, and deal structure, to meet revenue and margin targets 
  • Set and own quarterly targets for deals in motion, AI attach, and discovery completed before close 
  • Work with pricing teams on packaging and discount guidance suited to your customers 

Voice of the customer

  • Act as the technical and commercial expert in the field for your market 
  • Gather customer feedback and turn repeated needs into solution requirements for product teams 
  • Test emerging AI ideas with customers and bring the ones with traction to the teams that build new products 
  • Represent ServiceNow with customer executives, at industry events, and in customer advisory sessions 

Competitive intelligence

  • Monitor competitors selling AI into your market, including industry-specific vendors and horizontal AI platforms 
  • Analyze win/loss data to find patterns in why deals are won, lost, or stalled 
  • Equip sales teams with positioning and responses to competitor claims 

Qualifications

To excel as a Regional Product Manager (RPM), you need a unique blend of commercial acumen, cross-cultural leadership, and technical credibility. Because you sit between global development teams and local sales teams, your skillset must balance strategic thinking with ground-level execution.

Commercial and strategic skills

  • You design and run launch plans suited to how your market buys, including the partners, procurement processes, and executives involved 
  • You can set packaging and discount guidance and judge how deal structure affects margin 
  • You turn regulatory and compliance requirements into specific changes in how solutions are built, positioned, and deployed 

Relationship and communication skills

  • You align product teams and field sellers on priorities without direct authority over either 
  • You understand how business and IT leaders in your market make decisions, and you adjust how you communicate with each 
  • You manage expectations with senior product and sales leaders while supporting account teams on high-stakes customer deals 

Analytical and technical skills

  • You use sales data, win/loss results, and market share trends to decide where to focus 
  • You know enterprise AI and platform technology well enough to handle complex objections and train sellers 
  • You turn large volumes of customer feedback into a short, ranked list of requirements product teams can act on 

Experience

  • 10+ years in product management, solution consulting, or go-to-market strategy in enterprise software 
  • Domain depth in at least one industry or customer segment, including its core systems, regulations, and buyers 
  • A track record of influencing enterprise deals through discovery, solution design, or deal structure 
  • Experience taking AI or automation use cases from concept to production at customers 
  • Familiarity with the ServiceNow AI Platform (a plus) 

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $199,100 - $348,400, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Consultant (IC4) to join our team in Brazil. This role requires a strong technical background across the ServiceNow platform, with particular depth in Integrations, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), App Engine, portals, and core platform development.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical expertise with strong consulting and governance skills, and has demonstrated knowledge of Artificial Intelligence capabilities and Now Assist implementation.

What you will do

You will guide revenue for ServiceNow with the support and partnership of Sales, Partner Ecosystem, Product Management, and the executive team. This is a technical consultant who can go wide and deep on discovery, solution positioning and demonstration while enabling and co-selling with partners during sales cycles. 

About the Role : 

The Solution Consultant will join the Partner Technical Acceleration Group as a technical consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position, and provide product-specific solutions in partnership with our channel/GSI ecosystem, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory through partner-led and partner-sourced deals. 

Key Focus Areas 

Driving pre-sales efforts for partner-led territory. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Partner with top-tier System Integrators to develop and position ServiceNow-powered transformation solutions 

  • Support product sales as a technical and domain expert, partnering closely with assigned partners' pre-sales and delivery teams to extend their solution capability 

  • Lead discovery workshops to determine customers' challenges and give product demonstrations jointly with partner teams, to align our solution with customer needs 

  • Answer product feature and technical questions from partners, customers, channel partners, and ServiceNow colleagues 

  • Enable and upskill partner solution consultants and architects through technical training, certification support, and hands-on labs and

title: Director, Solution Consulting - CRM Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Why This Role Matters

You will lead one of  ServiceNow’s fastest-growing markets — and this team will be at the center of that momentum.

You’ll shape how we go to market, how we sell value, and how we build the next generation of Solution Consulting talent.

Job Description

As the Director, UKI CRM Solution Consulting, you run the day-to-day pre-sales engine for CRM across the UK, Ireland, and Scotland. You lead first-line Solution Consulting managers and their individual contributors, and you are the leader closest to the deals.

You know what each team is working on, what is landing with customers, and what is stalling. Your job is to remove the blockers, keep the team focused and motivated, and make sure Solution Consulting moves in step with its CRM selling peers. This is an execution role at heart: you make the engine go fast.

You report to the AVP, EMEA CRM Solution Consulting, who sets regional strategy and direction.

What you'll do...

Own the number -- deliver CRM NNACV for UKI

  • Carry accountability, with your first-line managers, for UKI CRM NNACV targets and contribute to the EMEA goal of double-digit ACV growth.
  • Forecast technical win rates and deal-by-deal readiness, and raise risk to the AVP early rather than late.
  • Work with UKI CRM sales leaders to focus Solution Consulting time on the opportunities, use cases, and industries where CRM wins fastest.

Know the deals on the ground

  • Maintain a detailed, current view of what each team is working on: active opportunities, technical stage, proof-of-value status, and next steps.
  • Know what is working and what is not, and act on it in the weekly deal and pipeline rhythms rather than in a quarterly review.
  • Join key customer, POV, and escalation discussions where technical credibility or senior air cover is needed.

Remove blockers and keep the team focused

  • Be the first escalation point for anything that slows a deal: environment access, resourcing conflicts, unclear scope, product gaps, or competing demands.
  • Protect the team's time by clearing distractions, cutting low-value requests, and making sure ICs spend their time on the deals that matter most.
  • Make sure every IC knows what good looks like on their deals and has what they need to deliver it.

Lead and develop first-line leaders and ICs

  • Coach first-line managers on deal reviews, technical strategy, and POV execution, and hold them to consistent motions and communication rhythms.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain strong technical talent, and build a bench of ready-now first-line leaders.
  • Give direct, regular feedback to ICs and managers, and address performance issues early.

Keep the team motivated and aligned to selling peers

  • Recognize wins visibly and often, and build a team rhythm that keeps morale and momentum high.
  • Run joint pipeline and deal reviews with CRM sales, value, partner, and product counterparts so Solution Consulting and selling teams operate as one engine.
  • Agree coverage, account plans, and proof strategy with the AEs before they reach the customer.

Drive the shift to POV-centric selling and the FDE model

  • Make working proof-of-value the default way the team earns technical trust, and help ICs move toward the Forward Deployed Engineer model of building alongside customers.
  • Use AI automation tools and standard POV frameworks to speed up demos, environment provisioning, and repeatable assets.

Connect the field to CRM product

  • Channel technical wins, losses, and product gaps from your team to the AVP and CRM product leaders, using specific, deal-level examples.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 6+ years in a leadership role in Solution Consulting or a comparable pre-sales or technical sales function, including managing first-line leaders and individual contributors.
  • Still credible on the deals: you can scope a POV, work through an architecture question, or join a customer call without losing the thread.
  • A consistent record of owning and delivering against ACV / NNACV or equivalent revenue-tied targets in a software or SaaS environment.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across the UK, Ireland, and Scotland and operating effectively across cultures, languages, and time zones.
  • A working understanding of the CRM market and how AI and agentic automation are changing it.
  • Fluency with AI and automation tools and a bias toward using them to simplify how work gets done.
  • Experience moving a team from demo-centric to POV / proof-of-value-centric selling.
  • Clear, direct communication, and the ability to set a standard and hold first-line leaders to it.
  • Good operating judgement: knows when to escalate, when to decide, and when to get out of the way.
  • A talent-focused leader who can recruit, develop, and retain strong technical leaders and ICs.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Expected to travel up to 40% of the time on average, including across the UK, Ireland, and Scotland.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a customer obsessed Senior Staff Outbound Product Manager to join the Data & Analytics product team responsible for Workflow Data Fabric and RaptorDB. This is an externally focused role for a product leader who can bring complex enterprise data capabilities to market through clear positioning, product launches, sales enablement, and direct customer engagement.

This role sits at the intersection of data architecture, platform performance, analytics, AI readiness, and customer value. You will help shape how ServiceNow customers understand, adopt, and unlock value from advanced data capabilities, translating deep technical concepts into compelling product narratives, go-to-market strategies, customer-facing content, and field enablement.

Business Context

Workflow Data Fabric and RaptorDB Professional are strategically important growth areas within ServiceNow’s Data & Analytics portfolio. The business is already significant, with approximately $600M in revenue and a goal to grow to $1.5B by 2029. The opportunity is not simply to sell data as a standalone product, but to build a clear wraparound strategy for how data enhances ServiceNow’s value proposition across workflows, customer outcomes, enterprise AI readiness, and strategic deal pursuits.

The right leader will identify the customer problem, craft the market narrative, and help scale field enablement and growth strategies through one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many motions. This person will partner closely with product, engineering, sales, solution consulting, product marketing, and customer-facing teams to ensure the market understands the value of ServiceNow’s next-generation data platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the outbound product strategy for Workflow Data Fabric and RaptorDB Professional, translating complex data platform capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated positioning, and compelling market narratives.
  • Define and refine the core messaging, use cases, personas, competitive differentiation, and customer proof points that help technical and executive audiences understand why these products matter.
  • Partner closely with inbound product managers, engineering, product marketing, sales, solution consulting, and customer-facing teams to shape launch strategy, field readiness, growth motions, and adoption plans.
  • Serve as a product evangelist in customer briefings, executive conversations, analyst sessions, webinars, conferences, and strategic deal support, adapting the message for both technical practitioners and business decision-makers.
  • Translate concepts across enterprise data, analytics, integration, platform performance, and AI readiness into clear business outcomes, customer use cases, and seller-ready messaging without requiring audiences to navigate unnecessary technical depth.
  • Turn field feedback, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and adoption signals into actionable recommendations that influence roadmap priorities, GTM execution, and outbound investments.
  • Own high-impact outbound deliverables, including sales playbooks, product launch campaigns, demos, solution briefs, competitive guides, field training, executive presentations, and customer-facing product storytelling.
  • Help establish and track success metrics for outbound initiatives, including launch readiness, seller adoption, customer engagement, pipeline influence, product adoption, and market feedback.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise software product management, outbound product management, technical product marketing, or go-to-market experience, including ownership of customer-facing launches, positioning, field enablement, and sales plays.
  • Enterprise software experience is required, with a strong preference for candidates who have built, positioned, sold, or taken software products to market for external enterprise customers.
  • Product management or outbound product experience as a builder or seller of software, not solely as an internal IT practitioner, implementation owner, or user of similar technologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics—including data platforms, databases, integrations, cloud infrastructure, analytics, or AI/ML data layers—with the ability to translate these capabilities into differentiated positioning and customer value. Deep engineering or architecture ownership is not required.
  • Strong understanding of how data strategy, integration, data management, databases, and platform capabilities support enterprise AI and workflow transformation.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging external enterprise customers, sellers, and executives through briefings, discovery conversations, launches, field events, or strategic deal support—and using those interactions to sharpen messaging and go-to-market execution.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity for technical practitioners, business decision-makers, sellers, executives, and customer stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functionally across product, engineering, marketing, sales, solution consulting, customer success, and field teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

Helpful Experience

  • Experience supporting data platform, database, integration/iPaaS, infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML data layer, or enterprise SaaS platform products.
  • Experience delivering demos or supporting technical customer conversations, EBCs, sales engagements, analyst sessions, webinars, conferences, or strategic deal pursuits.
  • Experience developing field enablement, launch narratives, competitive positioning, customer proof points, executive messaging, and adoption programs.
  • Experience with federal customers or highly regulated enterprise markets is helpful.
  • US citizenship or green card status is preferred to support federal market customer opportunities.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

title: Staff Applied Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tout a commencé sous le soleil de San Diego, en Californie, en 2004, lorsqu’un ingénieur visionnaire, Fred Luddy, a vu le potentiel de transformer notre façon de travailler. Aujourd’hui, ServiceNow se présente comme un leader mondial du marché, apportant une technologie innovante améliorée par l’IA à plus de 8 100 clients, dont 85% des entreprises du Fortune 500®. Notre plateforme intelligente basée sur le nuage connecte de manière transparente les personnes, les systèmes et les processus pour permettre aux organisations de trouver des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, plus rapides et meilleures. Mais ce n’est que le début de notre voyage. Joignez-vous à nous dans la poursuite de notre objectif de rendre le monde meilleur pour tous.

######

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Dans le rôle de scientifique de recherche appliquée principal(e), vous travaillerez sur des problèmes vaguement définis, pour lesquels aucune méthode éprouvée n’existe encore. ServiceNow AI Research observe le comportement des agents d’IA dans des environnements d’entreprise complexes et à grande échelle. Votre mission consiste à transformer les défis ambigus de ce portrait en orientations concrètes et testables. Vous déciderez quelles questions valent la peine d’être explorées, proposerez les modèles et les techniques pour y répondre, puis construirez, entraînerez et évaluerez vous-même les agents afin de déterminer s’ils fonctionnent.

Vous validerez les nouveaux concepts avant que le reste de l’organisation ne s’y engage. Cela implique de réaliser des prototypes rapidement, de mettre à l’épreuve les hypothèses et de collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe d’ingénierie en déploiement client (Forward Deployed Engineering) pour valider les idées dans des flux de travail réels. Lorsqu’un prototype échoue sur le terrain, c’est vous qui comprendrez pourquoi et qui déterminerez la suite à donner. Vos conclusions orienteront le programme de recherche, la feuille de route produit et les pratiques d’évaluation sur lesquelles l’équipe s’appuie.

Vous définirez aussi la direction technique des projets appliqués dans le cadre du programme plus large de l’équipe, encadrerez les chercheurs et les stagiaires, et représenterez les travaux par des publications, des conférences et des contributions à des projets open source.

#######

As a Staff Applied Research Scientist, you will work on problems that are vaguely defined and have no playbook yet. ServiceNow AI Research sees how AI agents behave in complex enterprise environments at scale, and your job is to turn ambiguous challenges in that picture into concrete, testable directions. You will decide which questions are worth pursuing, propose the models and techniques to answer them, and then build, train, and evaluate the agents yourself to find out whether they work.

You will derisk new concepts before the rest of the organization commits to them. That means prototyping quickly, stress-testing assumptions, and working side by side with the Forward Deployed Engineering team to validate ideas against real customer workflows. When a prototype fails in the field, you will be the one who understands why and what to do next. Your findings will shape the research agenda, the product roadmap, and the evaluation practices that the team relies on.

You will also set technical direction for applied projects within the team's broader agenda, mentor researchers and interns, and represent the work through publications, talks, and open-source contributions.

Qualifications

  • Doctorat en informatique, en apprentissage automatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente en recherche ou en application
  • Au moins trois ans d’expérience après le doctorat, incluant du travail sur des systèmes en production ou utilisés par des usagers réels
  • Capacité à décomposer un problème mal défini en ses composantes, à formuler des hypothèses et à concevoir des expériences pour les tester
  • Expérience pratique de l’implémentation, de l’entraînement et de l’évaluation de systèmes basés sur les LLM et d’architectures d’agents, incluant l’utilisation d’outils, la planification et les flux de travail en plusieurs étapes
  • Expérience dans la conception d’évaluations : définition de métriques, création de jeux de tests et analyse des modes de défaillance
  • Connaissances pratiques des enjeux de sécurité et de sûreté des systèmes d’IA, comme l’injection de requêtes (prompt injection), la fuite de données ou les usages malveillants
  • Solides compétences en développement logiciel en Python et dans les principaux frameworks d’apprentissage automatique, avec du code reproductible et maintenable
  • Aisance à travailler directement avec des ingénieurs et des équipes en contact avec la clientèle, et capacité à traduire les résultats en recommandations claires pour des audiences produit et de direction
  • Expérience d’encadrement de chercheurs, d’ingénieurs ou de stagiaires
  • Usage avancé des outils agentiques dans votre propre travail

Atouts

  • Publications ou contributions open source en évaluation d’agents, en sécurité de l’IA ou en fiabilité des agents
  • Expérience des systèmes d’IA en environnement d’entreprise, incluant la conformité, la gouvernance et les contraintes d’échelle
  • Expérience dans la création de benchmarks, de pipelines de red-teaming ou de surveillance de modèles déployés
  • Formation dans une discipline qui enseigne une décomposition rigoureuse, comme l’ingénierie des systèmes, la recherche en sécurité ou les méthodes formelles

#######

Requirements 

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research or applied experience
  • Three or more years of post-PhD experience, including work on systems that run in production or close to real users
  • Ability to break down an ill-defined problem into its components, form hypotheses, and design experiments that test them
  • Hands-on experience implementing, training, and evaluating LLM-based systems and agent architectures, including tool use, planning, and multi-step workflows
  • Experience designing evaluations: defining metrics, building test sets, and analyzing failure modes
  • Working knowledge of security and safety issues in AI systems, such as prompt injection, data leakage, or misuse
  • Strong software development skills in Python and modern ML frameworks, with reproducible, maintainable code
  • Comfort working directly with engineers and customer-facing teams, and the ability to translate findings into clear recommendations for product and executive audiences
  • Experience mentoring researchers, engineers, or interns
  • Advanced use of agentic tools in your own workflow

Nice to have

  • Publications or open-source contributions in agent evaluation, AI security, or agent reliability
  • Experience with AI systems in enterprise environments, including compliance, governance, and scale constraints
  • Experience building benchmarks, red-teaming pipelines, or monitoring for deployed models
  • Background in a discipline that trains careful decomposition, such as systems engineering, security research, or formal methods

title: Principal Software Engineer - Veza
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza is the identity security platform for human, non-human, and AI agent access. Customers use it to see who and what has access to what, govern it, and remediate risk across cloud, SaaS, and on-prem systems.

Agent security is the inflection point. Static access reviews can't keep up with autonomous agents acting at machine speed. Security is shifting to continuous, real-time control: just-in-time access for agents, automated remediation of policy violations, and real-time governance of agent actions as they happen—replacing standing privileges and periodic reviews.

Veza is in transition, growing quickly as part of ServiceNow's Security & Risk organization. The Chief Architect will shape how the platform scales to meet this new category.

Job Description

What you'll do

Identity

  • Own the identity model for workloads and agents: SPIFFE/SPIRE trust domains, workload attestation, and how identities are issued, scoped, rotated, and revoked.
  • Architect ephemeral authentication and authorization end to end: short-lived credential issuance, token exchange and delegation (for example RFC 8693-style flows), and revocation that takes effect in practice.
  • Define runtime authorization for agents: what an agent can access, under whose delegated authority, with what guardrails, and with audit trails that hold up to review.
  • Lead the identity architecture for the Agent Security roadmap, including Runtime Authorization, the Access Policy Engine, and AgentID with short-lived credentials, and its integration with the NHI program.
  • Set the identity standards for non-human identities across Veza’s integrations, covering how connectors authenticate, get scoped, and rotate secrets.

Core architecture

  • Define identity contracts that the graph, data model, and integrations architects build against, and review designs in those areas for identity correctness.
  • Shape how identity fits into the Veza-ServiceNow integration model, including shared identity and data contracts and UI surfacing patterns.
  • Partner with the integrations, graph, and deployment owners on decisions that touch identity, without taking over their domains.

Leadership

  • Represent Veza’s identity architecture to customers, partners, ServiceNow Security leadership, and standards bodies.
  • Mentor engineers

Qualifications

What you bring

  • 12+ years in security or identity engineering, with a substantial share spent designing identity systems in production at scale.
  • Strong background in identity and access: IGA, IAM, PAM, authorization models, access reviews, lifecycle management, or adjacent security domains.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in workload identity, specifically SPIFFE/SPIRE or an equivalent, and in ephemeral credential design. You can explain trust bootstrapping and rotation failure modes without notes.
  • Strong grounding in OAuth 2.x, OIDC, token exchange, and authorization models (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC, and policy engines such as OPA or Cedar).
  • Understanding of non-human identity (service accounts, secrets, API keys, workload identity) and emerging agent identity and authorization models.
  • Experience building security products that meet their own security and compliance bar (SOC 2, FedRAMP or equivalent, data residency).
  • Experience delivering production AI or agentic systems, including evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Active use of AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent).
  • Strong Python or Go, with the ability to go deep in code and design reviews.
  • Executive-level communication, with the ability to defend an identity decision to engineers, customers, and security leadership.
  • Breadth to hold your own on graph data models, integration architecture, and multi-region deployment, even if you don’t own them.
     

Preferred

  • Experience through an acquisition or platform integration, aligning an acquired architecture with a parent platform.
  • Experience with integration-heavy platforms and the authentication and secrets challenges they bring.
  • Familiarity with graph databases or immutable or event-sourced storage models.
  • Authored or shaped identity standards or RFCs.
  • Built or operated a production credential broker or identity provider.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Success in the first 12 months

  • A published identity architecture for workload and agent access, with committed milestones.
  • A defined, adopted model for ephemeral credentials across Veza’s services and integrations.
  • A runtime authorization design for agents that Product and Sales can take to customers.
  • Identity contracts agreed with the graph, integrations, and deployment owners.

Job Description

The Role

Do you care deeply about secure access at scale? Making sure the right people have the right access, exactly when they need it, without slowing teams down? Join Moveworks and help shape the future of our identity and access strategy.

At Moveworks, we believe great security is an enabler, not a blocker. As a Senior Identity & Access Management Engineer, you’ll be a hands-on technical developer, coding, designing, building, and scaling IAM solutions across cloud infrastructure, SaaS applications, and internal systems. You’ll own the development of IAM initiatives end-to-end, from untangling ambiguous access challenges to architecting secure, automated solutions and driving them into production.

In this role, you’ll develop robust access models across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, and beyond; reduce privilege sprawl through thoughtful role design; and build strong observability through logging, metrics, and reporting in our SIEM. You’ll modernize access reviews to deliver real security impact with minimal friction, continuously de-risk IAM threats, and partner closely with teams to drive adoption of secure-by-default patterns.

Your work will directly protect Moveworks’ most critical systems while enabling our engineers to move fast, safely, and confidently.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Be the technical developer to drive IAM application development: Code, design, and implement solutions with extensive knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Enabling robust and reliable solutions to keep our engineering teams active.

  • Drive IAM projects end-to-end: Take ambiguous access problems, understand and have the ability to define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout/operationalization (not just the design).

  • Develop with secure access models in mind: Continuously develop role design improvements and access assignment patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS apps, and internal systems to reduce unnecessary privileges, minimize manual grants, and create scalable “safe baseline” access that covers routine work without daily elevation.

  • Develop on operationalizing logging and metrics: Ensure access changes are observable in our Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tool; build repeatable reporting that surfaces risky access and drift.

  • Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): Develop, execute and design a UAR process & solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal—minimizing approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.

  • Develop technology to continuously de-risk: Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, propose appropriate controls and mitigations, drive adoption with partner teams, and develop solutions to continuously de-risk.

  • Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: Reliably distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.

  • Document and standardize the paved road: Write lightweight procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience developing and maintaining IAM products/tools.

  • Automation-first mindset: Experience writing production-ready scalable software, Infrastructure as Code, and using AI coding tools to build reliable automation.

  • IAM Expertise: Strong grasp of IAM best practices, techniques, and common failure modes (e.g., least privilege, privilege escalation paths, separation of duties, breakglass, auditability). Ability to spot dangerous permissions and identify suitable mitigations and controls.

  • Educational Background: BS+ in computer science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • US Citizenship preferred

descriptionHtml:

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the role

Health Log Analytics (HLA) ingests, stores, and analyzes the logs that power ServiceNow's AIOps suite. We want it to be the data backbone teams trust to find problems early and fix them fast.

HLA is a data platform for operational logs at high volume, built for ServiceNow’s large enterprise customers. The work spans the full data path: collection and ingestion, routing and enrichment, durable storage and retention, and fast, cost-aware query. Our ingest builds on OpenTelemetry, and we have our own Rust-based log storage. As data volume, customer needs, and AI-driven use cases grow, we need the platform to get more reliable, more efficient, and more useful.

We're looking for a senior technical leader to help set where HLA goes next. You'll work side by side with engineering and product leadership on the roadmap. You'll bring a clear point of view and show it with a prototype, not just a slide.

You'll set the technical bar for experienced engineers. You'll do it by being a great teammate, not the loudest person in the room.

What you'll do

  • Help shape the HLA roadmap with engineering, product, and leadership. Bring both vision and a reality check.
  • Work directly with customers to make sure HLA keeps delivering value as their needs change. Turn their feedback into clear, actionable input for product and the roadmap.
  • Set architecture direction across ingest, storage, and query, and across teams you don't own.
  • Write down your point of view, then build a prototype that helps others see it and get behind it.
  • Say no, with reasons. That includes AI ideas with no evidence behind them, and timelines or designs that don't fit today's constraints. Know when to push past those constraints, too.
  • Lead deep design reviews that raise the bar and leave people feeling sharper, not smaller.
  • Define the reliability and efficiency bar for the HLA data path: completeness, durability, latency, availability, tenant isolation, and unit cost.
  • Lead the technical approach to hard transitions, such as storage migrations, schema changes, replay, and upgrades with little or no downtime.
  • Set clear architectural boundaries and contracts for the teams building collection, ingest, storage, anomaly detection, query, and AIOps experiences.
  • Show how we build with AI. Weigh ideas against customer value, data quality, reliability, and cost. Run small experiments to help us decide what to scale.
  • Set the example on quality, on-call, and learning from incidents.
  • Mentor senior engineers and tech leads. Help grow the next technical leaders.
  • Work as a real partner to engineering and product leadership. Learn in the open.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have  

  • Experience in leveraging or critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision making, or problem solving. This includes using AI powered tools, automated workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run.
  • 12+ years building and operating production distributed systems, with substantial ownership of large-scale data or platform systems. Equivalent depth shown through sustained technical leadership counts too.
  • Broad grounding across data ingestion, storage and query, and AI on top of data. Deep expertise in at least one.
  • Experience with ingest tools like Kafka, Pulsar, or Kinesis, and with columnar stores, time-series databases, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or object-storage designs
  • A record of changing the direction of teams you didn't own, through credibility and clear thinking
  • Evidence-based judgment on AI. You know where it belongs and where it doesn’t, and you’ve built safeguards for correctness, safety, and cost. You’ve shipped with it, or you’re a strong proponent with a clear point of view.
  • Good judgment on tradeoffs: consistency, latency, cost, and operational burden
  • Comfort with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure at scale
  • Fluency in at least one of Go, Java, Scala, Rust, or Python. You prototype and review deeply, and you write code when it counts.
  • Clear communication. You can explain a tricky design to a new hire or a VP and have both of them get it.

Nice to Have: 

  • A background in observability, log analytics, OpenTelemetry or AIOps
  • Experience at an AI-native company, or building agents and LLM-based features
  • Experience with multitenant SaaS and per-tenant isolation

Who you are

  • Humble, smart, and you care about people
  • You have experience working remotely and leading remote teams
  • You make the people around you better, and you share the work and the credit
  • You're comfortable when the problem isn't fully defined, and you help define it
  • You turn small, messy things into big, solid ones
  • You care about the people who run what you build

Why join us

You'll work on real scale problems with real customers. You'll have room to shape the architecture and the direction of a product that matters. And you'll join a team that values clear thinking, honest feedback, and shipping.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This is not an ML role. This is a distributed systems engineering role at the heart of the agentic AI wave.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
  • Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using DynamoDB conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
  • Event-driven message pipeline — SQS FIFO queues for ordered delivery, Kafka consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
  • Structured concurrency — Python asyncio TaskGroups running multiple concurrent tasks per session (message polling, lease heartbeats, output publishing, orchestrator execution) with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
  • Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
  • Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

  • Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
  • Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
  • Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
  • Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
  • gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

Required:

  • 10+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
  • Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
  • Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
  • Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Job Description

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)  

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact  

Role summary 

Enterprise Security is hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring delivery discipline to three connected programs: Vulnerability Management, Configuration Management, and Attack Surface Management. You will manage the OKR and epic portfolio, keep priorities current, and make sure committed work is loaded into each engineering team's agile backlog, so delivery dates will hold.  

Why this role matters 

These programs span many teams and stay active for multiple quarters. Dependencies, shifting priorities, and unclear ownership can stall critical work. You will be the person who tracks, communicates, and resolves cross-team dependencies so engineers can stay focused on technical delivery, and leaders can focus on strategy and people. 

What you'll do 

  • Manage the OKR and epic portfolio across all three programs, including creation, refinement, sequencing, and status tracking. 
  • Lead ongoing reprioritization as scope and demand change and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders. 
  • Work with team leads, so each team's agile funnel reflects current priorities and supports committed delivery dates. 
  • Track dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams, and drive them to resolution or escalate early. 
  • Produce executive-ready status, risk, and progress reporting for the whole portfolio. 
  • Run gate reviews and go/no-go checkpoints for major milestones. 
  • Model team capacity against competing priorities and raise conflicts early. 
  • Build repeatable standards, such as OKR governance and intake and planning templates, that scale across teams. 

Qualifications 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • 12+ years of program or project management experience in software, security, or infrastructure organizations. OR similar experience with education. 
  • A track record of managing multi-team programs with competing priorities and dependencies. 
  • Strong working knowledge of agile delivery, including backlog, epic, and sprint planning in enterprise tools (such as ServiceNow Agile). 
  • Experience managing OKRs and tying delivery to measurable outcomes. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting. 
  • The ability to influence and align teams without direct authority. 

Qualifications

Preferred qualifications 

  • Experience in security operations, vulnerability management, configuration or compliance management, CMDB, or attack surface and exposure management. 
  • Familiarity with regulated or government environments, such as FedRAMP and federal directives. 
  • Experience launching a new program, including defining metrics and reporting cadence. 
  • Experience with capacity planning and portfolio-level road mapping. 
  • PMP, SAFe, or similar certification (nice to have, not required). 

Success measures for the first 6 to 12 months 

  • A single, current OKR and epic view across VM, CM, and ASM. 
  • Each team's agile funnel aligned to committed delivery dates. 
  • Cross-team blockers resolved on a predictable cadence. 
  • ASM success measures defined, with regular reporting to leadership. 
  • A reduction in program coordination work carried by managers and engineers. 


West Palm Beach Florida (WPB) is available to for Relocation.  Full relocation costs are provided by ServiceNow

title: Area VP, Solution Consulting
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

ServiceNow is a global market leader in AI-enhanced cloud technology, serving over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our platform connects people, systems, and processes so organizations can work smarter, faster, and better. We pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone. 

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As the AVP, AMS CRM Solution Consulting, you own the pre-sales technical engine behind one of ServiceNow's fastest-growing bets: CRM. You will lead a multi-layer organization of first- and second-line Solution Consulting leaders and their teams across the Americas, directly accountable for the Net New Annual Contract Value (NNACV) that CRM delivers. This is an execution role at heart. Your mandate is to convert ServiceNow's next-generation, AI-native CRM vision into consistent, repeatable pre-sales motions that win—at speed and at scale. 

You will re-establish a tight connection between the field and CRM product, build the next generation of pre-sales talent around the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) model, and lead the shift from a demo-centric to a proof-of-value (POV) centric go-to-market motion. Above all, you will drive speed, simplification, and clarity—scaling the organization through AI automation and operating as a single, unified engine of execution alongside your CRM selling peers. 

What you'll do… 

Own the number – drive CRM NNACV growth 

  • Carry direct accountability for AMS CRM NNACV targets and mobilize the Solution Consulting organization to achieve and exceed double-digit ACV growth. 

  • Translate the number into clear team-level and individual pre-sales motions; forecast technical win rates and remove the blockers that slow deals. 

  • Partner with CRM sales leadership to prioritize the opportunities, use cases, and industries where CRM wins fastest. 

Build the next-generation pre-sales organization (FDE model) 

  • Lead and grow the next generation of pre-sales talent, evolving the Solution Consultant role toward the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) model—technical leaders who build alongside customers rather than present to them. 

  • Participate in and accelerate the transition from a demo-centric to a POV-centric pre-sales GTM motion, making working proof-of-value the default way CRM earns technical trust. 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain elite technical talent, and build a bench of first- and second-line leaders ready for scale. 

Champion AI and the future of CRM 

  • Understand and guide the market's intense focus on AI alongside the world's demand for a next-generation CRM, positioning ServiceNow's AI-native CRM as the answer. 

  • Keep the organization fluent in agentic AI, Now Assist for CRM, and the platform capabilities that differentiate ServiceNow from legacy CRM incumbents. 

  • Bring an outside-in view of where CRM and AI are heading into product, GTM, and enablement decisions. 

Scale through automation – speed, simplification, and clarity 

  • Drive a passionate, relentless emphasis on using AI automation tools to scale the pre-sales organization—doing more through focus, not headcount. 

  • Simplify how the team works: fewer and better assets, standardized POV frameworks, and automated demo and environment provisioning. 

  • Make speed, simplification, and clarity the operating standard for every motion the team runs. 

Reconnect the field to CRM product 

  • Re-establish a strong, two-way connection between AMS Solution Consulting and CRM Product Management so that field insight shapes the roadmap and product direction reaches the field fast. 

  • Serve as a trusted voice of the customer, channeling technical wins, losses, and gaps into product priorities. 

  • Ensure the team consistently represents the current, differentiated CRM story—not the last generation's. 

Lead with consistent motions, clear messaging, and accountability 

  • Drive first- and second-line leaders to clear, consistent messaging and visible leadership accountability across the organization. 

  • Establish consistent motions and communication rhythms so every team runs the same plays to the same standard. 

  • Motivate the team and the broader CRM community to rally around shared, ambitious growth targets. 

Operate as a single engine of execution 

  • Work with CRM selling peers—sales, product, value, and partner leaders—as one integrated engine of execution, not adjacent functions. 

  • Align pre-sales strategy, coverage, and investment with the broader CRM go-to-market plan. 

  • Represent AMS CRM Solution Consulting in cross-functional and global forums, ensuring consistency across regions. 

Qualifications

T

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Extensive experience (10+ years) leading pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical sales organizations at scale, including leading other leaders (managing managers). This team is appox. 110 ICs and 16 managers. 

  • 10+ years in leadership role in Solution Consulting domain 

  • A consistent record of owning and delivering against ACV / NNACV or equivalent revenue-tied targets in a software or SaaS environment. 

  • Deep understanding of the CRM market and the disruption that AI and agentic automation are bringing to it. 

  • Fluency with AI and automation tools and a demonstrated bias toward using them to scale teams and simplify how work gets done. 

  • Experience evolving pre-sales motions—especially moving teams from demo-centric to POV / proof-of-value-centric selling. 

  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to set clear messaging and hold leaders accountable to it. 

  • Strong cross-functional operating skills and a track record of aligning sales, product, and pre-sales into a single execution engine. 

  • A talent magnet who can recruit, develop, and retain top technical leaders and individual contributors. 

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent work experience. 

  • Expected to travel up to 50% of the time on average.

Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a Senior Manager, Partner Technology Architecture to lead a team of
Partner Technology Architects serving our Global and strategic partners. As a first-line people
leader, you will build and develop a high-performing team that drives holistic partner growth
through pre-sales technical excellence, solution strategy, business development, and AI-first
technology adoption. You will remain hands-on: coaching your team, staying close to critical
partner engagements, and owning the outcomes your team delivers. You will translate platform
capabilities, AI innovation, and industry context into repeatable, outcome-driven offerings that
partners can build, scale, and monetize. This role requires travel for partner, customer, and
organizational activities of up to 30%.
While this role leads strategic business development and co-innovation, pre-sales technical
excellence remains the primary operational foundation for the team, including technical
discovery, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept leadership, and architectural validation that
accelerates partner-led customer engagements.


What You’ll Do
As a Senior Manager, you will lead a team of Partner Technology Architects, set their priorities
against partner and Global Partners & Alliances goals, and remain accountable for the partner
outcomes your team delivers.
People Leadership & Team Development
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Partner Technology Architects, setting clear goals
and growing each member according to business needs and individual professional
goals.
• Evaluate team members regularly through direct observation, peer feedback, and sales
feedback.
• Build and maintain a recruiting pipeline and hire to meet future business demands.
• Manage day-to-day team operations, including resource scheduling, activity reporting,
and expense review and approval.
• Assign resources to partner engagements, joint solution development, and demand
generation to ensure effective use of skills across the assigned region

Partner Strategy & Business Development
• Ensure your team serves as the primary strategic interface for assigned partners,
building trusted relationships with partner executives and practice leaders.

Job Description

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)  

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact  

Role summary 

Enterprise Security is hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring delivery discipline to three connected programs: Vulnerability Management, Configuration Management, and Attack Surface Management. You will manage the OKR and epic portfolio, keep priorities current, and make sure committed work is loaded into each engineering team's agile backlog, so delivery dates will hold.  

Why this role matters 

These programs span many teams and stay active for multiple quarters. Dependencies, shifting priorities, and unclear ownership can stall critical work. You will be the person who tracks, communicates, and resolves cross-team dependencies so engineers can stay focused on technical delivery, and leaders can focus on strategy and people. 

What you'll do 

  • Manage the OKR and epic portfolio across all three programs, including creation, refinement, sequencing, and status tracking. 
  • Lead ongoing reprioritization as scope and demand change and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders. 
  • Work with team leads, so each team's agile funnel reflects current priorities and supports committed delivery dates. 
  • Track dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams, and drive them to resolution or escalate early. 
  • Produce executive-ready status, risk, and progress reporting for the whole portfolio. 
  • Run gate reviews and go/no-go checkpoints for major milestones. 
  • Model team capacity against competing priorities and raise conflicts early. 
  • Build repeatable standards, such as OKR governance and intake and planning templates, that scale across teams. 

Qualifications 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • 12+ years of program or project management experience in software, security, or infrastructure organizations. OR similar experience with education. 
  • A track record of managing multi-team programs with competing priorities and dependencies. 
  • Strong working knowledge of agile delivery, including backlog, epic, and sprint planning in enterprise tools (such as ServiceNow Agile). 
  • Experience managing OKRs and tying delivery to measurable outcomes. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting. 
  • The ability to influence and align teams without direct authority. 

Qualifications

Preferred qualifications 

  • Experience in security operations, vulnerability management, configuration or compliance management, CMDB, or attack surface and exposure management. 
  • Familiarity with regulated or government environments, such as FedRAMP and federal directives. 
  • Experience launching a new program, including defining metrics and reporting cadence. 
  • Experience with capacity planning and portfolio-level road mapping. 
  • PMP, SAFe, or similar certification (nice to have, not required). 

Success measures for the first 6 to 12 months 

  • A single, current OKR and epic view across VM, CM, and ASM. 
  • Each team's agile funnel aligned to committed delivery dates. 
  • Cross-team blockers resolved on a predictable cadence. 
  • ASM success measures defined, with regular reporting to leadership. 
  • A reduction in program coordination work carried by managers and engineers.

title: Director of Engineering - AI Control Tower
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Role 

The AI Control Tower is ServiceNow's central hub for governing every AI model, agent, and dataset across the enterprise. We're building the infrastructure that enterprises will depend on as agentic AI moves from experiment to production — and we need a Director of Engineering who has been in that position before: shipping a 1.0 product, fighting for its first users, and figuring out how to turn early traction into durable adoption. 

This isn't a role for someone who has managed mature systems. It's for someone who has built something from scratch — in a small, fast company where there was no playbook — and who is now ready to do it at the scale and ambition of ServiceNow. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, AICT, you will lead one or more product areas within the AICT platform, with scope and ownership evolving as the product and team grow. 

You are AI-native. You don't just understand AI conceptually — you use it daily, you build with it, and you bring that instinct into how your team designs and ships. 

What You Will Do 

Product Delivery & Roadmap Execution Own the engineering roadmap for your AICT product areas — translating product requirements into technical plans, managing delivery across a focused engineering team, and maintaining the velocity needed to meet the demands of a fast-moving market. You have done this before and know the difference between motion and progress. 

1.0 to Adoption Drive the full arc from early release to meaningful customer adoption. You understand that shipping a 1.0 is only half the job — the other half is learning fast, iterating based on what real customers do (not what they say), and building the feedback loops that compound adoption over time. 

AI-Native Engineering Set the standard for how your team uses AI in its own development practice — from AI-assisted code review and testing to designing platform features that assume AI agents are first-class users. You lead by example: your team should see you using AI tools as fluently as you use a terminal. 

Team Building Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing engineering team. You are a strong technical voice who can also grow engineers — you give clear feedback, create stretch opportunities, and build the kind of team culture that makes people want to stay and do their best work. 

Cross-Functional Execution Work closely with Product Management, Design, and partner engineering teams to align dependencies and ship coherent experiences. Represent engineering in planning and review forums with senior leadership. 

Qualifications

Required 

  • 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years leading engineering teams (as a manager of managers or strong senior manager) 

  • Demonstrable startup experience at a company with fewer than 100 employees, where you were hands-on building and shipping a product — not just working at a startup, but building one 

  • Proven experience driving adoption of a 1.0 or early-stage product: you have the scars from a launch that didn't go perfectly and the wins from figuring out how to turn it around 

  • Deep technical foundation in cloud-native SaaS, including multi-tenant architectures, large-scale API design (REST/gRPC), Kubernetes orchestration, multi-cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm) 

  • Strong understanding of database schema design, data modeling, and modern data platforms, including relational, graph, vector, columnar, OLAP, and streaming data architectures, with the ability to design scalable data models for AI and enterprise workloads. 

  • database schema design, , data modeling, and event-driven architectures. 

  • AI-Native Engineering: Lead the adoption of AI across the entire engineering lifecycle—from product strategy, PRDs, UX, architecture, implementation, code reviews, debugging, testing, security, CI/CD, deployment, observability, APM, operations, and documentation—to improve engineering productivity, software quality, reliability, customer experience, and delivery velocity. 

  • Ability to operate at both the architectural level and the pull request level when it matters 

  • Track record of building and retaining engineering teams, including in competitive talent markets 

Preferred 

  • Experience building governance, observability, or compliance products — you understand why enterprises care about auditability and have designed for it 

  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks and the operational realities of running agents in production (tool reliability, context management, failure modes) 

  • Background in enterprise security, IAM, or data governance 

  • Familiarity with MCP, OpenAPI, or other AI interoperability standards 

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field

As the Solution Architect for Public Sector India, you'll be the technical lead for ServiceNow's entry into the Indian public sector. You'll turn government digitisation programs into solution blueprints, proof of concepts, and winning bids, with AI at the centre of the story.

Design and deliver AI-led architectures aligned with the India AI Mission & ministry priorities, proof of concepts, and tender responses that win public sector business in India and build trust with government technology leaders and SI partners.

  • Excellent communication: executive presence, storytelling, and strong written and verbal skills. Able to simplify complex architecture for non-technical decision makers and earn credibility with CIOs, senior officials, and SI architects.
  • AI fundamentals (LLMs, agents, RAG, data readiness, responsible AI and governance), with the drive and capacity to reach expert level within 12-18 months.

  • Proven track record on tenders and RFPs, with fluency in procurement and compliance requirements.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

ServiceNow seeks a staff-level product security engineer to serve as a senior technical authority within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT). PSIRT is ServiceNow's awareness, response, and investigation capability for post-release vulnerabilities in ServiceNow-developed products and service offerings. 

This role is for a recognized expert who can operate independently and as part of a team on the most significant security issues facing the platform—vulnerabilities that require evaluating intangibles. You will lead deep-dive investigations, coordinate resolution across engineering, product, and release teams, and demonstrate calm, decisive leadership during significant security events. 

This is a role for someone who already understands product development cycles and the engineering and product relationships that drive them—and will use that fluency to lead fixes to completion under incident pressure. You will help shape how ServiceNow responds to product security vulnerabilities at scale and the technical rigor of the entire response capability. 

The coverage provided by this role is: 

  • Sunday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST. 

  • Monday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST. 

  • Tuesday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST. 

  • Friday: 06:00 - 13:00 UTC / 11:30 - 18:30 IST. 

  • Saturday: 03:00 - 12:00 UTC / 08:30 - 17:30 IST. 

Due to the nature of incident response and needs of the business, coverage may change. Additional coverage outside of stated hours may be required in response to significant incidents.  

What you get to do in this role:

         Lead Through Significant Security Events

  • Demonstrate technical and organizational leadership during these events—bringing structure and clear decision-making under pressure. 
  • Partner with incident commanders, business information security leadership, engineering, and customer-facing teams to maintain clear ownership, workstream prioritization, and hand-offs during these events. 

         Reduce Exposure Window 

  • Drive coordinated response across affected releases, balancing risk and remediation feasibility. 
  • Leverage an understanding of product development cycles and engineering/product partnerships to move fixes through the release pipeline without stalling on organizational boundaries. 
  • Verify fix completeness and guard against incomplete mitigations before release. 


         CVE & Coordinated Disclosure Process 

  • Contributed to ServiceNow's CVE disclosure process for incidents you own—CVE assignment, scoring, advisory content, and publication timing. 
  • Conduct technical accuracy reviews of external advisories, researcher write-ups, and joint disclosure content to ensure correctness before publication. 

      Pursue After-Action Outcomes & Continuous Improvement 
     
  • Author root cause analyses and drive lessons learned to closure following product security incidents. 
  • Participate in retrospectives following significant product security events, translating findings into concrete process and technical improvements. 
  • Contribute to partner teams tracking product security risk themes and trends across the portfolio. 
    Contribute to SDLC improvement areas, feeding incident learnings upstream into secure development practices. 

Qualifications

 To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

  • Minimum 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience; or equivalent experience. 

  • Minimum 4 years of auditing source code for security vulnerabilities. 

  • Demonstrated leadership during significant security events or major incidents, with willingness to participate in on-call. 

  • Ability to read and comprehend Java and JavaScript code.  

  • Strong understanding of common Java and JavaScript vulnerabilities.  

  • Proficiency in scripting in both Python and JavaScript for data gathering, processing, and visualization.  

  • Development of proof-of-concept exploits for web application vulnerabilities.  

  • Written and verbal communication of complex security risk clearly to both technical teams and leadership. 

  • Experience with leading fix implementation and release coordination across engineering, product, and test/release teams. 

  • Proficiency in deep-dive product security investigations and root-cause analysis spanning design, code, configuration, and operational layers. 

  • Exploit analysis and proof-of-concept development that distinguishes real exploitability from theoretical risk. 

  • Familiarity with SDLC integration, CI/CD pipelines, SaaS threat models, and secure development practices. 

    Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a PSIRT or similar function for a major software or SaaS platform. 

  • Recognized expertise in product security incident response, vulnerability research, or application security within a software or SaaS environment. 

  • Experience conducting vulnerability assessments on the ServiceNow platform. 

  • Experience with emerging threats: AI-specific attack vectors, software supply chain security, and SDLC tooling security. 

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments. 

  • Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSWE) or demonstrated equivalent expertise.
