title: VP, Product Strategy-Technology Workflows
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Business 

Technology Workflows is the largest business at ServiceNow – and its core.  We build the products that run the technology estate— Service Management (Incident/Problem/Change), Operations Management (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, etc.), the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Asset Management, and Portfolio Management. Our customers use us to gain visibility of their technology estate, understand how it connects and performs, and act on it. 

As AI moves from helping people work to acting on systems directly, the accuracy and reach of that picture becomes the limit on everything built above it. That puts the Technology Workflows business at the center of the company’s agentic strategy. 

The Role 

This is a senior individual contributor role and the strategy partner to the SVP of Technology Workflows and the General Managers and Product Leaders of each business unit.  You will not run a product line directly, nor will not have a team reporting directly to you.  Your work and impact come through the ability to partner and influence.  You will decide what this business should believe about where its market is going, be the key identifier of technological shifts and trends, and understand the current and future competitive landscape.  You will synthesize your findings with evidence and turn it into artifacts that help set long-term roadmap direction, budget allocations, staffing decisions, pricing, partnerships, and acquisitions.  You will interact with the ServiceNow Ventures team to help identify and assess sectors and individual companies for investment, with the Corporate Development team to create M&A chess boards and evaluate acquisition targets, and with the Corporate Strategy team to develop ServiceNow’s overall strategic posture. 

Key to this role is a understanding of both business and deep technical constructs.  Technology Workflows is the most technical product group at ServiceNow and success in this role requires understanding how technical estates are run and the constantly changing stack used by practitioners. 

If you want a defined product area and a team to build it, this is the wrong role. If you want to set the direction of a business at this scale without the machinery of owning it, few seats give you this much reach. 

What you get to do in this role 

  • Own and defend the multi-year strategic position for Technology Workflows, and keep it current as the AI landscape moves. Produce the written arguments and pre-reads that leadership actually decides from. 

  • Set market sizing and category definition for the business, including where the current and future addressable market genuinely is rather than where the analyst taxonomy says it is. 

  • Shape pricing and packaging strategy across the portfolio, including the shift of consumption-based products toward outcome-based models, in partnership with product managers, pricing, finance, and the platform packaging teams. 

  • Own inorganic strategy for the business: source and evaluate acquisition, acquihire, and partnership candidates across the Technology Workflows portfolio.  Form a technical point of view, convene product and engineering diligence, and hand corporate development and Technology Workflows leadership a recommendation with a thesis attached. 

  • Build and maintain the partner and ecosystem framework—which partners matter, why, and how each one fits—across multiple categories such as observability, endpoint, operational technology, and systems integrator relationships. 

  • Represent the business in executive and customer forums, including the CIO Product Advisory Council, the annual strategy cycle, and the twelve-month product roadmap review. Write the content, present it live, and carry the commitments it creates. 

  • Maintain the competitive picture for AI-native technology operations and surface how our own products and packaging must evolve with how the market is being sold. 

  • Partner across product leadership for service management, operations, configuration, asset management and portfolio management, plus Platform, AI, pricing, marketing, and analyst relations—with influence rather than authority. 

To be successful in this role you have 

  • Strong analytical and presentation skills in deeply technical fields.  An engineering degree with 10+ years of product leadership/product development experience and an MBA with 10+ years of business leadership and execution are assets. 

  • 15+ years in enterprise software with a focus on technical IT or production operations – or direct experience running technical estates, with significant time spent operating at or alongside the executive table 

  • Deep domain knowledge in how hardware and software is built, deployed, and run, and the tooling and tech stacks involved.  You must be able to hold a technical conversation with a startup CTO and tell whether the architecture claim is real.  You must be able to converse with customers and practitioners in their own vernacular and understand how they do their work and the ecosystem of tools they use to get it done. 

  • Experience with development and ownership of a strategic position that changed what a business did—not a deck that circulated, a decision that moved. 

  • Experience evaluating companies for acquisition, acquihire, or deep partnership, including forming an independent technical view and coordinating diligence across product and engineering. 

  • Strong commercial instincts across pricing, packaging, and market sizing 

  • Strong analytical skills and the willingness to challenge an analysis you were handed. 

  • Exceptional written communication. This role persuades senior leaders in prose and in pre-reads, often before ever presenting live. 

  • Executive presence with external audiences, including large enterprise CIOs and startup founders. You will be the most senior product voice in the room more often than not. 

  • Comfort operating without a team. You build coalitions, borrow capacity, and get outcomes through people who do not report to you. 

  • Experience integrating AI into work processes, strategic direction, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, reviewing AI-influenced insights, or examining how AI changes your function or industry. 

  • A strong full-stack understanding of on-premise infrastructure, the public cloud, DevOps practices, how software is created/deployed/run, and the tooling and engineering practices along the way. 

Nice to have 

  • Background spanning both the IT estate and the production/DevOps estate.

title: Staff AI Engineer, Agentic AI Harness & Quality - Moveworks
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!
 

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Role

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with expertise building AI-native product and platform to join us in expanding ServiceNow’s customer-facing agentic AI capabilities.

As a member of the Agentic AI Harness & Quality team, you will have all the tools of modern agentic AI engineering at your disposal, from frontier LLMs and tools to all the infrastructure needed to tune, evaluate, and serve AI agents in production. We are an eval-driven, data-centric team, and you will have the assistance of a world-class annotation team to build error-free, inclusive, and privacy-preserving datasets for tuning and evals.

You will push the envelope of AI performance in production, in every meaning of the word “performance”: not just accuracy and quality of outputs, but also latency, reliability, and capability of the end-to-end user-facing system as a whole. Successful AI engineers on the team are motivated to design and maintain high-performing compound AI systems.

Our team indexes on increasing our ability to move fast, solving challenging product and engineering challenges, and pushing the envelope of agent reliability and value provided to customers. Your work will impact our team’s core objective to build the highest-performing enterprise assistant platform the world has ever seen, in close collaboration with other functions within Moveworks and ServiceNow as a whole.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Apply software engineering and compound AI system engineering to create lasting value for all our customers

  • Drive quality in agent behavior, both in terms of increasing success rate at achieving goals set by end users and decreasing misbehavior in the customer business environment

  • Take on exciting and difficult challenges in AI harness engineering, such as agent cognitive architecture, eval benchmark creation, context engineering, generative UI, dynamic agent orchestration, multimodal I/O such as image and voice, multilinguality, conversational memory management, reasoning strategies, grounding and verifiability for generated text, deployment safety, and automatic harness optimization

  • Read, discuss, and build on the latest AI research and open-source repositories and models

  • Research and develop innovative, scalable and dynamic solutions to hard problems

  • Use your knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and LLMs to make improvements to the agentic harness and its AI components, evaluate them with small scale experiments and productionize your solutions at scale

  • Partner closely with web and chat platform engineering teams to turn harness investments into delightful user experiences that wow our customers

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Drive to ship product improvements with production-quality, fully unit-tested code and rigorously-evaluated updates to models, prompts, context curation code, or other tunable system components

  • Solid grasp of LLM and agent evaluation fundamentals, especially for agent action trajectories, generated text, and non-uniform sampling regimes

  • Attention to detail and high standard of data quality for eval datasets

  • Thoughtfulness about API contracts and implications of exposing a platform feature to a given type of stakeholder or end user

  • Readiness to hit the ground running in a Mac development environment, programming in Python and/or Golang with the assistance of coding agents

  • Familiarity with industry standard agent architectures and large language models

  • Critical reading skill to catch subtle “miscommunication bugs” in English-language agent instructions

  • Ability to fix miscommunication bugs with precise writing and evals

  • Desire to move fast with a high degree of ownership

  • Drive to ship product improvements with production-grade code

  • Strong appetite for continuous incremental wins and completing challenging projects fast

  • High level of curiosity about engineering outside of immediate discipline and ongoing desire to learn and stay at the cutting edge of agentic AI

Job Description

About the team:   

This role will support the Strategic Partnerships team within Central Product Management. The Strategic Partnerships team works with the leading technology and AI native companies to define a product led partnership motion, including building high value joint solutions and defining the ideal GTM, with an eye to accelerating customers adopting and getting value from AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.  The Strategic partnership team is focused on activating strategic partnerships and driving adoption of the joint solutions. 

Why This Role Matters:  

Enterprise leaders aren’t just experimenting with AI—they’re demanding outcomes. The next wave of adoption will be led by those who can move fast, deliver measurable value, and transform 1-off wins into repeatable success.  The lines are blurring across platforms, with coopetition being the new normal. The partnerships team sits at the intersection of this coopetition and helps define the better together where applicable. 

As a Strategic Partnerships Technical Program Manager, you operate on the frontlines of transformation. You will support ServiceNow’s cross-functional Strategic Partnership teams in organizational direction and structure, build partnerships, unblock delivery challenges, and ensure scalability. Your leadership accelerates innovation and drives repeatable success across industries. You shape internal tooling, build internal relationships, manage the customer portfolio, and cultivate a culture of excellence and impact.   

Who You Are:  

You are a dynamic and innovative problem-solver who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a strong analytical mindset while keeping focus on the bigger picture. You have a background managing SDLC processes and a portfolio of projects while keeping a customer-first mentality. You have a passion for AI and scaling innovation. You are curious and knowledgeable on the ecosystem of platforms. You excel at transforming ambiguity into clarity and have hands on experience driving projects/programs end to end.   

What You’ll Do:  

Manage the Partner Build Portfolio  

  • Manage the portfolio of partner engagements, overseeing phases, delivery timelines, scope, and outcomes for each engagement. 
  • Maintain a single source of truth for engagement progress, risks, and outcomes. 
  • In partnership with Strategic Partnership Leaders, balance priorities across accounts to ensure resources are allocated effectively. 
  • Aggregate engagement learnings to influence and scale go forward engagements. 
  • Organize complex, ambiguous problems into prioritized milestones, deliverables, and success criteria for engagements, translating business objectives into execution strategy (tactical and strategic). 
  • Help manage risks, dependencies and escalate impediments, as well as releases and navigating AI release requirements. 

Establish and Maintain Product & Engineering Partnerships + Feedback Loops 

  • Serve as central liaison between Strategic Partnerships, Applied AI FDE, Product, Engineering, Experience (UI/UX) and supporting orgs. 
  • Define and operationalize a structured model for engaging Strategic partnership team and broader APEX org. 
  • Work with Strategic Partnership leaders to translate engagement insights and patterns into actionable product feedback, influencing and tracking engagement to platform innovation progress. 
  • Develop standardized intake templates, RACIs, and collaboration playbooks.  

Drive Build Scale & Repeatability  

  • Capture lessons from early engagements (Phase 0 setup through rollout) and codify best practices. 
  • Implement tools, dashboards, and automation to streamline delivery and accelerate engagement impact and velocity. 
  • Drive process improvements and create documentation to promote best practices using automation to replace repeatable, operational tasks. 

Create Communication, Visibility & Governance Structure  

  • Centralize and manage all Strategic Partnerships documentation, resources, and operational structure. 
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure clarity and execution. 
  • Establish consistent reporting cadence for engagement status, metrics, and risks.  
  • Create executive-ready dashboards and summaries for leadership visibility. 
  • Drive internal storytelling on product adoption, innovation velocity, and customer value. 
  • Reinforce transparency, learning, and disciplined scale across the program. 
  • Seek to continuously grow by proactively seeking and embracing constructive feedback, as well as provide feedback to colleagues to encourage an open and collaborative culture.  

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of portfolio/program management experience in mid/large-size software development companies. 
  • A solid understanding of SDLC and release management practices in cloud-based SaaS product organizations.   
  • Prior work delivering AI or intelligent workflow solutions at scale, with proven success in deploying AI solutions that delivered tangible customer impact. 
  • Familiarity with AI governance, compliance, and enterprise security practices.  
  • Up to 25% travel required (Customer Onsite). 

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Demonstrated competence in key AI/ML software engineering program management best practices: program planning, schedule construction and management; risk assessment & mitigation, dependency management, change management, and predictive metrics. 
  • Outstanding collaboration and communication skills - clearly communicate changes, requests, and deadlines to the teams and risks, status, progress, and decisions to a variety of audiences including executives. 
  • Passion for working with people in technical and innovative environments, with the ability to work well with many different types of personalities in various functions. 
  • Strong leadership and relationship building skills to influence and motivate without authority - masterful in the art of bringing people together. 
  • Strong facilitation skills to lead/drive a variety of build events, with a high regard for quality, drive for continuous improvement across the organization, and ability to keep the big picture in view. 
  • Experience deploying AI solutions to production and skilled at identifying waste/delays in AI end-to-end development, deployment, and release processes is a plus. 
  • Exceptional team building and team management skills, including interpersonal skills, conflict resolution, and negotiation. 
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

This is a high-impact opportunity to sit at the intersection of product management, partner enablement, and customer advocacy within one of ServiceNow's most strategically important and high-growth business units. As Senior Manager, Partner Product Enablement & Advocacy, you will be the outbound voice of AI Product Management to the EmployeeWorks from ServiceNow partner ecosystem, equipping partners to position, demo, implement, and sell our products with confidence, while bringing partner feedback back to shape what we build. 

Partners are customers of ours too. They invest in our platform, build practices around it, and put their reputations on the outcomes they deliver. You will treat them that way: advocating for their needs inside the business, closing the loop on what they tell us, and making sure the partner experience is as strong as the end-customer experience. You will also support the GVP of AI Product Management in partner executive engagements and help draft the executive communications that go out under the GVP's name. 

This role reports to the Chief of Staff to the GVP of AI Product Management, within the APEX organization, and follows a hybrid work model. The role is Bay Area based, preferably out of the EmployeeWorks from ServiceNow office in Mountain View, CA. 

What you get to do in this role 

Own outbound product management for partners 

  • Translate product strategy, roadmap, and release priorities into clear, partner-ready messaging, so partners understand what is shipping, why it matters, and how to position it 

  • Serve as the day-to-day product point of contact for a defined set of strategic partners (e.g., priority GSIs, resellers, and technology partners), ensuring they have timely, accurate, and consistent product information 

  • Develop and maintain the partner-facing product narrative, including packaging and positioning, competitive differentiation, and ideal use cases, in partnership with Product Marketing and Sales 

  • Prepare product leadership for partner engagements with briefings, talk tracks, and follow-through on commitments made 

  • Help define and test partner readiness for new capabilities and releases: packaging, documentation, deployment guides, support escalation paths, and operational playbooks 

  • Lead partner early access programs to gather feedback and validate new product capabilities before general availability 

  • Lead partner adoption efforts for new releases and major capabilities, including announcements, release notes, and demo assets 

Build and run partner enablement 

  • Design and deliver enablement programs that take partners from awareness to certified, including training curriculum, demo kits, solution guides, battlecards, and reference architectures 

  • Deliver live product demos and workshops to partner sales, pre-sales, and delivery teams, and equip partners to run compelling demos on their own 

  • Equip partner sales, pre-sales, and delivery teams with talk tracks, discovery questions, ROI narratives, competitive objection handling, implementation checklists, and troubleshooting guides 

  • Create scalable enablement assets and cadences (launch briefings, office hours, release readouts) so product updates reach partners quickly and consistently 

  • Manage partner community engagement and create content that drives interest and success 

  • Partner with Partner Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, and Professional Services to align enablement with partner go-to-market motions 

Advocate for partners as customers 

  • Act as the internal voice of the partner, representing partner needs, friction points, and priorities in product planning, packaging, and GTM discussions 

  • Run structured partner feedback loops (advisory sessions, partner councils, post-engagement reviews) and synthesize themes into insights that inform roadmap and GTM priorities 

  • Translate partner and field deployment learnings into prioritized requirements with crisp acceptance criteria for inbound product managers 

  • Manage escalations when strategic partners hit product, enablement, or program issues: mobilize the right teams, drive resolution, elevate to leadership when needed, and keep partners informed throughout 

  • Close the loop with partners on what we heard and what we did about it, building trust and long-term partner health 

  • Monitor partner satisfaction and experience, identifying risks and opportunities across the partner lifecycle 

Support executive engagement and GVP-level communications 

  • Support the GVP of AI Product Management and product leadership in partner executive engagements, bringing product and roadmap context and, where appropriate, joining or leading working-level conversations on the GVP's behalf 

  • Prepare the GVP for partner executive engagements with briefings, stakeholder context, talk tracks, and clear asks, and drive follow-through on commitments afterward 

  • Draft executive-level communications for the GVP, including presentations, decks, documents, emails, and partner-facing updates, that are brief, scannable, and benefit-led, with final review by the GVP and Chief of Staff before release 

Engage cross-functionally on key company priorities 

  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, GTM, Partnerships, and Customer Success to ensure partner commitments are met and momentum is maintained 

  • Partner with other outbound PMs to keep partner, customer, and field messaging aligned and avoid duplicated or conflicting enablement 

  • Partner with inbound PMs and designers to bring partner feedback into product requirements and experience design, and to keep partners informed on what is changing and why 

  • Work with Professional Services and the partner assurance team to support partner delivery quality and readiness, and to resolve implementation issues quickly 

  • Contribute to a high-performing team, sharing best practices, bringing a continuous improvement mindset, and raising the quality and consistency of partner engagement across the organization 

Qualifications

Successful candidates typically bring: 

  • Proven ability to thrive in a highly dynamic environment where written guides and playbooks are sparse and changes occur nearly daily: you create structure where none exists, ramp quickly, ask sharp questions, stay current without being told, and keep partners and leadership aligned as things shift 

  • 6 to 9 years of experience spanning product management, partner enablement, solutions consulting, or similar functions; background in technical pre-sales, partner or channel programs, or product strategy strongly preferred 

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise software demos or technical enablement; a technical background (CS / engineering) is a plus 

  • Product fluency in AI and enterprise SaaS: able to demo confidently, speak credibly to roadmap, and connect technical capabilities to partner and customer outcomes; hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, EmployeeWorks, or similar) a plus 

  • Working knowledge of enterprise deployment realities that partners navigate in customer implementations, such as SSO/OAuth/SAML, permissions and access controls, data governance, security reviews, and compliance 

  • Experience working with or within partner ecosystems (GSIs, resellers, ISVs, or alliances) and an understanding of how partners build practices, sell, and deliver 

  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills: equally comfortable running a hands-on partner workshop as presenting to senior partner and internal executives, with the ability to simplify complexity without losing technical truth 

  • Executive presence and proven ability to support senior leaders in external engagements and draft on their behalf: polished decks, documents, and emails in an executive's voice, with strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and discretion with confidential information 

  • Proven operator in cross-functional environments: strong prioritization instincts, able to build consensus and drive results without direct authority 

  • Analytical approach to adoption: you define metrics, instrument success, and make data-informed recommendations 

  • Customer-advocate mindset: able to represent an external audience's needs internally, give candid feedback, and follow through 

  • Strong judgment about when to act independently and when to escalate, with the ability to navigate ambiguity 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve how work gets done, from research and synthesis to content creation and workflow automation; proficiency with PowerPoint, Excel, PowerBI, Dynamics, and leading productivity tools 

  • Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, preferably out of the EmployeeWorks from ServiceNow office in Mountain View, CA, with the ability to work in a hybrid model

locations: New York, NEW YORK, United States
descriptionHtml:

Job Description

About the Role

ServiceNow is extending its two-tier channel model across the US and Canada with Carahsoft as its authorized distributor. The Senior GTM Operations Manager, Distribution will own the onboarding and day-to-day operation of Carahsoft, from standing up operating frameworks to activating reseller partners and driving predictable, compliant revenue.

This is a hands-on operational role during a program launch. The person in this role will be the primary operational point of contact between ServiceNow and Carahsoft, and will protect program integrity while accelerating time to revenue. Because Carahsoft’s public sector and commercial business spans federal, state and local, and enterprise accounts, this role requires deep familiarity with US contracting vehicles, procurement rules, and reseller operations.

Key Responsibilities

Distributor operating framework

  • Design and stand up the operational framework for Carahsoft across the US and Canada, including processes, roles, service levels, and escalation paths.
  • Define the operating cadence (business reviews, forecast calls, issue triage) and the documentation that governs it.
  • Establish clear decision rights between ServiceNow and Carahsoft for pricing, deal registration, partner eligibility, and exceptions.

Reseller activation and onboarding

  • Own the end-to-end reseller onboarding process through Carahsoft, from partner qualification through certification, enablement, and first deal.
  • Work with Carahsoft’s partner and vendor teams to build activation plans and track partner readiness against targets.
  • Identify enablement gaps and coordinate with ServiceNow partner enablement to close them.

Deal flow and revenue operations

  • Manage deal flow from reseller registration through quote, order, fulfillment, and booking, and resolve bottlenecks as they arise.
  • Monitor pipeline and bookings data from Carahsoft and produce regular performance reporting for ServiceNow leadership.
  • Ensure transactions meet ServiceNow program rules, pricing governance, and contract terms.

Prebuy and inventory coordination

  • Coordinate prebuy and inventory structures with Carahsoft where applicable, including forecasting, replenishment, and working capital considerations.
  • Track inventory positions and flag risk early to protect margin and commitments.

Contract vehicle and compliance management

  • Ensure Carahsoft’s operations align with US federal, state, and local procurement requirements, including GSA schedules, cooperative contracts, and public sector contracting vehicles.
  • Support compliance with trade and export controls, sales tax and invoicing obligations, and data privacy requirements across US and Canadian operations.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Trade Compliance to resolve jurisdiction-specific questions before they become program issues.

Stakeholder management

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact between ServiceNow and Carahsoft.
  • Build working relationships with ServiceNow US and Canada sales leaders, partner managers, and central GPC functions, and represent Carahsoft’s operational needs internally.
  • Escalate issues with clear options and recommendations, and drive them to resolution.

Performance and continuous improvement

Job Description

The Customer Success Executive—US Manufacturing is a senior individual contributor role within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG), responsible for driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of high-value US Manufacturing accounts. This role carries full accountability for the commercial health and strategic growth of assigned accounts—operating with the ownership mentality of a general manager at the account level.

This is not an account-monitoring role. We are looking for a commercially minded operator who has personally driven demonstrable YoY growth within a large portfolio, built trusted executive relationships, and executed cross-functional motions that convert platform adoption into measurable business outcomes. You will serve as the primary post-sales customer executive for your accounts—a strategic advisor to manufacturing CIOs and senior IT leaders—and partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and peer CEG functions to ensure customers realize the full value of their ServiceNow investment and view us as a long-term digital transformation partner.

What you get to do in this role

• Own account-level commercial performance. Drive GRR, NRR, and renewal outcomes for your assigned accounts through proactive risk management, downsell prevention, and expansion motions.

• Engage at the executive level as a strategic advisor. Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior IT stakeholders. Co-develop digital transformation strategies with customer executives, positioning ServiceNow as the strategic platform partner for their modernization and AI agendas. Bring relevant industry thought leadership and a consulting mindset to every engagement. Your executive presence and credibility at this level must be a proven strength, not an aspiration.

• Translate customer strategy into a ServiceNow roadmap. Take each customer’s enterprise priorities—modernization, cost-out mandates, AI ambitions—and map them to a phased ServiceNow roadmap that connects platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes. You bridge the gap between what the C-suite wants to achieve and how the platform gets them there.

• Run complex transformations in our largest accounts. Own governance, delivery excellence, and cross-functional orchestration across multiple business units and concurrent workstreams—defining governance models aligned to business and platform strategy and evolving them as engagements scale.

• Tell the story through data. Deliver compelling executive presentations—both internally and to customers—that articulate the value of ServiceNow through data-driven narratives. You are equally effective presenting a portfolio review to leadership and standing in front of a customer CIO making the case for platform expansion.

• Drive AI consumption and platform adoption. Own AI consumption as a strategic KPI within your accounts. Design and execute adoption journeys that convert license entitlements into measurable business outcomes, with a focus on emerging agentic capabilities.

• Set success metrics and drive value realization. Establish clear, measurable success metrics with each customer. Regularly review progress, proactively identify risks, and refine business transformation plans to

ensure milestones are met and value is realized. Work with internal teams and the customer to develop strategies that overcome barriers on the path to outcomes.

• Champion the voice of the customer. Synthesize industry-specific feedback, feature requests, and adoption blockers into structured input for Product Engineering and roadmap prioritization. Stay current on manufacturing industry trends, regulatory environments, and digital transformation priorities shaping your accounts.

• Operationalize customer health at scale. Define and manage operational KPIs for your portfolio—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Deliver regular reporting on customer health, adoption trends, downsell risk, and advocacy pipeline. Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms to automate insights and drive proactive outreach.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. You combine deep post-sales expertise with the executive presence to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing CIOs and a bias toward action that turns customer outcomes into revenue outcomes. You will be an expert in governance, strategy, value alignment, and execution across cross-functional teams, with a track record of delivering scalable, repeatable success. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.

To be successful in this role, you will need

• AI driven. Experience leveraging or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.

• Educational background. BA/BS or equivalent required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

• Experience. 10–15 years of experience in management consulting, enterprise SaaS, senior customer success, or technology-enabled business transformation roles.

• Strategic account ownership. Demonstrated experience operating as the primary post-sales customer success executive—owning the commercial outcomes, adoption trajectory, and renewal health. You drive long-term commercial strategy with a deep understanding of how to grow and protect strategic relationships.

• Transformational leadership expertise. Demonstrated success in running large-scale, strategic account transformations and exceeding business objectives. Proven ability to build repeatable processes for scalable execution while maintaining a hands-on approach to ensure critical tasks are completed.

• Business acumen. Exceptional commercial instincts. You think in portfolio economics, understand the interplay between adoption, consumption, and revenue, and can translate customer outcomes into business impact narratives that resonate with Finance, Sales leadership, and executive sponsors.

• Executive presence and C-suite engagement. Proven ability to engage at the C-suite level—both with customers and internally. Direct experience partnering with CIOs and senior IT executives to co-develop digital transformation strategies. You bring gravitas, credibility, and the ability to influence without relying on positional authority.

• Data storytelling. Ability to translate complex adoption metrics, value realization, and portfolio performance into executive-level narratives that drive decisions.

• Cross-functional collaboration. Strong track record building productive relationships across Sales, Presales, Delivery, Product, and Enablement in matrixed, fast-paced environments. You lead through influence, not org-chart authority.

• Customer centricity and industry awareness. Deep understanding of how manufacturing enterprises operate, what drives their priorities, and where friction lives. You instinctively orient around the customer’s outcomes—anticipating concerns, removing barriers to satisfaction, and ensuring every interaction reinforces ServiceNow’s position as a trusted partner. Familiarity with adjacent verticals (Energy, Transportation, Services) is a plus.

• Platform knowledge. Experience overseeing technical account health—adoption telemetry, integration health, platform upgrades, and solution expansion. Background with AI/ML platform products or driving AI adoption programs is a significant differentiator.

• Adaptability and travel. Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment. Willingness to travel domestically to strategic customer sites as required.

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

Platform Security Team

Platform Security builds foundational security infrastructure and AI-driven detection systems for enterprise-scale operations. Our mission is to make security proactive, intelligent, and seamlessly integrated into the ServiceNow platform. Outbound Security within Platform Security owns the controls on traffic leaving the ServiceNow platform across multiple domains: egress filtering and policy, outbound proxying, SSRF protection, data exfiltration prevention, and workload egress identity for a SaaS platform. This is core, regulated-environment security engineering.

Role Summary

As a Staff AI Security & Outbound Security Engineer, you will architect and deliver enterprise-scale security solutions that integrate outbound security systems with machine learning, reasoning engines, and real-time inference. You will bring deep expertise in network and application egress security, strong technical leadership, and hands-on machine learning depth. You will design and operate intelligent, adaptive security systems for egress control, outbound proxy infrastructure, and exfiltration detection at SaaS scale.

What You Get to Do in This Role

•       Design, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable, secure outbound security services meeting FIPS compliance and regulated-environment requirements

•       Architect and operate mission-critical egress services with reliability and security as first-class design constraints, not afterthoughts

•       Own services end-to-end on Kubernetes in a multi-tenant SaaS environment: deployment, scaling, on-call, incident response

•       Bring a security mindset to every design review: threat model the feature, not just the happy path. This is a deliberate area we're leveling up as a team

•       Evaluate where AI/ML has a legitimate role in outbound security, such as anomaly detection in egress traffic, ML-assisted destination risk scoring, and AI-assisted code review for SSRF and unsafe outbound-request patterns, and separate that from where it's a distraction

•       Collaborate with product owners, security architects, and platform teams to translate compliance and security requirements into working outbound security frameworks

•       Mentor engineers on secure coding, outbound-request pitfalls (SSRF, DNS rebinding, open redirects, unrestricted egress), and design review rigor

•       Stay current on evolving exfiltration techniques and egress-security advancements, including post-quantum readiness for outbound TLS, and bring that forward before it's a compliance deadline

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

•       8+ years of professional software engineering experience; Java, Go, or a comparable strongly-typed language at production scale

•       Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OO design, distributed systems tradeoffs

•       Production experience running services on Kubernetes (deployments, Helm, CI/CD) in a SaaS/multi-tenant environment. This is assumed, not a differentiator

•       Working understanding of core network and application security concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, TLS/PKI fundamentals, proxies, firewalls, allowlisting/denylisting)

•       Demonstrated security-first engineering habits: secure coding practices, threat modeling, code review discipline

Preferred Qualifications

•       Direct experience in outbound/egress security, forward proxies, SSRF mitigation, DNS security, or data loss/exfiltration prevention, including egress gateways, network policy enforcement, or TLS inspection

•      AuthN/AuthZ, IAM, Certificates, Identity, secure connectivity and external network topology experience

•       Some hands-on AI/ML exposure. Not a research background, but real experience applying ML techniques to security/ops problems (anomaly detection, risk scoring, log/telemetry analysis) or critically integrating LLM tooling into engineering workflows

•       Experience with regulated environments (FIPS 140-2/3, FedRAMP, Common Criteria, or similar)

•       Exposure to post-quantum cryptography in the context of outbound TLS and secure communications

•       Track record mentoring engineers and raising the security bar on a team, not just shipping features

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Job Description

What you get to do in this role: 

About the Team 

The Strategy, Planning, and Operations (SPO) team serves as the strategic engine of the Customer Excellence Group (CEG) organization. Within SPO, the Central Strategy team drives high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that shape strategy, improve execution, and accelerate performance across the business, spanning Strategy, Initiative Delivery, Strategic Programs, and Realization. 

The Analytics + Insights pillar sits within Central Strategy and leads CEG’s analytics function. It turns data into insights that strengthen customer health, accelerate adoption, and directly inform leadership decisions. The pillar owns CEG executive scorecards, OKR metrics and targets, corporate OKR and SPM reporting, and Quarterly Impact Insights, and supports the AI Command Center, Global Forecast Call, and Mission Control. We are a lean team, so prioritization and simplification are part of everyone’s job. 

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Analytics & Insights who can turn executive reporting into strategic decisions. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports. 

CEG’s scorecards, OKR/SPM reporting, and Quarterly Impact Insights are the foundation of the role. You will be accountable for their accuracy and narrative, and you will use them as your early-warning system: spotting emerging issues, connecting signals across reporting streams, and deciding what deserves a deeper look. You will then build the model or analysis, and bring the CEG Leadership Team a clear recommendation and a plan for follow-through with partners across product, engineering, sales, marketing, finance, and customer success. 

This is a hands-on role. Recurring analytical reporting is real work that comes with the job. The expectation is that you use what it shows to set and drive the analytical agenda. 

What You’ll Do 

Run the reporting engine 

  • Be accountable for CEG executive scorecards across global, geo, and major-area views, including commentary on what changed, why, and what leadership should do about it. 

  • Define and maintain CEG OKR metrics and targets, along with adoption and downsell reporting. 

  • Run the corporate OKR/SPM reporting cycle with metric owners, and make sure figures reconcile across scorecards, OKR submissions, and executive materials before they reach leadership. 

  • Own the analysis and executive narrative for Quarterly Impact Insights, working with Finance on the underlying data. 

  • Contribute account-level analysis and metrics to the AI Command Center and the Global Forecast Call. Stay fluent in the weekly D&L forecast and Partner 360 ROI so you can connect them to your analyses. 

Find what matters and analyze it 

  • Review each reporting cycle for emerging risks, anomalies, and open questions, and decide which warrant deeper analysis. 

  • Structure ambiguous problems, form hypotheses, and build driver-based models and scenarios that quantify what is at stake and what would change the outcome. 

  • Deliver strategic analyses that end in a recommendation, a named decision-maker, and agreed next steps. 

  • Turn recurring ad hoc requests, such as Impact coverage analysis and account enrichment for undeployed backlog work, into planned analyses instead of one-off scrambles. 

  • Drive follow-through with cross-functional partners, influencing without direct authority. 

Make the system better 

  • Reduce manual consolidation through automation, standard templates, and consistent metric definitions across reporting streams. 

  • Recommend which reports and metrics to simplify, merge, or retire based on how leaders actually use them. 

  • Apply AI where it improves the speed or quality of analysis, and evaluate critically where it doesn’t. 

Qualifications

Required 

  • Experience: 8+ years in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, or strategy and operations roles, where rigorous analysis and executive decision support were core to the job. We value the modeling discipline these paths build, and we also welcome analytics leaders from technology companies who can show the same. 

  • Modeling and analytical rigor: Advanced Excel (or equivalent) with demonstrated experience building financial or operational models that informed an executive decision. You can show us a model you built and explain the judgment behind it. 

  • Strategic problem-solving: Experience structuring ambiguous problems, finding the signal in recurring metrics, and recommending a course of action. 

  • Executive communication: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders through clear storytelling and analytical confidence. 

  • Collaboration: Experience in a matrixed environment, aligning stakeholders and following through on recommendations without direct authority. 

  • Ownership of delivery: Comfortable owning recurring reporting with high accuracy, and using it as the starting point for deeper work. 

Preferred 

  • Experience owning executive scorecards, OKR or operating-metric reporting, or quarterly business reviews. 

  • Power BI and experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake. 

  • Working knowledge of SaaS business drivers such as adoption, renewal, and expansion. 

  • Experience using AI to improve analysis, decision-making, or operational processes.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

**PLEASE NOTE** This role has a minimum of 2 days per week in Santa Clara or San Diego offices requirement.

If you are unable to come into the Santa Clara office a minimum of 2 days per week, please do not apply. Thank you. 

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) 
 
The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact.

This role exists so Product Security's technical programs land on time. It takes security strategy and turns it into defined workstreams with a credible sequence, then drives them to measured closure, and is technical enough to argue that sequencing and its tradeoffs directly with senior leaders rather than relaying them. This reports directly to the VP of Product Security. 


Five areas owned end to end:

  • Strategy to workstream translation. Takes strategic direction and ambiguous initiatives and decomposes them into defined workstreams with owners, dependencies, milestones, and a defensible sequence. Owns the "how and in what order," including what must be true before a workstream can start and what gets staged versus run in parallel.
  • Technical program delivery. Secure-by-default initiatives, tooling rollouts, and remediation campaigns from intake through closure and measurement. Owns the plan, the sequencing, and the outcome, not just the tracking.
  • Cross-team dependency and release coordination. Launches, sequencing, and critical-path management where Product Security gates an engineering ship. 
  • Engineering-facing delivery escalation. The first stop when security work is blocked or contested. Resolves at the engineering level wherever possible and escalates with a recommendation when it cannot.

Decision rights:

  • Decides: how strategy decomposes into workstreams and in what order they run; how individual programs are structured, sequenced, and staged; technical tradeoffs within a program; when a program is complete and what evidence closes it.
  • Recommends: prioritization tradeoffs across programs and workstreams; which initiatives to stop, defer, or absorb; where the strategy is not sequence-able as written and needs a scope or timeline change.

Key relationships:

  • VP, Product Security: escalation path for decisions that require prioritization authority. Not the day-to-day reporting relationship for portfolio status.
  • Product Security Directors and Team leads: Peers and delivery partners. Programs run through their teams; this role does not direct their employees.
  • Engineering partner teams: Internal customers for security work and the primary working relationship day to day.
  • Business Operations: Strategy and Business Operations sets strategic direction with the VP and leadership team and owns the operating rhythm, portfolio reporting, and OKR linkage; this role translates that direction into sequenced workstreams and supplies delivery truth back into it. Escalates cross-program conflicts, aging risk, and sequencing infeasibility here for prioritization.

Success at 6, 12, and 24 months:

  • 6 months. Has mapped the assigned programs and their dependencies across engineering and knows where the real constraints sit. Delivery status is reliable enough to report from.
  • 12 months. Takes net-new, ambiguous security initiatives and shapes them into sequenced, delivered outcomes without a playbook. Sequencing recommendations carry enough credibility that leadership shapes commitments around them before making them externally. Has visibly influenced how security requirements enter the SDLC upstream, with a measurable reduction in downstream remediation load.
  • 24 months. Takes net-new, ambiguous security initiatives and shapes them into delivered outcomes without a playbook. 
     

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 12 years of technical program or project management, with 3+ in security, product security, or a closely adjacent technical domain. Has independently run multi-team programs from intake to close. Or similar experience plus education
  • Hands-on software development background, or enough time embedded with engineering teams to read a codebase, follow an architecture discussion, and challenge an engineering estimate without translation.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous strategic goal and produce a sequenced, resourced delivery plan that stakeholders commit to, including saying when the stated timeline is not achievable.
  • Experience in a large-scale product engineering organization shipping continuously at high volume, with the dependency and release complexity that comes with it.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive delivery through teams that do not report to them, including holding a release or negotiating an exception under pressure.
  • Familiarity with Secure Development Lifecycle frameworks such as NIST 800-218, BSIMM, and Microsoft SDL.
  • Familiarity with Software Development Lifecycle frameworks such as Agile, Scrum, and CI/CD.
  • Bachelor's in a technical or related field (CS, engineering, information security) or equivalent practical experience. Certifications that strengthen: PMP, CISSP, CSM, Security+.

  • Experience with the Kubernetes ecosystem, including Helm, Argo Workflows, Kustomize, Istio/Linkerd, Gateway API/Ingress, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and container runtime technologies.

title: Senior Reliability Engineer - Veza
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources—providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

Job Description

We are seeking an exceptional  Site Reliability Engineer to lead critical infrastructure initiatives and drive innovation across our organization. You'll architect scalable solutions, navigate complex technical challenges independently, and deliver results under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. You'll work cross-functionally alongside builders who have helped shape the success of companies such as Google, Okta, AWS, and Snowflake.

We are building the next generation identity security platform for the multi-cloud era - will you join us?

Strategic Leadership & Technical Execution

Job Description

About This Role

Universities, education departments and government agencies across Australia are being asked to serve students and citizens better with less. Enquiries, enrolments, applications and support often run across disconnected systems and teams. As a Senior Advisory Solution Consultant on our ANZ CRM & Industry Workflows team, you’ll help them rethink how those services work on ServiceNow.

This role leads our CRM specialist coverage for education across Australia. You’ll work with universities, TAFEs and state education departments. You’ll also support other state government agencies, and occasionally federal, alongside our wider public sector team. You’ll join a collaborative team that invests in your growth, and help shape how we take ServiceNow to education.

What you get to do in this role:  

  • Lead the education segment: Lead CRM pursuits across universities and education departments, from first discovery through to technical win. Work with Account Executives and field Solution Consultants on complex, multi-stakeholder deals, including formal RFPs.
  • Lead discovery and shape solutions: Turn institutional challenges into transformation strategies on ServiceNow’s platform. Think a university unifying student enquiries across faculties, or a state agency modernising how citizens apply for and renew services.

Configure demo environments, stand up lightweight POCs, wire integrations and style portal experiences. You need to be comfortable building things that work and fixing them when they don’t.

  • Set delivery up to succeed: Work with partners and our delivery teams so what we sell lands well with the customer.
  • Build ecosystem relationships: Connect with Product Management, technology partners and consulting firms to advocate for public sector customers and stay ahead of sector shifts.

ServiceNow is one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. You’ll get a whole sector to shape, with AI already live in customer conversations. You’ll have flexibility and trust in how you work, competitive pay with salary, variable incentives and equity, and the autonomy to bring your own thinking to complex problems.

The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) at ServiceNow is a customer-focused innovation group building intelligent software and smart user experiences using existing and latest advanced technologies to enable end-to-end, industry-leading work experiences for customers. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We build and evolve the AI platform, and partner with teams to build products and end-to-end AI-powered work experiences. In equal measure, we lay the foundations, research, experiment, and de-risk AI technologies that unlock new work experiences in the future.

You will play a major part in building AI and Machine Learning (ML) solutions that transform the user experience and workflow efficiency of enterprise services. Traditional analytical tools tend to require a technically knowledgeable user to produce even simple results. We are taking a completely fresh approach with the expectation that any user, regardless of technical knowledge, can use the AI/ML solutions we develop to operate the services in the enterprise setting in a thoughtful and scalable manner. We are just getting started with our early-adopter customers and we need your help in building and making available an amazing range of solutions to our 5k+ enterprise customers around the world.

  • Collaborate daily with a team of like-minded developers, product managers and quality engineers to produce quality software
  • Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, testing and delivery of high-quality solutions to our users

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Expertise in Go or Python, Design Patterns, time and space-efficient algorithms
  • Experience building new products that use challenging algorithms
  • Expertise in coding efficient, object-oriented, modularized and quality software
  • Knowledge of core AI/ML techniques and algorithms
  • Knowledge of unit testing, profiling, and code tuning

DevOps requirements

  • Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. 
  • Own observability for what you build — meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise.

  • AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt.

You should have experience with large-scale web applications, database platforms, distributed systems, Linux-based production environments, and a strong problem-solving mindset for reliability, automation, diagnostics, observability, and prevention. Qualified candidates will be responsible for leading a team of highly skilled engineers that push the limits of scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence. 

Do you 

  • Have experience leading teams of engineers and developing people? 
  • Enjoy problem solving and using an analytical mindset to understand why systems fail and how to prevent repeat issues? 
  • Have a technical background in roles including database engineering, reliability engineering, systems/cloud engineering, SRE, DevOps, or production engineering? 
  • Know Linux operating systems, databases, observability, diagnostics, and production troubleshooting well enough to guide engineers through complex investigations? 
  • Have an attitude of continuous improvement and a passion for removing inefficient, repetitive, or reactive processes through automation and engineering prevention? 

Answer 'yes' to these questions and we want to hear from you. Hit the Apply button and let's have a chat about the role and your skills and experiences. 

Let’s start with the role 

As a Sr Manager of the Data & Storage Reliability Engineering team your responsibilities will be: 

  • Define and execute the team-level strategy for prevention engineering, reliability, observability, resilience, and operational risk reduction across large-scale production environments. 
  • Lead initiatives that turn production signals, incident learnings, customer escalations, migration outcomes, and platform telemetry into durable engineering improvements. 
  • Partner closely with SWAT and Customer & Production Engineering to establish a continuous feedback loop between production operations and platform improvement. 
  • Drive improvements in observability, diagnostics, automation, reliability reviews, resiliency validation, migration readiness, and engineering guardrails. 
  • Identify recurring failure patterns, reliability risks, observability gaps, operational inefficiencies, scalability constraints, and performance bottlenecks, and drive action to reduce future customer impact. 
  • Establish reliability, resilience, observability, automation, and prevention goals for critical database and storage services. 
  • Champion proactive monitoring, production analytics, and automation to improve operational health and reduce repetitive manual work. 
  • Lead deep root cause analysis and ensure sustainable corrective actions are implemented for recurring issues and customer-impacting events. 
  • Partner with engineering leaders to influence database, storage, reliability, observability, and platform architecture priorities based on production evidence. 
  • Build and develop a world-class team of reliability, prevention, observability, and platform engineers. 
  • Own team management, recruitment, career development, objective setting, project prioritization, onboarding, and performance reviews. 
  • Manage an engineering team that supports production-facing work, including on-call or escalation participation where required. 
  • Drive a culture of intolerance for repetitive manual activities by promoting automation, self-service diagnostics, guardrails, and scalable engineering practices. 
  • Drive initiatives with partner teams to improve the reliability, resilience, scalability, and operational efficiency of the ServiceNow application and platform. 
  • Act as part of the escalation and crisis management ecosystem by helping convert immediate recovery learnings into sustainable engineering prevention. 
  • Analyze and evaluate existing processes to drive continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and prevention-oriented engineering practices. 
  • Provide training, documentation, dashboards, playbooks, and support to partner teams that interface with the Data & Storage Reliability Engineering team. 
  • Onboard new hires, new technologies, new systems, and new automations into the team to enable successful execution and scale. 

Qualifications

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving — using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function. 

  • 10+ years of experience in database engineering, reliability engineering, distributed systems, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, production engineering, or large-scale SaaS platform operations. 

  • 4+ years of engineering leadership experience, including leading engineers and cross-functional or distributed teams. 

  • Experience leading Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Production Engineering, Performance Engineering, or related technical teams. 

  • Strong expertise in database technologies, operating system performance, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and large-scale production environments. 

  • Solid understanding of reliability engineering, observability, diagnostics, root cause analysis, capacity planning, scalability engineering, resiliency, automation, and operational excellence. 

  • Experience translating production insights, customer escalations, incident learnings, platform telemetry, and recurring operational challenges into prioritized engineering work. 

  • Experience designing and improving observability, diagnostics, reliability reviews, migration readiness checks, resiliency validation, automation, and engineering guardrails. 

  • Strong understanding of tuning and troubleshooting across database, operating system, storage, network, and application layers. 

  • Proven experience identifying and resolving complex reliability, scalability, performance, efficiency, and operational bottlenecks in large-scale distributed environments. 

  • Experience leading customer-critical investigations involving reliability, capacity, performance, scalability, resilience, or operational risk challenges. 

  • Experience leveraging observability and telemetry platforms to analyze system behavior and drive platform improvements. 

  • Experience partnering with software engineering, infrastructure, production operations, and escalation organizations to improve platform reliability, scalability, efficiency, and production readiness. 

  • Experience driving engineering initiatives through data, metrics, incident learnings, telemetry, benchmarking, and measurable outcomes. 

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Desired Skills 

  • Experience operating large-scale enterprise database and storage platforms supporting mission-critical workloads.

Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.

ServiceNow

Job Description

As a member of our Solution Consulting team, you will have a major impact on our future success by supporting Moveworks Solution Sales. You will guide revenue for one of our  products with the support and partnership of Sales, Product Management, and the executive team. This is a hands-on technical consultant who can go wide and deep on solution delivery and solution positioning during sales cycles. 

What you get to do in this role:  

The Solution Consultant is a technical consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position and provide product-specific solutions during sales cycles while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

  • Support product sales as a technical and domain expert of a client-facing sales team that pursues customers and prospects across multiple industry markets
  • Lead discovery workshops to determine customers' challenges and give product demonstrations to align our solution with customer needs
  • Develop client partner relationships
  • Guide strategic programs in top accounts such as customer journey sessions for roadmap and outcome agreement
  • Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value
  • Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solution Consultants to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
  • Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
  • Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • A solid understanding of cloud architecture and RESTful APIs. Scripting or coding experience is beneficial to build prototypes of bespoke customer use-cases and integrations into systems unsupported by out-of-the-box Moveworks connectors. Familiarity with RPA, iPaaS, low-code/no-code tools is a plus.
  • 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or technical expertise with cloud software solutions
  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services
  • Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence
  • Travel, as necessary

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

ServiceNow is actively seeking a Chief of Staff to join the Global Partner function within the Global Partnerships & Channels Organization (GPC). Reporting directly to the GVP of Global Partnerships, the Chief of Staff will serve as a strategic partner and force multiplier, driving operational excellence, cross-functional alignment, and execution of high-impact initiatives across the global partnerships organization. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—turning vision into action, aligning leaders around clear priorities, and ensuring we deliver on what matters most.

As Chief of Staff, you will act as a trusted advisor, thought partner, and operational backbone for the GVP and the broader partnerships leadership team. You will lead critical planning processes, drive strategic initiatives end-to-end, and serve as a connective tissue across the organization—bridging communication gaps, unblocking obstacles, and ensuring the right work happens at the right pace.

This role is ideal for a strategic operator who thrives in ambiguity, excels at building relationships across all levels, and possesses the executive presence to represent leadership in high-stakes situations. A combination of exceptional analytical skills, operational rigor, strong communication abilities, and an entrepreneurial mindset will be critical for success.

Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership & Advisory

· Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the GVP of Global Partnerships, providing objective analysis, insights, and recommendations on strategic and tactical matters

Review public information (e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to remain updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect.

  • Demonstrated experience in territory strategy, planning and sales execution with measurable wins.
  • Ability to understand broad, macro-level business IT needs for a prospective client.
  • Ability to break down a complex sales process into discrete activities and see steps ahead to deliver customer outcomes.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to inspire and lead a matrix team to establish trust and credibility with prospective customers.
  • Demonstrated perseverance, resilience, and savvy to find new creative paths to open doors, increase interaction and participation, and engage prospects.
  • The ideal candidate lives our values to “stay hungry and humble” and doesn’t take their success for granted, always curious, ready to learn and evolve.
  • Travel up to 50% (depending on geography/region)

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of quota carrying, technology solution-based direct sales experience, penetrating net new accounts within a territory.
