Job Description

Role 

This is a principal-level security architecture and strategy role with enterprise-wide scope. You will set security direction across ServiceNow’s products and platforms, define the controls and standards that teams build against, and serve as a technical authority on complex and emerging threats, including those introduced by AI and agentic systems. You’ll also drive the use of AI to strengthen security itself, applying it to detection, triage, and security analysis. You’ll partner with security research teams to turn their findings into requirements and roadmap priorities, and represent ServiceNow’s security posture externally and to executive leadership. We’re looking for a deep security or engineering expert; experience with AI security is a plus, not a prerequisite. 

What you'll do 

  • Contribute to the security strategy and reference architecture across the company’s products and platforms 
  • Lead threat modeling for complex and novel systems, including AI and agentic systems where established patterns don’t yet exist 
  • Define platform-wide security standards, including access-control and data-boundary models that other teams build against 
  • Establish what secure-by-design means for new technologies, including AI, and drive adoption across engineering organisations 
  • Set methodology and priorities for red-teaming and security assessment programs 
  • Apply AI to strengthen security work, such as detection, triage, vulnerability discovery, and design review 
  • Make or approve security risk decisions for high-impact initiatives that cross organisational boundaries 
  • Represent ServiceNow’s security posture to standards bodies, industry forums, and executive leadership 
  • Develop senior security engineers and shape the team’s technical agenda 

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you’ll need:

  • To succeed in this role, you'll need 

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or an exceptional record of impact 
  • Experience that meets one of the qualifying backgrounds below, including design reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessment at enterprise scale 
  • A sustained record of setting security direction across multiple teams or product lines, with standards, controls, or architecture that others adopted as their baseline 
  • Recognised depth in at least one core security discipline, such as application, cloud, identity, cryptography, or offensive security, with working breadth across the others 
  • Expert fluency with threat modelling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE, attack trees) and security frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10, to the point of extending, critiquing, or contributing to them 
  • A demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on new technology domains and reason about security where no established patterns exist 
  • A track record of developing principal- and staff-level security leaders, and of shaping decisions with senior executives and engineering leaders 
  • Clear, precise communication with executive audiences, and a record of influencing outcomes without direct authority 

Qualifying background (either path) 

  • Security-led: 13+ years in security, with at least 3 years in principal-level roles owning architecture, risk, or threat modeling across the organization 

  • Engineering-led: 13+ years of software engineering, including at least 3 years building or owning security-critical systems such as identity, authorization, data pipelines, distributed systems, or platform security, and a demonstrated move into security ownership at enterprise scale 

Bonus 

  • Depth in AI security, including threat modeling or securing LLM, GenAI, or agentic systems 
  • Experience with prompt injection and jailbreak defense, guardrail architecture, or AI red-teaming 
  • Hands-on familiarity with agentic frameworks and protocols such as LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, and A2A 
  • Experience designing identity and consent models for AI agents 
  • Built security tooling for AI systems used beyond one team 
  • CVEs, publications, or invited talks in security research, especially in AI or LLM security 
  • Prior experience setting AI security strategy at a company or platform level

Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and experienced lawyer specialized in Employment Law to join our Global Employment Law team to support the continued growth of ServiceNow across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). The role will report to the Senior Director, Global Employment Law.   

The Director, Global Employment Law, EMEA will be primarily responsible for providing legal counsel and partnership to the Global People Organization and other key internal stakeholders globally on employment law matters.  This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in ServiceNow’s expanding legal team and to work on challenging legal issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment.  

What you get to do in this role:  

  • Help us build a culture of high performance and great inclusion. Deliver business oriented, risk-based advice and counsel on the full range of employment law issues including: hiring, separations and dismissals, employee relations issues, restructurings, works councils and collective consultation, compensation and benefits, leaves of absence, global workforce innovation and culture, workplace investigations and employee relations, and employee privacy matters. Fully understanding the legal requirements is the starting point – treating people fairly and creating an amazing working environment is the end point  

  • Partner with our Global People Organization to create and revise global and locally compliant policies and procedures consistent with our values

Job Description

Role Overview

The Business Systems Product Manager is a senior individual contributor role within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG) responsible for owning and executing on a high-impact area of the Customer Success Platform (CSP). This role partners closely with Digital Technology (DT) counterparts to translate business priorities into precision-executed platform capabilities. The CSP is a major strategic bet for CEG, and this BPM is expected to operate at a level that reflects that.

CSP is the home for all 2,500+ CEG users and serves as the next-generation tooling that powers how CEG drives product adoption, NRR/GRR, and NPS for ServiceNow's customer base. Every workflow, automation, and AI capability shipped on CSP directly compounds the productivity and outcomes of the entire post-sales organization.

This is a deep product craft role for someone who thrives on personal ownership, end-to-end execution, and influence without authority. The right candidate is obsessed with AI, outcome measurement, and enabling the customer success organization to focus on high-value work by eliminating manual, repetitive tasks through intelligent automation. They set the technical and product bar within their domain and are looked to as a subject-matter expert by peers and senior leaders alike.

What You Will Do Product Ownership & Prioritization

  • Own a major workstream within the CSP product roadmap end-to-end, from problem definition through delivery and adoption.
  • Drive structured prioritization within your domain, balancing competing demands with a rigorous, data-informed lens and clearly articulated tradeoffs.
  • Translate complex business pain points into crisply scoped business requirements with measurable outcomes.
  • Author detailed BRDs that capture current-state processes and workflows, the future-state vision, and the transformation needed to get there, leaving no ambiguity for engineering or stakeholders.

Execution & Delivery

  • Drive elite-level execution on your roadmap, ensuring features are delivered with precision, on time, and to specification.
  • Partner with DT/CCX engineering counterparts on delivery cadence, surfacing blockers early and helping resolve them quickly.
  • Maintain rigorous program hygiene on your initiatives: clear scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, and status at all times.
  • Ensure every capability ships with a high-quality, intuitive user experience that CEG users adopt without friction.
  • Build the UAT strategy for your domain: recruit UAT testers across CEG personas, write detailed test cases, and lead UAT execution end-to-end.
  • Lead effective release communications to stakeholders, ensuring CEG users and leadership know what is shipping, when, and what it means for them.

AI Strategy & Integration

  • Embed AI-first thinking into every capability you ship, identifying opportunities to automate manual workflows and free CS teams to focus on strategic, high-value activities.
  • Develop a point of view on how emerging AI capabilities apply to your domain and advocate for AI investment in the roadmap.
  • Stay ahead of the AI landscape as it applies to customer success operations, internal tooling, and workflow automation, and bring that perspective into design discussions.
  • Prototype, evaluate, and partner with engineering on AI/agentic feature design.

Measurement & Outcomes

  • Define and track adoption, usage, and business impact metrics for every feature you deliver.
  • Operate with a default to data: decisions, tradeoffs, and post-launch reviews are grounded in measurable outcomes.
  • Use clear ROI frameworks to justify your roadmap investments and demonstrate platform value to senior stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Communicate roadmap, status, and outcomes for your domain clearly and confidently to senior executives, including VP and SVP-level audiences.
  • Proactively surface risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation plans before they become escalations.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships across CEG business stakeholders, DT, and cross-functional partners.
  • Navigate complex organizational dynamics with strategic judgment and composure, leading through influence rather than authority.

Product Craft Leadership

  • Set the bar for product craft within the CSP team: discovery quality, written artifacts, decision frameworks, and execution discipline.
  • Identify systemic gaps in process, tooling, or architecture across the CSP and drive cross-team improvements.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years in Product Management, business systems, or enterprise technology, with demonstrated growth in scope and impact across roles.
  • Proven track record owning and shipping product roadmaps for internal or customer-facing platforms in complex enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional execution in close partnership with engineering or DT teams.
  • Track record of delivering results in high-pressure, high-stakes environments with competing priorities.
  • Experience presenting strategy and program status to VP and C-level stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Genuine passion for AI and experience applying or advocating for AI/automation in product strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence without direct reports.

Preferred

  • Experience in a post-sales, customer success, or CS operations environment.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow's platform capabilities, particularly as applied to internal tooling or CS workflows.
  • Experience with customer success platforms, CRM, or internal enablement tools.
  • Background in experience design or a strong aesthetic sensibility for product UI/UX.
  • Hands-on experience prototyping, building, or shipping AI/agentic features.

descriptionHtml:

As the AVP, APAC CRM Solution Consulting, you own the pre-sales technical engine behind one of ServiceNow's fastest-growing bets: CRM. You will lead a team of first-line Solution Consulting managers and their Solution Consultants across Asia Pacific (APAC), directly accountable for the Net New Annual Contract Value (NNACV) that CRM delivers. This team is approx. 17 ICs and 3 first-line managers. This is an execution role at heart. Your mandate is to convert ServiceNow's next-generation, AI-native CRM vision into consistent, repeatable pre-sales motions that win—at speed and at scale. 

You will re-establish a tight connection between the field and CRM product, build the next generation of pre-sales talent around the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) model, and lead the shift from a demo-centric to a proof-of-value (POV) centric go-to-market motion. Above all, you will drive speed, simplification, and clarity—scaling the organization through AI automation and operating as a single, unified engine of execution alongside your CRM selling peers. 

Job Description

What you'll do… 

Own the number – drive CRM NNACV growth 

  • Carry direct accountability for APAC CRM NNACV targets and mobilize the Solution Consulting team to achieve and exceed double-digit ACV growth. 

  • Translate the number into clear team-level and individual pre-sales motions; forecast technical win rates and remove the blockers that slow deals. 

  • Partner with CRM sales leadership to prioritize the opportunities, use cases, and industries where CRM wins fastest across the region. 

Build the next-generation pre-sales organization (FDE model) 

  • Lead and grow the next generation of pre-sales talent, evolving the Solution Consultant role toward the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) model—technical leaders who build alongside customers rather than present to them.

  • Work with CRM selling peers—sales, product, value, and partner leaders—as one integrated engine of execution, not adjacent functions.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a Senior Staff Engineer in HRSD, you set the technical direction for model-driven capability across the HR domain, the agentic and conversational experiences that interpret employee, manager, and HR agent intent, reason over profile, case, catalog, policy, and knowledge context, and act on the user's behalf. Your unit of ownership is the architecture, standards, and evaluation infrastructure that let multiple teams ship those experiences safely — not a single feature set. 

This is not an ML research role; you do not train foundation models. It is also distinct from traditional full-stack staff work, where systems follow deterministic logic. Two things shape the job: much of the load-bearing logic lives in natural language — instructions, prompts, context, tool descriptions, guardrails — and must be engineered with the same discipline as code; and because behavior is probabilistic, correctness is established through evaluation at scale, not fixed assertions. 

What You'll Own 

AI architecture for the domain. How agents are decomposed and composed, where reasoning happens, how context is assembled and bounded, how tools are exposed, and how autonomy is delegated. Own the multi-release calls: model selection and migration, orchestration approach, build-versus-adopt, and the cost/latency/quality tradeoffs behind each. 

The autonomy boundary. Decide as domain policy which HR actions an agent may take, which require a human decision point, and which no agent should attempt. Anything changing pay, employment status, restricted records, or employee-relations matters requires a human in the path by construction — build the mechanisms that make those constraints structural. 

The shared instruction and tool description surface. HRSD ships as product; customers configure, extend, and override this surface on their own instances. Treat it as a versioned contract with upgrade-safe extension points, deprecation paths, and compatibility guarantees. 

Evaluation as infrastructure. Own the golden datasets, multi-turn suites, judge calibration, CI gates, and drift detection that let teams change behavior safely. Extend coverage to HR-specific failure classes: access-boundary violations, cross-scope leakage, jurisdictional and policy-variant correctness. 

Production quality and safety. Observability for containment, hallucination rate, tool-selection error, unsafe action, and injection vectors from user-supplied content entering agent context. Because HR conversation content is itself restricted, design diagnosis that works without exposing what was said. 

AI-assisted engineering standards. Convert ambiguous problems into testable specs; define what accountable agent-assisted delivery looks like for the domain — specification standards, review expectations, verification harnesses — and hold the line on it. 

Hands-on where it matters. The hard integration, the risky migration, the prototype that settles an architectural argument, the incident nobody else can unblock. 

Partner across functions. Collaborate efficiently with product, engineering, design to co-create scalable AI solutions and translate business needs into robust technical designs. 

Qualifications

What You Bring:

7+ years of software engineering, with a record of technical direction adopted beyond your immediate team. 

Direct, hands-on experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation that verifies them. 

Production experience with LLM APIs, retrieval-grounded features, agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement — including at least one model or orchestration migration carried through production. 

Entitlement-aware data handling: per-user access enforcement in retrieval and tool layers, scope separation between roles, and handling of restricted records under audit. 

Evaluation experience used by engineers other than yourself: dataset curation, judge calibration, CI gating, drift detection. 

Strong command of system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing across front-end, server-side, and relational data work with a high quality mindset. 

Effective, accountable use of AI coding assistants and agents. 

On-call and incident-command experience on customer-facing systems, including ownership of the systemic fixes that followed. 

Experience in software stack including Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React and demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools and frameworks. 

Bachelor's degree in CS, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred 

HR domain depth: case management, employee journey and lifecycle, or payroll/benefits/leave/absence sufficient to set requirements. 

Integration with core HR, payroll, or benefits systems of record, including reconciliation and eventual-consistency patterns. 

Contribution in a Forward deployment model to champion customer adoption.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tout a commencé sous le soleil de San Diego, en Californie, en 2004, lorsqu’un ingénieur visionnaire, Fred Luddy, a vu le potentiel de transformer notre façon de travailler. Aujourd’hui, ServiceNow se présente comme un leader mondial du marché, apportant une technologie innovante améliorée par l’IA à plus de 8 100 clients, dont 85% des entreprises du Fortune 500®. Notre plateforme intelligente basée sur le nuage connecte de manière transparente les personnes, les systèmes et les processus pour permettre aux organisations de trouver des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, plus rapides et meilleures. Mais ce n’est que le début de notre voyage. Joignez-vous à nous dans la poursuite de notre objectif de rendre le monde meilleur pour tous.

######

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow recherche un Directeur de Compte CRM senior. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le succès sur le marché et l’expansion des produits CRM et IA de nouvelle génération de ServiceNow, en les positionnant comme la colonne vertébrale essentielle de la transformation numérique à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

Nos produits CRM ne sont pas de simples outils autonomes : ils reposent sur notre plateforme de gestion des services, reconnue comme leader du marché, et créent une source unique et intelligente de vérité. Cette approche unifiée permet à des processus critiques et à grande échelle, allant de l’intégration client, des plaintes, de la gestion des fraudes et des litiges, jusqu’aux successions, aux exceptions commerciales, à la gestion des courtiers et des négociants en valeurs mobilières, etc., de s’appuyer sur une information uniforme, une IA prédictive et une efficacité opérationnelle inégalée.

Ce que vous piloterez : CRM et IA au service du succès stratégique

Votre mission consistera à transformer la complexité sectorielle en valeur d’affaires mesurable :

  • Stratégie et exécution à l’échelle de l’entreprise :
  • Gestion de comptes : Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de territoire axée sur des cas d’usage à forte valeur. Apporter une contribution pointue, propre à chaque secteur, lors de la planification des comptes, en veillant à ce que les comptes cibles et les cas d’usage soient alignés sur le potentiel de retour sur investissement élevé de nos solutions CRM propulsées par l’IA.

  • Cibler et valider les occasions CRM et IA : Prospecter et développer le pipeline dans les comptes CRM et faire croître les partenariats CRM existants grâce à une vente consultative, incluant notamment des séances d’information pour dirigeants (EBC), des ateliers de découverte et des projets pilotes de cas d’usage.

  • Défendre la valeur transformationnelle : collaborer avec les équipes de comptes, les partenaires d’implantation de solutions et les revendeurs pour conclure de nouvelles ventes, afin d’aider les dirigeants d’entreprise à améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle et l’expérience client.
  • Soutien aux ventes et formation des équipes :

########

ServiceNow is looking for a seasoned CRM Account Executive to capitalize on your deep industry knowledge and proven sales record within East Canada. You will be instrumental in overseeing the market success and expansion of ServiceNow's next-generation CRM and AI products, positioning them as the essential backbone for enterprise-wide digital transformation. 

Our CRM products are not just stand-alone tools; they are built upon our market-leading Service Management platform, creating a single, intelligent source of truth. This unified approach allows mission-critical, enterprise-scale processes—from customer onboarding, complaints, fraud and disputes management to decedent, trade exceptions, broker/dealer servicing, etc —to execute uniform information, predictive AI, and unmatched operational efficiency. 

What You Will Drive: CRM & AI for Strategic Success 

Your focus will be on converting industry complexity into measurable business value: 

  • Enterprise Strategy & Execution: 
  • Account Management: Develop and execute a territory strategy focused on high-value use cases. Provide critical, industry-specific input during account planning, ensuring target accounts and use cases are aligned with the high-ROI potential of our AI-driven CRM solutions 
  • Target & Validate AI/CRM Opportunities: Prospect and grow pipeline in CRM greenfield accounts and grow existing CRM partnerships through consultative selling, including, but not limited to Executive Briefings (EBCs), Discovery Workshops and Use Case Pilots. 
  • Champion Transformational Value: Partner with account teams and Solutions Implementation partners and resellers to close net new sales opportunities to help Enterprise leaders drive operational efficiency and a superior customer experience. 
  • Sales & Team Enablement

    Qualifications

    Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous possédez :

    • Une résidence actuelle dans le Grand Montréal ou à Québec, au Canada
    • Une maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais et du français
    • Plus de 7 ans d’expérience dans la vente de logiciels d’entreprise au sein d’une équipe de comptes importante et matricielle
    • Plus de 7 ans d’expérience à démontrer et articuler la valeur d’affaires et le retour sur investissement des solutions CRM pour remporter des transactions complexes

    • Une expérience de l’intégration de l’IA dans les processus de travail, la prise de décision ou la résolution de problèmes, ou une réflexion approfondie sur la manière de le faire. Cela peut inclure l’utilisation d’outils propulsés par l’IA, l’automatisation de flux de travail, l’analyse de données issues de l’IA, ou l’exploration de l’impact potentiel de l’IA sur la fonction ou sur le secteur

    • Possibilité de déplacement 30-50% du temps

    Qualifications

    To be successful in this role you have:

    • Currently based in Greater Montréal or Québec City, Canada
    • Professional fluency in English and French
    • 7+ years of experience selling enterprise software within a large, matrixed account team environment
    • 7+ years of experience building and articulating the business value and ROI of CRM solutions to win complex deals
    • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.

descriptionHtml:

Armis from ServiceNow, protects the entire attack surface and manages an organization’s cyber risk exposure in real time. Combined with ServiceNow’s Security and Risk capabilities, as well as Identity Security capabilities from Veza, we bring together all critical capabilities to secure every asset, every identity - incl. AI Agents - across all environments with the right level of context - security, operational and business - to build the first of its kind autonomous defense platform for the Agentic Enterprise.

Job Description

About the Opportunity 

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Advisory Solutions Consultant to join our Identity Security Center of Excellence at ServiceNow. 

As enterprises navigate increasingly complex security environments, fragmented identity ecosystems, and the rapid adoption of AI, identity has become the control point for enterprise security, and the need for intelligent, unified identity security solutions has never been greater. 

This is an opportunity to help shape how some of the world's largest organizations approach identity security, access governance, cyber risk, and AI-driven security transformation. 

We're seeking a technically accomplished, strategically minded professional who thrives at the intersection of cybersecurity, identity, enterprise architecture, and consultative solution selling. 

What You'll Do 

Serve as a Trusted Technical Advisor 

  • Partner with enterprise customers, CISOs, security architects, and identity leaders to understand their security challenges, business priorities, and transformation initiatives. 
  • Translate complex security requirements into compelling solution strategies and measurable business outcomes. 
  • Lead technical discovery, architectural discussions, executive workshops, and strategic solution engagements. 

Drive Security & Identity Solution Excellence 

  • Provide deep technical expertise across Identity Security, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Identity and Access Management (IAM), and security operations. 
  • Help customers understand and realize the value of ServiceNow's expanding security portfolio, including Veza and Armis. 
  • Architect solutions that address identity visibility, access intelligence, least-privilege enforcement, cyber exposure, and security risk reduction. 
  • Demonstrate how integrated security capabilities can help organizations eliminate silos and improve their overall security posture. 

Shape the Future of AI & Identity Security 

  • Advise customers on emerging identity and security challenges associated with AI agents, non-human identities, and autonomous systems. 
  • Explore approaches to AI agent discovery, identity lifecycle management, permissions, governance, and access control. 
  • Help organizations establish security and governance frameworks as they scale AI adoption. 

Influence Strategic Enterprise Opportunities 

  • Collaborate closely with account teams, solution consulting leadership, product management, and engineering to advance complex enterprise opportunities. 
  • Lead compelling technical presentations, solution demonstrations, architecture workshops, and proof-of-value engagements. 
  • Articulate differentiated technical value and competitive positioning in sophisticated enterprise environments. 
  • Act as a technical escalation point and subject matter expert for strategic customer engagements. 

Elevate the Center of Excellence 

  • Contribute to reusable solution architectures, technical enablement, demonstrations, and field best practices. 
  • Mentor and enable field Solutions Consultants on security and identity technologies. 
  • Bring customer and market insights back to product and engineering teams to influence innovation and solution strategy. 

Qualifications

What You'll Bring 

Technical Expertise 

  • Deep experience in identity security, including IAM, IGA, and privileged access, with identity as your primary focus within enterprise cybersecurity. 
  • Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, access governance, entitlement management, and least-privilege principles. 
  • Subject matter expertise in identity security architectures for large, complex enterprises, with the fluency to speak credibly about identity platforms, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and modern security architectures to identity teams, enterprise architects, and business leaders alike. 
  • Understanding of emerging security challenges involving AI agents, machine identities, and non-human access. 
  • Ability to connect complex technical capabilities to meaningful security and business outcomes. 

Consultative & Strategic Skills 

  • Proven track record selling identity security solutions to large enterprises in a presales, solution consulting, security architecture, or technical advisory role, including shaping and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals. 
  • Confidence presenting to and advising a range of enterprise audiences, from security and IT leaders, including CISOs and CIOs, to identity teams and enterprise architecture groups, with the ability to frame identity security in terms of business risk and outcomes. 
  • Ability to lead complex technical conversations, challenge conventional thinking, and influence architectural decisions. 
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, and solution demonstration skills. 
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to operate effectively across sales, engineering, product, and customer teams. 

What Will Set You Apart 

  • Experience selling, implementing, or competing against technologies such as Veza, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Okta, Microsoft Entra, or comparable security and identity platforms. 
  • Understanding of identity security posture management, identity threat detection, cyber asset visibility, and exposure management. 
  • Strong familiarity with cloud-native environments, Zero Trust architectures, and modern enterprise security frameworks. 
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, scripting, or solution prototyping. 
  • A strong point of view on how AI will reshape identity security and enterprise cybersecurity. 
  • The curiosity to explore emerging technologies and the ability to turn innovative ideas into practical customer solutions. 

Why Join Us? 

You'll be part of the Identity Center of Excellence, a specialized team operating at the forefront of some of the most important transformations in enterprise technology. 

This role offers the opportunity to influence strategic customer engagements, collaborate with talented technical leaders, work with an expanding portfolio of security technologies, and help define how enterprises secure identities, assets, and AI-driven environments. 

We're looking for more than a technical expert. We're looking for a strategic thinker, trusted advisor, and passionate technologist who can earn the confidence of security and IT leaders, identity teams, and enterprise architects, and help shape the future of enterprise identity security. 

Interested in helping us build what's next? We'd love to hear from you.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

The Experienced Customer Success Manager (CSM) is the senior practitioner level in the CSM job family. You will own consumption and adoption outcomes across a smaller portfolio of higher-ACV, more complex customers, operating with expert autonomy across the competencies and engaging credibly at senior Director and VP level when the situation demands. 

You set the play under ambiguity. You recognize when to escalate and when to decide. You utilize the full internal agent stack with expert fluency, lead more tailored Customer Impact Plan engagements with your accounts, and translate commercial context into ServiceNow roadmap recommendations without supervision. 

Beyond your portfolio, you shape how the CSM practice runs locally. You contribute to playbook development. You mentor IC1 and IC2 CSMs. You translate patterns from your accounts into actionable feedback that improves the agent stack and the team’s ways of working. 

This role is illustratively aligned to a smaller portfolio of higher-complexity customers with larger annual contract value — final portfolio sizing and ACV thresholds are subject to final design.

Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the team:  

The Connected Customer Experience (CCx) team in Digital Technology designs and delivers digital experiences that help customers and partners adopt, learn, and succeed with ServiceNow. CCx spans support, learning, and success experiences, built on the ServiceNow AI Platform.   

About the role:  

As Product Strategy Senior Manager, you will serve as a senior individual contributor who shapes the product strategy for CCx digital customer experiences across support, learning, and success. You will translate customer insight, market trends, product data, and leadership priorities into a clear strategic direction, compelling strategy documents, and aligned roadmaps. 

In this role, you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on product strategy—developing strategy documents and executive presentations, shaping roadmaps and business cases, and ensuring timely follow-through. You will engage directly with customers and senior leaders, exercise strong judgment in sensitive and ambiguous situations, and influence product and business decisions through evidence-based insights. Success requires exceptional written and verbal communication, analytical rigor, operational discipline, executive presence, and the ability to deliver measurable outcomes in a fast-moving, matrixed environment. 

What you get to do in this role: 

This role connects strategy, customer perspective, product direction, and execution at scale. You will partner across product, engineering, design, customer operations, and communications to turn complex inputs into aligned plans, decision-ready insights, and effective customer and executive engagements. 

  • Digital CX product strategy—define and evolve the multi-year product strategy for CCx digital experiences across support, learning, and success, including self-service, AI-powered and autonomous support, and personalized customer journeys. Integrate customer feedback, engagement signals, product inputs, and leadership perspectives into CCx Product Strategy and recurring intelligence and decision-ready insights; identify evidence gaps, recurring themes, product implications, and decisions required. 

  • Customer engagement and executive experiences—shape the strategy and content for customer forums and executive briefings that inform and validate product direction; facilitate discussions and present directly to customers when appropriate. 

  • Market and customer insight—run competitive and market analysis, size opportunities, and use customer research and usage data to identify where to invest and where to stop. 

  • Strategy development and storytelling—independently author strategy documents, executive PowerPoint presentations, roadmaps, and business cases that articulate vision, priorities, tradeoffs, and investment needs, from problem framing through executive review. 

  • Decision support and influence—apply sound judgment and analytical rigor to recommend priorities, shape product and business decisions, surface tradeoffs, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders without direct authority. 

  • Outcomes and measurement—define success metrics for the digital CX strategy, such as customer effort, self-service and case deflection rates, adoption, and customer satisfaction, and connect initiatives to company goals. 

  • AI-enabled ways of working—embed AI into research, synthesis, planning, content development, program execution, and measurement while applying appropriate judgment and quality controls. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has: 

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in product strategy or product management, preferably at a SaaS or enterprise technology company; experience in management consulting, customer experience strategy, or strategic program management is a plus. 

  • Deep understanding of digital customer experience, including self-service, support and success platforms, customer journey design, and AI-driven customer engagement. 

  • Proven track record of authoring strategy documents and executive PowerPoint presentations that drove investment or roadmap decisions; work samples or portfolio required. 

  • Experience applying strategy frameworks, competitive analysis, business case development, and prioritization methods to shape product direction. 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead multiple complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution, including governance, planning, dependencies, risks, stakeholder accountability, and outcome measurement. 

  • Experience engaging directly with customers and senior executives, facilitating high-stakes discussions, and converting customer perspectives into actionable product and business insights. 

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with a strong record of developing strategic narratives, executive-level presentations, briefings, and decision materials. 

  • Strong executive judgment and presence, including the ability to anticipate questions, calibrate content for different audiences, prepare leaders and speakers, and navigate sensitive or ambiguous situations. 

  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs, recognize patterns and evidence gaps, frame product implications, and recommend clear priorities and decisions.

Job Description

About the Role: 

As a Customer Reference Program Specialist on the Customer Marketing team, you will run the day-to-day operations of our customer reference program. You will match customers with prospects, coordinate reference calls and events, and keep our reference pool current and healthy. You will work closely with your Customer Marketing colleagues and partner with sales, product marketing, product management, and field marketing to turn customer success into proof that supports campaigns, content, and deals, so sellers have the right customer proof at the right time. 

What You'll Do: 

Reference matching and call coordination 

  • Match reference requests from sales teams to the best-fit customers based on industry, product, use case, and region. 
  • Leverage usage dashboards, Power BI, and other reporting tools  to verify customer adoption and usage before matching each reference request. 
  • Manage the full logistics of one-on-one and group reference calls: outreach, scheduling, briefing materials, and follow-up. 
  • Prepare reference meeting assets, such as customer proof points, talking points, and call briefs. 
  • Collect feedback from sellers and customers after calls and flag trends to the team. 
  • Coordinate customer reference meetings for company events, including customer host preparation, session descriptions, meeting materials, attendee communications, and on-site logistics. 
  • Manage registration and approval workflows, applying participation criteria and coordinating with sales to confirm eligible attendees. 
  • Partner with customer hosts to shape focused, relevant discussions that address prospect needs and highlight measurable customer outcomes. 

Reference pool management 

  • Identify and recruit new reference customers in partnership with sales, customer success, marketing (product, outbound, etc.), and product management.  
  • Keep reference records accurate in our tracking systems, including approvals, topics, availability, and participation history. 
  • Monitor participation levels to prevent customer fatigue and distribute requests fairly. 
  • Proactively source advocates to address priority deal needs, upcoming sessions, and gaps in product, industry, use case, and regional coverage. 

Cross-functional support 

  • Work with your Customer Marketing colleagues, field marketing, and sales enablement to bring references into events, campaigns, and deal support. 
  • Make sure approved reference assets are easy for sales teams to find and use. 
  • Participate in cross-functional project teams and contribute to program planning. 
  • Guide sales teams through reference request and participation processes, clearly communicating requirements, deadlines, and next steps. 

Reporting and improvement 

  • Track reference usage and report on program activity and its impact on pipeline and deals. 
  • Maintain dashboards and validate attendee, account, and opportunity data to support accurate reporting on participation and influenced pipeline. 
  • Recommend improvements to processes, coverage gaps, and reporting based on what the data shows. 

Qualifications

What You'll Bring: 

  • 5+ years of related experience in marketing, customer advocacy, customer marketing, or a similar customer-facing program role 
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 
  • Hands-on experience with customer reference or advocacy programs, or comparable program coordination work 
  • Strong project management skills: you can juggle many concurrent requests and drive each one to completion 
  • Clear, concise, professional written and verbal communication, including with customers and senior stakeholders 
  • Sound judgment in applying established processes, and the resourcefulness to find answers or support when something is missing 
  • Comfort working with data and tracking systems (CRM, spreadsheets, reference platforms) to report on program performance 
  • Familiarity with SaaS or enterprise technology is a plus 

How You'll Work: 

  • Collaborate within Customer Marketing and across sales, product marketing, and field marketing, balancing internal needs with customer expectations 
  • Take on challenges promptly and follow through 
  • Learn new tools, products, and customer stories quickly, and apply them to the program 
  • Work with direction from your manager on new or complex projects, and independently on routine work 
  • Anticipate gaps and risks, propose practical solutions, and escalate issues early to keep customer commitments and program timelines on track.

Job Description

The role 

This senior principal solution architect is a functional and technical expert who consults with customers on implementing ServiceNow’s Security and Risk solutions in line with leading practices, accelerating customer business outcomes and helping build the practice. The role is laser-focused on the most relevant customer challenges. It supports sales cycles, engages directly with customers and partners, and advocates for customer needs within ServiceNow (Product Management, Customer & Partner Excellence, Training & Certification). 

The solution architect brings architectural guidance, industry business acumen, deep product expertise, innovation, and knowledge capital to customers and partners. 

Responsibilities 

  • Lead pre-sales activities: sales presentations, solutioning and scoping workshops, SOW development with clear deliverables and effort estimates, scope definition and change order triggers, and engagement sizing with Services Account Executives and Sales team members. 
  • Serve as a lead member of the engagement team, focused on connecting Security and Risk workflow applications to the customer’s technology landscape while advising on governance leading practices. 
  • Engage senior leadership, including CXOs, on implementation roadmap and change management. 
  • Partner with the Platform Architect team to surface proactive platform risks in customer landscapes. 
  • Act as practice director on marquee accounts for Security and Risk, leading delivery teams, providing oversight and technical expertise, and owning adherence to delivery standards. 
  • Design and deliver Security and Risk solutions with a technical architecture built for long-term success, following ServiceNow technical standards and leading practices. 
  • Design solutions for common customer use cases and publish them (to Solution Consultants, Customer Community, and others) for broader consumption. 
  • Build mutually beneficial relationships with Security and Risk product owners and stakeholders to promote awareness of capabilities and roadmaps. 
  • Lead office hours, presentations, webinars, and learning events for field delivery stakeholders (advisory, delivery, GTM) showcasing customer use cases and successes. 
  • Drive continuous improvement of delivery and engagement materials with the Customer & Partner Excellence team. 
  • Enable and mentor the ServiceNow delivery team and partner ecosystem. 
  • Create documentation and service offerings that promote our services. 
  • Flex across other areas of Risk and Security to maintain utilization KPIs. 
  • Travel up to 20% annually, driven by customer needs and internal meetings. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has: 

  • 12+ years in a professional services organization, or equivalent education and experience. 
  • 8+ years of consulting and/or configuration experience implementing complex technologies, including integrations and portals. 
  • 5+ years implementing ServiceNow Security and Risk solutions. 
  • Strong experience with TPRM, USEM, VR, SIR, IRM (RC, TPRM, BCM), OpsRes, and AI Control Tower. 
  • Strong understanding of the risk and security regulatory landscape and standards such as FFIEC, DORA, OpsRes, SEC, OCC, and SOX. 
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF and other industry-specific frameworks. 
  • Experience with cross-functional domains such as asset management, service management, CMDB, and Risk and Security, including ITOM modules (Event Management, Discovery, CMDB, Service Graph Connectors). 
  • Strong understanding of Now Assist, RaptorDB, and Vault ZTA. 
  • Experience with cross-functional solutions and architectural foundations in large, heavily regulated enterprises such as FSI and HCLS. 
  • Experience applying AI to work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving: AI-powered tools, workflow automation, AI-driven insights, or the impact of AI on the function or industry. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and consult senior leaders in a matrixed organization (identifying needs, presenting options with pros, cons, and risks) and to provide thought leadership to sponsors and stakeholders. 
  • Customer-centric mindset, willing to go the extra mile and break down barriers to customer success. 
  • Ability to work with technical and non-technical customers, gather requirements, analyze information, and design comprehensive solutions. 
  • Ability to produce visually rich conceptual design documents for audiences of varying business and technical aptitude. 
  • Experience running solution presentations and securing customer acceptance of solution designs. 
  • Strength in building trust and engaging remote or in-person audiences. 
  • Aptitude for communicating complex concepts through visualization and modeling, including wireframes, workflows, and diagrams. 
  • Creativity and comfort running projects independently, with success driving complex issues to resolution. 
  • Collaborative working style. 
  • Breadth across leading technology software platforms. 
  • A passion for learning new technologies and working on projects that push the platform’s capabilities. 

Certifications 

  • Required on Day1: CIS-RC, CIS-VR, CSA 
  • Required by Day90: CIS-TPRM, CIS-SIR, and Certified Application Developer (CAD). 
  • Certified Technical Architect (CTA): Preferred on Day1 or must be achieved within the first 365 days. 
  • Working proficiency within 90 days in CMDB Fundamentals

We are the platform engineers handling app lifecycle at ServiceNow. We develop and maintain the server-side JavaScript engine at the heart of the ServiceNow platform — the runtime that powers custom applications, workflows, and business logic. We ensure apps move smoothly and securely from development to production. This role requires deep expertise in compiler and runtime systems — you'll optimize execution engines, memory management, and performance at the systems level. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Design and optimize execution engines, JIT/AOT compilation pipelines, and memory management systems to ensure customer applications run at scale 

  • Build high-quality, clean, scalable, and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering architecture and processes (Code Reviews, Unit testing, etc.) 

  • Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, test automation, and delivery of high-quality product to our users 

  • Implement software that is simple to use, allowing customers to extend and customize functionality to meet their specific needs 

  • Mentor colleagues and promote knowledge-sharing across teams on low-level systems engineering, performance profiling, and optimization techniques 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 12+ years of experience with Java or similar object-oriented language, with at least 5+ years working on compiler, runtime, JIT/AOT systems, or language execution engines 

  • Experience integrating AI into software development, workflows, decision-making, or automation using AI-powered tools and technologies.  

  • Strong experience with compiler/runtime systems: execution engines, memory management, concurrency, JIT/AOT compilation, performance optimization, profiling, and debugging 

  • Advanced knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations at the systems level 

  • Passion for JavaScript and the Web as a platform; experience with modern UI frameworks (Angular, React, or Vue) 

  • Experience developing, troubleshooting, and optimizing relational databases 

  • Experience with LLVM, language runtime development, or low-level systems engineering (strong plus) 

  • Track record working across multiple technology stacks (Cloud Dev, Platforms, Web Dev, Frameworks, service-oriented architecture)

Job Description

ServiceNow's legal team runs on ServiceNow. NDAs, procurement contracts, conflict checks, and requests for legal advice all move through our own platform.  

You'll own a portfolio of AI and platform initiatives for our legal technology team within the Global Business Services Experience team. The goal: give attorneys and legal professionals their time back. Fewer routine requests land on their desks. The ones that do get answered faster. And legal data is structured so AI agents can do useful work with it. 

You won't hand requirements to engineering and move on. You'll prototype with AI, prove what works, and partner with our Product organization to turn the best of what we build into features our customers use. This is where we put AI to work for people, starting with our own. 

What you get to do in this role: 

Own the roadmap 

  • Own a multi-quarter roadmap for legal AI and platform initiatives across Contract Management Pro, Legal Service Delivery, and connected systems 
  • Plan each quarter in epics, then deliver through iterative development, testing, and production release 
  • Write epics, user stories, technical spikes, acceptance criteria, and solution approach documents that engineers can build from 
  • Prioritize a busy backlog with clear tradeoffs, and say no when it matters 
  • Lead discovery with legal and business teams, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and translate them into prioritized product requirements and measurable outcomes 

Build AI agents legal teams trust 

  • Design and deliver AI agents for legal work, such as advice and counsel recommendations, contract redlining against our standard terms, request intake and triage, and contract review 
  • Decide how agents retrieve knowledge, when people review their output, and how feedback improves them over time 
  • Use out-of-the-box and Now Assist capabilities first, and build custom only when the platform can't do the job 
  • Build quick prototypes to test AI performance and get stakeholder agreement before committing to a full build 
  • Make sure anything headed to production gets engineering review and hardening 
  • Prove it works 
  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets, and pass thresholds before any AI feature reaches production 
  • Run model and vendor evaluations without locking into a single model or provider 
  • Build and own value models (hours saved, request volume, cycle time) and report AI impact to senior leadership monthly and quarterly 
  • Establish baselines and measure adoption, cycle time, quality, and realized productivity improvements after launch 

Partner across ServiceNow 

  • Partner with our Product organization to co-develop and validate enhancements for potential inclusion in customer-facing platform releases 
  • Bring feedback from our own legal team into product roadmaps 
  • Align Legal, Procurement, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Digital Technology stakeholders on shared priorities 
  • Work alongside business process managers and engineers in a shared delivery model 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in technical product management, including ownership of a multi-quarter roadmap 
  • Experience with enterprise workflow platforms 
  • Experience shipping generative or agentic AI features, including LLM behavior, retrieval, and prompt design 
  • Experience defining evaluation methods for AI applications, including output quality, groundedness, task completion, and appropriate human review 
  • Experience on agile teams writing epics and user stories that engineers build from 
  • Clear executive communication: you can sum up portfolio status, value, and risk in a few slides 
  • Strong stakeholder management across legal, business, and technical teams

Job Description

About the team

The Conversational AI team at ServiceNow builds the core platform behind ServiceNow Otto, our conversational AI experience. We are a group of applied scientists and software engineers working at the intersection of research and production. Our work spans the full stack that makes Otto capable: agent orchestration, including harness engineering, prompt tuning, agent skills, policy design, and quality evaluation across languages; the A2A and MCP protocols that let agents collaborate and connect to tools; background channels and conversational triggers that bring agents into action; AI-native licensing and pricing; and the central caching layer that connects the ServiceNow platform to the services powering Otto.

We are seeking a Staff AI-Native DevOps Engineer to lead a new DevOps practice within the Conversational AI team. You will own the build, deployment, and reliability of the systems behind ServiceNow Otto, our conversational AI platform, from commit through production across our SaaS environments. Your work will span CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure on Kubernetes, observability, and the operational tooling that lets agent orchestration, MCP and A2A services, and the central caching layer ship safely and frequently. You will partner closely with applied scientists and software engineers to make AI-native delivery repeatable, measurable, and secure. This role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure as code with a practical understanding of how ML and LLM-based services behave in production, and a bias toward pragmatic engineering with measurable impact on deployment velocity and service reliability.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native applications and infrastructure.
  • Strong software engineering skills, with experience developing infrastructure tooling and automation using Go, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience leading complex infrastructure initiatives, establishing engineering best practices, and driving adoption across multiple teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed systems issues and drive improvements in performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and agentic architectures, with the ability to apply these concepts to engineering and operational challenges.
  • An AI-native engineering mindset, proactively leveraging AI tools and automation to accelerate development, improve operational efficiency, and deliver more intelligent, resilient systems.

DevOps:

  • Deploy, scale, and operate distributed microservices in production Kubernetes environments, including managing application lifecycle, networking, security, and service reliability.
  • Design and implement infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Kubernetes-native tooling, including Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and Kubernetes Operators.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tekton, and ArgoCD to automate testing, deployment, and release management.
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and incident response practices, performing root cause analysis and driving remediation to improve availability, fault tolerance, and operational resilience.
  • Architect and optimize cloud infrastructure across public and private cloud environments, with an emphasis on security, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational simplicity.

AI skills:

Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at your level — it applies to how you build and to what you build. 

  • Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other — catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. 
  • AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt.
  • Understanding of LLM-powered application architectures, including model inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and agentic workflows, with an awareness of their infrastructure, scalability, and reliability implications.
  • Ability to deploy, operate, and troubleshoot AI-powered services in production, including managing model API integrations, observability, latency, resource utilization, and operational costs.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or related experience.
  • 6+ years of experience deploying and operating containerized applications and distributed services in production environments. 
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and infrastructure automation.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Go, Python, or Bash, with experience building production-grade automation and tooling.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools in software engineering workflows, with demonstrated ability to validate, debug, and safely integrate AI-generated code.
  • Working knowledge of LLMs, Generative AI, and agentic AI concepts, including their integration patterns and operational considerations.

Preferred requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating Kubernetes-based SaaS platforms at scale, including multi-service deployments and complex production environments.
  • Experience developing Kubernetes Operators, custom controllers, or other Kubernetes-native automation to manage application lifecycle and infrastructure operations.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in driving cross-team infrastructure initiatives, improving production reliability, and establishing scalable platform engineering practices.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, integrating, or operating LLM-powered applications or agentic systems in production environments. Experience building AI-enabled infrastructure automation, observability, incident diagnosis, or remediation workflows to improve platform reliability and engineering productivity.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $181,200 - $317,100 plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. title: Associate Customer Success Manager - French
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tout a commencé sous le soleil de San Diego, en Californie, en 2004, lorsqu’un ingénieur visionnaire, Fred Luddy, a vu le potentiel de transformer notre façon de travailler. Aujourd’hui, ServiceNow se présente comme un leader mondial du marché, apportant une technologie innovante améliorée par l’IA à plus de 8 100 clients, dont 85% des entreprises du Fortune 500®. Notre plateforme intelligente basée sur le nuage connecte de manière transparente les personnes, les systèmes et les processus pour permettre aux organisations de trouver des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, plus rapides et meilleures. Mais ce n’est que le début de notre voyage. Joignez-vous à nous dans la poursuite de notre objectif de rendre le monde meilleur pour tous.

######

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Please note that this role requires a minimum of 2 days in-office.

What you get to do in this role: 

The Associate Customer Success Manager will own consumption and adoption outcomes across a portfolio of mid-complexity customers, operating with judgment and autonomy within your portfolio while drawing on senior CSMs for strategic or commercial ambiguity. You will utilize the internal AI agents that augment the role today and be ready to drive adoption of new agents as they are released. 

You will operate as a confident advisor — overriding agent-recommended plays where customer context demands, leading Customer Business Reviews at Director and Manager level, and translating platform outcomes into commercial impact for the business stakeholders you engage. 

You will also contribute to the practice: patterns from your accounts feed playbook development, your structured feedback improves the agent stack, and you mentor peers informally on advisory craft and AI fluency. 

You operate as a credible voice on how we work with AI — with your customers. You can explain to a Director what AI is doing on their behalf, set realistic expectations for AI reliability, and help them think about their own governance and trust posture as they adopt ServiceNow's AI capabilities themselves. The way you operate is part of how ServiceNow is building toward a different way of working in customer success — your fluency with AI contributes to that journey. 

This role is illustratively aligned to a portfolio of moderate-complexity customers with mid-tier annual contract value — final portfolio sizing and ACV thresholds are subject to final design. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Own consumption and adoption outcomes across a portfolio of mid-ACV, moderate-complexity customers; drive customer action through deep understanding of adoption metrics aligned to customer KPIs and business goals.  

  • Utilize the internal productivity agent stack with practitioner-level fluency — recognize agent failure modes, override agent-recommended actions where context demands, integrate agent outputs into customer engagement seamlessly. 

  • Lead Customer Business Reviews at Director and Manager level; translate platform outcomes into commercial impact in the customer’s language. 

  • Own a standardized to moderately tailored Customer Impact Plan across the portfolio; manage critical risks and mitigation strategies, conducting periodic reviews to refine the plan and report on adoption. 

  • Apply business acumen — understand how the customer makes money, differentiates, and manages risk; spot expansion signals in natural conversation and hand them off cleanly to Sales. 

  • Partner with the Renewal Account Manager (RAM) and AE on renewal readiness, surfacing risk and opportunity from your portfolio. 

  • Diagnose adoption blockers at configuration or workflow level; escalate complex technical issues to relevant stakeholders with full context already assembled. 

  • Contribute patterns from customer deployments to playbook development; provide structured feedback to agent systems and flag patterns that need new logic. 

  • Integrate outputs from multiple AI tools into a coherent customer narrative — adding the commercial, political, and strategic context that AI cannot see. This integration work is where human judgment compounds with AI output.  

  • Explain AI behavior to customer stakeholders with appropriate confidence calibration — what the AI did, what it didn't do, where it might be wrong, and where it should be trusted. Help customers build their own intuition for AI-augmented work.  

  • Provide structured feedback to the AI systems — flag failure modes, surface patterns the AI misses, and feed your judgement back so the system improves over time.  

  • Support Impact renewal preparation in collaboration with the AE and RAM, proactively addressing adoption challenges and value gaps.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Fluency in Canadian French (written and verbal) is required 
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 2–5 years of related work experience in customer success, consulting, technical advisory, project management, business administration, or SaaS — with demonstrable AI fluency. 
  • Capability with AI tools and agents in a professional context — able to operate fluently with multiple agents, recognize their failure modes, and override agent-recommended actions where context demands. 
  • Ability to translate AI work for non-technical stakeholders — explain to a customer Director what AI is doing, why it matters, and what level of confidence is appropriate, without retreating into technical language or overselling capability.  
  • Demonstrated track record of using AI to materially change how you do work — not just adopting AI tools, but extracting real value from them and adapting your workflow accordingly. 
  • Practitioner-level business acumen — translates customer business context into a ServiceNow best-practice roadmap with confidence and limited supervision. 
  • Strong stakeholder management capability — navigates multi-stakeholder situations at Director and Manager level with structure; comfortable challenging assumptions and leading uncomfortable conversations.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of a customer portfolio, act with autonomy, and make key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes. 
  • Ability to leverage data and analytics to make informed decisions and provide recommendations that drive achievement of customer business objectives. 
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow platform architecture, CMDB, Workflow Data Fabric, and Agentic AI concepts — working fluency in Sense, Decide, Act, Govern and mapping core use cases to customer business. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Support, Delivery, Renewal Account Managers). 
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead Customer Business Reviews and chair structured customer meetings. 
  • Growth mindset — willing AND able to stretch into an evolving role; ready to drive adoption of new agents as they are released. 
  • ServiceNow experience and/or certifications strongly preferred.

Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem  across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources  providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance. 

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents.  For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

Job Description

About the Team  

We are looking for a passionate Staff Software Engineer, Backend who will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining the next frontier of Agent Identity Security. The team is advancing Agent Identity Security as AI agents and copilots rapidly expand across enterprise systems. The team drives innovation, defines next-generation IGA for non-human identities and agents, and helps shape new industry standards as the AI agent ecosystem evolves. Its work includes discovering agents, tracking their actions, and defining access management and runtime authorization capabilities to maintain a strong security posture.  

Your core focus areas:  

In this role, you will tackle the unique access risks posed by AI agents, contributing to a high-impact startup at the cutting edge of Identity and Access Management. This is an exciting opportunity where your key responsibilities will include: 

  • Architect and Build: Design, develop, and scale a comprehensive identity security solution for AI agents, ensuring it can manage a diverse landscape of agents deployed across different applications and systems. 
  • Strategic Influence: Shape our long-term agent identity security roadmap and help define industry standards for securing agents, providing visibility into rogue agents, and ensuring least privilege access. 
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product management, other engineering teams, and security experts to translate complex security challenges into robust, scalable, and production-grade features. 
  • End-to-End Ownership: Take ownership of the entire feature lifecycle, from initial concept and design through to deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Leverage AI techniques and tools to advance and strengthen Agent Security product. 

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Experience: Proven 5+ yrs in backend software development, with a focus on APIs, Microservices Architecture or related areas 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Golang, Java. 
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and Microservices Architectures. 
  • Experience with cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and familiarity with IAM services and features. 
  • Innate love for Distributed Systems (designing, developing, debugging, monitoring) 

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience with Containerization and Orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, is a plus. 
  • Knowledge of database technologies (SQL and NoSQL), caching mechanisms, and distributed systems. 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Strong sense of Product feature Ownership – from Ideation to Deployment 

Why join us: 

With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises in Fortune 500 trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance, we are building the system that uses AI to govern AI.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

We are looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager (TCSM) to join our growing Customer Success Team, who are a key in helping our valued customers achieve their strategic objectives and obtain maximum value from their investment in their Armis Platform. This will include helping in aligning new use cases to the CISO goals, and identify growth opportunities by informing the customer of our latest innovations, capabilities, and products and match these to the clients’ business goals. In addition, the TCSM will guide the customer in the successful adoption and operationalization of the Armis platform towards maximum value realization within all levels of the organization so hands-on technical delivery of the platform and configuration is required. The TCSM serves as the business liaison between the customer and all cross functional teams within Armis, including our Executive team, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Training and Enablement and others.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage a portfolio of up to 20 accounts throughout their lifecycle with Armis.

  • Build strong customer relationships by engaging early as the customer transitions from the PreSales phase to deployment. Work with customer and Armis account teams to define success plans and strategy to meet customer’s objectives.
